chapters.titleEn: Current builds before attraction moves the plunger
chapters.caption: 施加 5 V：电流与磁力先建立，柱塞克服弹簧后才接触。
chapters.captionEn: Apply 5 V: current and attraction build before the plunger overcomes the spring and closes the contacts.

chapters.title: 负载由自己的电源供能
chapters.titleEn: The load uses its own energy source
chapters.caption: 负载电源 5 V → 12 V，功率 0.25 W → 1.44 W，线圈状态不变。
chapters.captionEn: Load source 5 V → 12 V gives 0.25 W → 1.44 W while coil state stays unchanged.

chapters.title: 从静止出发，2 V 不足以吸合
chapters.titleEn: Two volts cannot pull in from rest
chapters.caption: 开气隙下施加 2 V，磁力小于预紧力，触点仍开。
chapters.captionEn: At the open gap, 2 V produces less attraction than preload, leaving the contacts open.

chapters.title: 先吸合，再降到相同电压
chapters.titleEn: Pull in first, then reduce to the same voltage
chapters.caption: 先用 5 V 吸合再降到 2 V，小气隙增强磁力，仍可保持。
chapters.captionEn: Pull in at 5 V, then reduce to 2 V: the smaller gap strengthens attraction enough to hold.

chapters.title: 断电之后，电流先续流再衰减
chapters.titleEn: After switch-off, current recirculates before decaying
chapters.caption: 本例含续流二极管：断源后线圈电流先衰减，弹簧再释放触点。
chapters.captionEn: With the illustrated flyback diode, coil current decays after source removal before the spring releases the contacts.

chapters.title: 有线圈电流，触点仍可能没动
chapters.titleEn: Coil current does not prove contact movement
chapters.caption: 柱塞被机械阻挡：线圈有电流和磁力，负载仍未接通。
chapters.captionEn: A mechanically blocked plunger retains coil current and attraction while leaving the load disconnected.

chapters.title: 穿心一匝，测量大电流
chapters.titleEn: One primary turn measures a large current
chapters.caption: 低负担下，二次电流接近一次电流除以匝数。
chapters.captionEn: With a low burden, secondary current nearly follows the turns ratio.

chapters.title: 没有完全抵消的安匝
chapters.titleEn: The ampere-turns do not cancel completely
chapters.caption: 一次安匝减去二次安匝，剩余部分建立磁场。
chapters.captionEn: Primary minus secondary ampere-turns establishes the core field.

chapters.title: 二次匝数加倍
chapters.caption: 同样一次电流，二次电流大约减半。
chapters.captionEn: The same primary current gives roughly half the secondary current.

chapters.title: 负担变大，比例开始失真
chapters.titleEn: A larger burden distorts the ratio
chapters.caption: 更多电压需要更多磁通变化，非线性误差增大。
chapters.captionEn: More required voltage drives larger flux changes and nonlinear error.

chapters.title: 开路不等于没有电压
chapters.titleEn: Open circuit does not mean zero voltage
chapters.caption: 二次电流为零，变化磁通仍产生高电压。
chapters.captionEn: Secondary current is zero, but changing flux still induces high voltage.

chapters.title: 有磁通，不一定有感应电压
chapters.titleEn: Flux alone does not guarantee induction
chapters.caption: 直流达到稳态后，磁通不变，感应输出为零。
chapters.captionEn: After DC settles, flux is constant and induced output is zero.

chapters.title: 发热与散热能达到平衡
chapters.titleEn: Heating and heat loss can balance
chapters.caption: 1 A下，热量逐渐通过端帽导出。
chapters.captionEn: At 1 A, heat increasingly escapes through the end caps.

chapters.title: 中间先达到熔点
chapters.caption: 2.2 A过载下，最热处先到达961.9°C。
chapters.captionEn: At 2.2 A, the hottest location first reaches 961.9°C.

chapters.title: 短脉冲可以留下热，却不熔化
chapters.titleEn: A brief pulse can heat without melting
chapters.caption: 相同4 A，8 ms脉冲结束后开始冷却。
chapters.captionEn: At the same 4 A, an 8 ms pulse ends before melting and then cools.

chapters.title: 环境更热，余量更小
chapters.titleEn: A warmer environment leaves less margin
chapters.caption: 相同2.2 A，80°C环境更早到达熔点。
chapters.captionEn: At the same 2.2 A, an 80°C environment reaches melting sooner.

chapters.title: 只变粗一点，升温就明显变慢
chapters.titleEn: A thicker wire heats much more slowly
chapters.caption: 直径50→70 µm，面积接近翻倍。
chapters.captionEn: Changing diameter from 50 to 70 µm nearly doubles area.

chapters.title: 电流加倍，短时升温约快四倍
chapters.titleEn: Double current, roughly quarter the short heating time
chapters.caption: 高电流短时间内，达到同一热状态的I²t近似相同。
chapters.captionEn: During brief high-current heating, equal thermal endpoints need similar I²t.

chapters.title: 先固定其他条件
chapters.caption: 同一组物体，同高、同时、从静止释放。
chapters.captionEn: Same objects, same height, released together from rest.

chapters.title: 先看有空气的下落
chapters.caption: 有空气时，铁片先到，羽毛后到。
chapters.captionEn: With air present, the iron arrives first and the feather follows.

chapters.title: 抽去空气
chapters.caption: 抽去空气，保持其他条件不变。
chapters.captionEn: Remove the air while holding the other conditions fixed.

chapters.title: 再次同时释放
chapters.caption: 忽略空气阻力，两者一起下落、一起到达。
chapters.captionEn: Without air resistance, both fall together and arrive together.

chapters.title: 把两次实验对齐
chapters.caption: 相同条件下，自由落体的加速度与物体质量无关。
chapters.captionEn: Under the same conditions, free-fall acceleration does not depend on mass.

chapters.title: 同节拍，不同点距
chapters.caption: 快而均匀，仍然是匀速。
chapters.captionEn: Fast and steady is still uniform.

chapters.title: 一段时间，一段位移
chapters.caption: 等时段越长，平均速度越大。
chapters.captionEn: A longer equal-time strip means faster motion.

chapters.title: 盯住同一个时刻
chapters.caption: 缩小区间，仍保留采样边界。
chapters.captionEn: Narrow the interval; respect the sampling limit.

chapters.title: 从等时纸带到加速度
chapters.caption: 等时段等量增长，预测下一点。
chapters.captionEn: Equal gap increments predict the next mark.

chapters.title: 下落更快，加速度变了吗？
chapters.caption: 速度增加，加速度可以不变。
chapters.captionEn: Velocity can grow at constant acceleration.

chapters.title: 跟着导体棒看受力
chapters.titleEn: Follow the force on the wire
chapters.caption: 电流、磁场与受力互相垂直。
chapters.captionEn: Current, field and force are perpendicular.

chapters.title: 只反转电流
chapters.caption: 磁场不变，电流反向，受力反向。
chapters.captionEn: Keep the field fixed: reversing current reverses force.

chapters.title: 再反转磁场
chapters.caption: 只反转磁场，也会反转受力。
chapters.captionEn: Reversing only the field also reverses the force.

chapters.title: 铜线圈也能吸铁钉
chapters.titleEn: A copper coil can attract iron
chapters.caption: 通电螺线管建立磁场，使软铁钉被吸引。
chapters.captionEn: The coil field magnetizes and attracts the soft iron nail.

chapters.title: 反向后为何仍然吸引
chapters.caption: 磁极反转，软铁磁化也反转，吸引保持。
chapters.captionEn: The poles and induced magnetization reverse together.

chapters.title: 相邻电流怎样相互作用
chapters.caption: 同向相吸，反向相斥。
chapters.captionEn: Parallel currents attract; opposite currents repel.

chapters.title: 把吸引变成接触循环
chapters.titleEn: Turning attraction into a contact cycle
chapters.caption: 线圈吸引、接点断开、弹簧复位，循环重来。
chapters.captionEn: Attraction opens the contact; elastic return closes it again.

chapters.title: 没动，为什么读9.8？
chapters.caption: 支撑让内部质量块偏离中位。
chapters.captionEn: Support shifts the proof mass.

chapters.title: 下落，为什么反而接近零？
chapters.caption: 支撑撤去，读数回零；重力仍在。
chapters.captionEn: Signal near zero; gravity remains.

chapters.title: 接住时，向下还是向上？
chapters.titleEn: At the catch: down or up?
chapters.caption: 接住的正峰，来自向下减速。
chapters.captionEn: Catch peak: slowing downward motion.

chapters.title: 电梯一直上行，读数会一直偏大吗？
chapters.caption: 读数随速度的变化，不随上行方向。
chapters.captionEn: Changing speed changes the signal.

chapters.title: 上行减速，加速度是什么符号？
chapters.caption: 同向参考下，读数减g得到稳定加速度。
chapters.captionEn: Fixed axis: settled signal − g = a.

chapters.title: 不用手机，怎样求出加速度？
chapters.titleEn: How can a force meter find acceleration?
chapters.caption: 两次稳定拉力，在等幅条件下消去质量。
chapters.captionEn: Equal magnitudes let us eliminate mass.

chapters.title: 摩擦只转移电荷
chapters.caption: 玻璃棒与丝绸得到等量异号电荷。
chapters.captionEn: Glass and silk acquire equal and opposite charges.

chapters.title: 先让两个导体接触
chapters.caption: 带正电的物体靠近，电子移向较近的导体。
chapters.captionEn: A positive object approaches and draws electrons toward the nearer conductor.

chapters.title: 先分开，再移走
chapters.caption: 分开后，两导体保留等量异号电荷。
chapters.captionEn: After separation, the conductors retain equal and opposite charges.

chapters.title: 重新接触
chapters.caption: 通路恢复，电子重新分布，两者恢复中性。
chapters.captionEn: Reconnection lets electrons redistribute and restores neutrality.

chapters.title: 验电器张开了，净电荷变了吗？
chapters.titleEn: Do open leaves imply added charge?
chapters.caption: 靠近可以使箔片张开，但验电器仍可整体中性。
chapters.captionEn: An approaching rod can open the leaves while total charge stays zero.

chapters.title: 用已知电荷作比较
chapters.titleEn: Compare with a known initial charge
chapters.caption: 预先带负电时，正电棒移近可先使张角减小。
chapters.captionEn: For a negatively precharged instrument, an approaching positive rod can first reduce the opening.

chapters.title: 把排斥看成张开的细丝
chapters.caption: 同号电荷的排斥与弹性回复共同决定细丝形状。
chapters.captionEn: Repulsion and elastic restoring forces together determine filament shape.

chapters.title: 先看没有磁场的电子束
chapters.caption: 无磁场，电子束保持直线。
chapters.captionEn: With the field off, the beam stays straight.

chapters.title: 反转磁场，反转偏转
chapters.titleEn: Reverse the field and the bend
chapters.caption: 电子带负电，磁场反向，偏转也反向。
chapters.captionEn: The negative electron reverses its bend when the field reverses.

chapters.title: 用磁场改变半径
chapters.titleEn: Use the field to change the radius
chapters.caption: 磁力持续转向，速率保持。
chapters.captionEn: Magnetic force changes direction, not speed.

chapters.title: 斜着进入，沿轴前进
chapters.titleEn: Enter obliquely and advance along the axis
chapters.caption: 沿磁场的速度分量保留，圆周运动叠加成螺旋。
chapters.captionEn: Motion along the field combines with circular motion into a helix.

chapters.title: 让同位素走不同的弯路
chapters.caption: 同电压、同电荷，较重同位素半径更大。
chapters.captionEn: At equal voltage and charge, the heavier isotope has a larger radius.

chapters.title: 从落点回到质量
chapters.caption: 固定加速电压时，半径随质量平方根变化。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed accelerating voltage, radius scales with the square root of mass.

chapters.title: 铅板告诉我们运动方向
chapters.titleEn: The lead plate reveals travel direction
chapters.caption: 穿板损失动量，之后的弯曲更急。
chapters.captionEn: Momentum loss makes the track bend more tightly after the plate.

chapters.title: 再用磁场判断电荷
chapters.titleEn: Then infer the charge from the field
chapters.caption: 先确定运动方向，再由弯曲方向判断电荷。
chapters.captionEn: Determine motion first, then infer charge from the bend.

chapters.title: 先照可见光
chapters.caption: 负电锌板的箔片保持张开：单个光子的能量还不够。
chapters.captionEn: The charged leaves remain open: each photon has too little energy.

chapters.title: 换成紫外光
chapters.caption: 电子逸出，锌板失去部分负电，箔片逐渐合拢。
chapters.captionEn: Escaping electrons reduce the negative charge and the leaves close.

chapters.title: 扫描光的频率
chapters.caption: 达到截止频率后，阴极才开始发射光电子。
chapters.captionEn: Photoelectrons appear only above the threshold frequency.

chapters.title: 只改变光强
chapters.caption: 光更强，发射的电子更多；最大初动能保持不变。
chapters.captionEn: Brighter light releases more electrons without raising their maximum energy.

chapters.title: 用反向电压拦住电子
chapters.titleEn: Stop electrons with a retarding voltage
chapters.caption: 反向电压达到遏止电压时，最快的电子也不能到达阳极。
chapters.captionEn: At the stopping voltage, even the most energetic electrons cannot reach the collector.

chapters.title: 换频率，再测遏止电压
chapters.caption: 同一种阴极材料下，记录多组频率与遏止电压。
chapters.captionEn: Keep the cathode material fixed and collect frequency–stopping-voltage pairs.

chapters.title: 从斜率得到 h/e
chapters.caption: 遏止电压对频率的斜率为 h/e；横轴截距对应截止频率。
chapters.captionEn: The stopping-voltage slope is h/e; the horizontal intercept is the threshold frequency.

chapters.title: 从小孔观察热腔
chapters.caption: 小孔近似黑体；分光后可比较不同波长的辐射。
chapters.captionEn: A small cavity aperture approximates a blackbody; dispersion separates wavelengths.

chapters.title: 升高炉温
chapters.caption: 温度提高，曲线整体升高，峰值向更短波长移动。
chapters.captionEn: Heating raises the spectrum and shifts its peak toward shorter wavelengths.

chapters.title: 追踪同一条曲线的峰值
chapters.caption: 峰值波长与温度的乘积近似为常量。
chapters.captionEn: Peak wavelength times temperature is approximately constant.

chapters.title: 用同一条定律描述各温度
chapters.caption: 普朗克分布在短波端下降，避免经典预测的发散。
chapters.captionEn: Planck’s distribution falls at short wavelengths instead of diverging.

chapters.title: 同质量，换形状
chapters.caption: 纸张质量不变，揉成团后下落可以更快。
chapters.captionEn: Crumpling paper can change its fall without changing its mass.

chapters.title: 再与橡皮比较
chapters.caption: 纸团更接近橡皮的下落，但仍受空气影响。
chapters.captionEn: The paper ball falls more like the eraser, while air still matters.

chapters.title: 两石捆绑的反证
chapters.caption: 同一个组合，原假设却推出更慢和更快两种结论。
chapters.captionEn: The same pair receives contradictory slower and faster predictions.

chapters.title: 把距离读成时间
chapters.titleEn: Read a distance as a time
chapters.caption: 接尺前的下落距离，可以换算成反应延迟。
chapters.captionEn: The distance fallen before the catch gives a delay estimate.

chapters.title: 时间刻度为什么不等距
chapters.titleEn: Why the time marks are uneven
chapters.caption: 延迟翻倍，下落距离变为四倍。
chapters.captionEn: Double the delay and the falling distance becomes four times larger.

chapters.title: 先看到排斥
chapters.caption: 距离变近，悬球偏转；最终距离也随之改变。
chapters.captionEn: As the source moves nearer, the suspended sphere deflects and changes the final separation.

chapters.title: 先回零，再比较
chapters.caption: 转动悬丝上端，使 A 球回到原位。
chapters.captionEn: Rotate the upper suspension until A returns to its reference position.

chapters.title: 距离减半，力怎样变？
chapters.caption: 保持电荷和回零状态，距离减半，力变为四倍。
chapters.captionEn: Keep charges fixed and maintain null: halving separation gives four times the force.

chapters.title: 相同小球分走一半电荷
chapters.titleEn: Share charge with an identical sphere
chapters.caption: 中性球接触后分开，A 的电荷与回零扭角都减半。
chapters.captionEn: After contact and separation, A retains half its charge and needs half the nulling twist.

chapters.title: 磁体在场，电流为何为零
chapters.titleEn: A magnet is present, but current is zero
chapters.caption: 磁通存在，不等于磁通正在变化。
chapters.captionEn: Flux can exist without changing.

chapters.title: 靠近和远离，方向相反
chapters.titleEn: Approaching and withdrawing reverse the response
chapters.caption: 磁极不变，运动反向，感应电流反向。
chapters.captionEn: With the pole fixed, reversing motion reverses induction.

chapters.title: 保持运动，反转磁极
chapters.titleEn: Keep the motion and reverse the pole
chapters.caption: 运动相同，磁极反转，电动势反向。
chapters.captionEn: The same motion with reversed poles gives reversed emf.

chapters.title: 让闭合铝环回应磁体
chapters.caption: 闭合电流阻碍磁体和铝环的相对运动。
chapters.captionEn: The closed current loop opposes relative motion.

chapters.title: 切断一处，环流消失
chapters.titleEn: Break the ring and remove the loop current
chapters.caption: 断环不能维持绕环电流。
chapters.captionEn: A split ring cannot sustain a circulating current.

chapters.title: 同一线圈，改变释放高度
chapters.titleEn: Change release height, keep the coil
chapters.caption: 下落更快，磁通变化也更快。
chapters.captionEn: Faster passage changes flux more rapidly.

chapters.title: 同一次运动，增加匝数
chapters.titleEn: Keep the motion and increase turns
chapters.caption: 同一磁通变化，电动势正比于匝数。
chapters.captionEn: For the same flux change, emf is proportional to turn count.

chapters.title: 圆盘怎样连接外电路
chapters.titleEn: How the disc connects to a circuit
chapters.caption: 轴与边缘电刷，连接径向电动势。
chapters.captionEn: Axle and rim brushes connect the radial emf.

chapters.title: 停转与反转是关键对照
chapters.titleEn: Stop and reverse as controlled comparisons
chapters.caption: 停转则电动势为零，反转则极性反向。
chapters.captionEn: Stopping removes emf; reversing rotation reverses polarity.

chapters.title: 偏着挂，为什么会转？
chapters.titleEn: Why does the tilted lamina turn?
chapters.caption: 力臂决定重力的转动作用。
chapters.captionEn: Lever arm sets gravity’s turning effect.

chapters.title: 一条线，够不够？
chapters.caption: 第一条墨迹只限定一条直线。
chapters.captionEn: One ink mark constrains only a line.

chapters.title: 换孔后，什么没有变？
chapters.titleEn: What stays fixed after changing holes?
chapters.caption: 旧墨迹随板转，新悬线提供第二个约束。
chapters.captionEn: Old ink turns; a new plumb supplies another constraint.

chapters.title: 加配重后，旧交点还对吗？
chapters.titleEn: Does the old crossing survive an added mass?
chapters.caption: 轮廓不变，配重仍会移动组合重心。
chapters.captionEn: The outline stays, but added mass shifts the centre.

chapters.title: 从碎屑的转向开始
chapters.caption: 极化后的碎屑逐渐沿局部电场取向。
chapters.captionEn: Polarized fragments gradually align with the local field.

chapters.title: 异号电荷之间
chapters.caption: 取向连接两端，正试探电荷的受力规定箭头方向。
chapters.captionEn: The pattern connects the electrodes; a positive test charge defines arrow direction.

chapters.title: 同号电荷之间
chapters.caption: 中央场互相抵消，周围的取向向外弯开。
chapters.captionEn: The fields cancel at the midpoint and surrounding orientations bend outward.

chapters.title: 平行板中部
chapters.caption: 只看远离边缘的区域，碎屑近似平行。
chapters.captionEn: Away from the edges, fragments are approximately parallel.

chapters.title: 接通的瞬间
chapters.caption: 原线圈电流变化，副线圈才响应。
chapters.captionEn: The secondary responds while the primary current changes.

chapters.title: 电流稳定以后
chapters.caption: 有磁场，不等于持续产生电动势。
chapters.captionEn: A magnetic field alone does not sustain an emf.

chapters.title: 断开后反向
chapters.caption: 磁通减小，感应电动势方向反转。
chapters.captionEn: Decreasing flux reverses the induced emf.

chapters.title: 连续传送音频信号
chapters.caption: 变化的原电流，不需要电接触就能传递信号。
chapters.captionEn: Changing primary current transfers a signal without electrical contact.

chapters.title: 抽出以后比较
chapters.caption: 相同信号源，更小的耦合带来更弱的接收信号。
chapters.captionEn: The same source produces a weaker signal with less coupling.

chapters.title: 先测无电场时的下降
chapters.titleEn: Measure the fall without a field
chapters.caption: 稳定下降时，空气黏滞阻力平衡扣除浮力后的重力。
chapters.captionEn: At terminal speed, viscous drag balances the effective weight.

chapters.title: 调电压，让油滴悬停
chapters.titleEn: Adjust voltage until the drop balances
chapters.caption: 负电油滴受到向上的电场力；悬停时两力平衡。
chapters.captionEn: The negatively charged drop feels an upward electric force; at rest the forces balance.

chapters.title: 改变电荷，重复平衡
chapters.titleEn: Change the charge and balance again
chapters.caption: 多次测得的电荷大小是同一个基本量的整数倍。
chapters.captionEn: Repeated charge measurements lie at integer multiples of one common unit.

chapters.title: 让粒子穿过薄金箔
chapters.titleEn: Send particles through a thin foil
chapters.caption: 绝大多数粒子近乎直行；图中放大展示不同入射偏距。
chapters.captionEn: Most particles pass nearly straight; enlarged paths compare impact parameters.

chapters.title: 把入射偏距逐渐减小
chapters.caption: 越接近集中的正电荷，库仑斥力造成的偏转越大。
chapters.captionEn: Closer encounters with concentrated positive charge produce stronger deflection.

chapters.title: 解释少量大角度散射
chapters.caption: 少量大角度散射要求正电荷和大部分质量集中在很小区域。
chapters.captionEn: Rare large deflections reveal concentrated positive charge and mass.

chapters.title: 测量散射后的X射线
chapters.caption: 固定入射波长，在不同散射角度比较谱线位置。
chapters.captionEn: Keep incident wavelength fixed and compare spectral lines at different angles.

chapters.title: 增大散射角度
chapters.caption: 散射角增大，散射峰向长波移动；电子获得反冲动量。
chapters.captionEn: A larger angle shifts the peak toward longer wavelengths and gives the electron recoil momentum.

chapters.title: 比较最大波长改变
chapters.caption: 反向散射的波长增加最大；峰位遵循同一守恒关系。
chapters.captionEn: Backscattering gives the largest wavelength increase under the same conservation law.

chapters.title: 先记录光点零位
chapters.caption: 没有按压时，记录光点最初的位置。
chapters.captionEn: Record the initial unloaded spot.

chapters.title: 按压两镜之间
chapters.caption: 桌面局部倾斜，使反射方向发生变化。
chapters.captionEn: Local table slopes change the reflected direction.

chapters.title: 让光走得更远
chapters.caption: 按压力不变，墙移远后光点偏移更大。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed force, a farther wall gives a larger spot displacement.

chapters.title: 松手检验恢复
chapters.caption: 弹性范围内，卸载后回到初始状态。
chapters.captionEn: Within the elastic model, unloading restores the initial state.

chapters.title: 先调至稳态等亮
chapters.caption: 控制稳态电流，才有可比较的两盏灯。
chapters.captionEn: Match steady current before comparing the lamps.

chapters.title: 重新接通
chapters.caption: 线圈支路电流逐渐增加。
chapters.captionEn: Current in the inductive branch rises gradually.

chapters.title: 传感器显示上升过程
chapters.caption: 保持总电阻相同，比较有无电感。
chapters.captionEn: Keep total resistance fixed when removing inductance.

chapters.title: 断开后的通路
chapters.caption: 电源退出，线圈与灯泡仍然闭合。
chapters.captionEn: The source leaves, but the coil–lamp loop stays closed.

chapters.title: 低电阻线圈的闪亮
chapters.caption: 断开前线圈电流更大，才可能暂时更亮。
chapters.captionEn: A larger initial coil current permits a brighter flash.

chapters.title: 不是每次都会闪亮
chapters.titleEn: Opening need not produce a flash
chapters.caption: 增大线圈电阻，反向仍在，闪亮消失。
chapters.captionEn: Higher winding resistance removes the flash, not reversal.

chapters.title: 测出电流反向
chapters.caption: 电流传感器保留电流的正负号。
chapters.captionEn: The current sensor preserves the sign.

chapters.title: 先充电，再隔离
chapters.caption: 开关断开后，极板保留原来的电荷。
chapters.captionEn: Opening the switch preserves charge on the isolated plates.

chapters.title: 只减小板距
chapters.caption: 电荷不变；板距减半，电容加倍，电压减半。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed charge, halving separation doubles capacitance and halves voltage.

chapters.title: 只减小正对面积
chapters.caption: 错开一块板，电容减小，电压升高。
chapters.captionEn: Offset one plate: capacitance falls and voltage rises.

chapters.title: 再插入介质
chapters.caption: 几何不变；介质使电容增大，电压降低。
chapters.captionEn: With geometry unchanged, dielectric insertion raises capacitance and lowers voltage.

chapters.title: 先找到伸长零点
chapters.caption: 伸长量等于总长度减去原长。
chapters.captionEn: Extension is total length minus natural length.

chapters.title: 逐次加挂砝码
chapters.caption: 每次静止后，才用重力代表弹力。
chapters.captionEn: Use load weight as spring force only after it settles.

chapters.title: 检查比例关系
chapters.caption: 线性范围内，伸长翻倍，弹力翻倍。
chapters.captionEn: In the linear range, doubling extension doubles force.

chapters.title: 换材料，重新测
chapters.titleEn: Change the material and measure again
chapters.caption: 橡皮筋的加载曲线可以是弯曲的。
chapters.captionEn: Rubber can have a curved loading relation.

chapters.title: 沿卸载路径返回
chapters.caption: 相同伸长处，卸载力可以小于加载力。
chapters.captionEn: At the same extension, unloading force can be lower.

chapters.title: 重复以后再比较
chapters.caption: 比较各轮记录，检查软化与重复性。
chapters.captionEn: Compare cycles to check softening and repeatability.

chapters.title: 先用电场偏转
chapters.caption: 电子向电场的反方向偏转，显示射线带负电。
chapters.captionEn: The beam deflects opposite the electric field, indicating negative charge.

chapters.title: 换成磁场
chapters.caption: 磁场改变运动方向，轨迹弯曲；所受力与速度垂直。
chapters.captionEn: A magnetic field bends the beam with a force perpendicular to velocity.

chapters.title: 让两种偏转抵消
chapters.caption: 电场力与磁场力抵消时，电子束恢复直线。
chapters.captionEn: When electric and magnetic forces balance, the beam becomes straight.

chapters.title: 把比荷与电荷量区分开
chapters.caption: 偏转测量先给出比荷；结合元电荷才可求电子质量。
chapters.captionEn: Deflection first gives charge-to-mass ratio; elementary charge is needed to infer mass.

chapters.title: 让射线穿过金属窗
chapters.titleEn: Transmit rays through a metal window
chapters.caption: 薄金属窗维持管内真空，同时允许一部分电子穿出。
chapters.captionEn: A thin metal window preserves the vacuum while transmitting some electrons.

chapters.title: 比较薄膜的阻挡
chapters.caption: 加厚示意薄膜，透过信号减弱；原子并非不可穿透的实心球。
chapters.captionEn: A thicker foil weakens transmission; atoms are not impenetrable solid spheres.

chapters.title: 断开的微安表
chapters.caption: 相同初始偏转下，指针来回摆动。
chapters.captionEn: The same initial deflection produces oscillation.

chapters.title: 短接两个接线柱
chapters.caption: 感应电流的转矩加快稳定。
chapters.captionEn: Induced-current torque makes the pointer settle sooner.

chapters.title: 旋转磁体驱动铝框
chapters.titleEn: A rotating magnet drives the frame
chapters.caption: 相对转动产生电流，转矩带动铝框。
chapters.captionEn: Relative rotation induces current and drives the frame.

chapters.title: 反转驱动与转差
chapters.titleEn: Reverse the drive and inspect slip
chapters.caption: 驱动方向反转，铝框跟随但保留转差。
chapters.captionEn: The frame follows the reversed drive with remaining slip.

chapters.title: 先让铜盘自由转动
chapters.caption: 同样的初始角速度，先记录自然减速。
chapters.captionEn: Record natural deceleration at a fixed initial speed.

chapters.title: 把磁极放到边缘
chapters.titleEn: Place the poles near the edge
chapters.caption: 磁极不接触铜盘，涡流仍然耗散转动能。
chapters.captionEn: Without contact, eddy currents dissipate rotational energy.

chapters.title: 完整铝管中的落磁
chapters.titleEn: A magnet in a complete tube
chapters.caption: 闭合环流把重力释放的能量转成热。
chapters.captionEn: Closed eddies turn released gravitational energy into heat.

chapters.title: 切断大范围环流
chapters.caption: 纵向开缝后，同一磁体下落更快。
chapters.captionEn: A longitudinal slit lets the same magnet fall faster.

chapters.title: 弹簧磁体自由振动
chapters.caption: 断开线圈，先保留同一初始位移。
chapters.captionEn: Start with the coil open and the same displacement.

chapters.title: 闭合线圈后的衰减
chapters.caption: 振动能经感应电流耗散，衰减加快。
chapters.captionEn: Induced current dissipates oscillation energy more quickly.

chapters.title: 记录同一次放电
chapters.caption: 电流逐渐减小，电容器两端电压同时降低。
chapters.captionEn: Current declines as the capacitor voltage falls.

chapters.title: 把面积加起来
chapters.caption: 曲线下面积给出已释放电荷，剩余部分仍在电容器中。
chapters.captionEn: The area gives released charge; the rest remains in the capacitor.

chapters.title: 接到相同的空电容器
chapters.caption: 达到共同电压后，电荷与电压都各减半。
chapters.captionEn: At a common voltage, each has half the original charge and voltage.

chapters.title: 再换一只新的空电容器
chapters.caption: B 保留自己的电荷，A 接到新 C 后再次减半。
chapters.captionEn: B retains its share; connecting A to a new C halves A again.

chapters.title: 先保证匀速
chapters.caption: 匀速水平拖动时，拉力等于滑动摩擦力。
chapters.captionEn: A steady horizontal pull equals kinetic friction.

chapters.title: 增加正压力
chapters.caption: 材料相同，增加载荷后摩擦力增大。
chapters.captionEn: For the same surfaces, added load increases friction.

chapters.title: 用手体验压力变化
chapters.caption: 按压更大时，滑动的阻碍更明显。
chapters.captionEn: Stronger pressure produces more sliding resistance.

chapters.title: 留下起滑峰值
chapters.caption: 静摩擦随拉力增加，纸团保留最大读数。
chapters.captionEn: Static friction grows with pull; the paper keeps the peak.

chapters.title: 看完整时间记录
chapters.caption: 传感器同时保留增长、峰值和回落。
chapters.captionEn: The sensor preserves the rise, peak and falling reading.

chapters.title: 先观察电池
chapters.caption: 直流电压保持同一极性。
chapters.captionEn: Direct voltage keeps one polarity.

chapters.title: 换成交流电源
chapters.caption: 周期性跨过零，意味着电压极性反转。
chapters.captionEn: Crossing zero periodically reverses voltage polarity.

chapters.title: 发电机的一半周期
chapters.caption: 一个方向的电流点亮一只LED。
chapters.captionEn: One current direction lights one LED.

chapters.title: 另一半周期
chapters.caption: 电流反向，另一只LED发光。
chapters.captionEn: Reversed current lights the other LED.

chapters.title: 线圈接直流
chapters.caption: 稳态直流由电阻限制。
chapters.captionEn: Resistance limits steady direct current.

chapters.title: 保持有效值，改接交流
chapters.caption: 变化电流带来感抗，灯泡变暗。
chapters.captionEn: Inductive reactance makes the lamp dimmer.

chapters.title: 直流充电暂态
chapters.caption: 短暂充电以后，电流趋于零。
chapters.captionEn: A brief charging current tends to zero.

chapters.title: 交流反复充放电
chapters.caption: 外电路持续有电流，电子不穿过介质。
chapters.captionEn: External current continues without electrons crossing the dielectric.

chapters.title: 提高交流频率
chapters.caption: 电容不变，频率越高，容抗越小。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed capacitance, higher frequency lowers reactance.

chapters.title: 先给电容充电
chapters.caption: 开关先接电源，建立初始电场能。
chapters.captionEn: The switch first stores electric energy in the capacitor.

chapters.title: 切换到线圈
chapters.caption: 电场能与磁场能交替交换。
chapters.captionEn: Electric and magnetic energies exchange.

chapters.title: 真实振荡会衰减
chapters.caption: 电阻耗散使振幅和电磁能逐渐减小。
chapters.captionEn: Resistive loss reduces amplitude and field energy.

chapters.title: 把两只挂钩相连
chapters.caption: 两只表同时变化，读数大小相等。
chapters.captionEn: Both readings change together with equal magnitude.

chapters.title: 伸长不同不是力不同
chapters.titleEn: Unequal stretch is not unequal force
chapters.caption: 分别标定的刻度，把不同伸长换成相同力值。
chapters.captionEn: Separate calibrations turn unequal extensions into equal forces.

chapters.title: 统一符号再记录
chapters.caption: 以向右为正，两条记录关于零线对称。
chapters.captionEn: With rightward positive, the traces mirror about zero.

chapters.title: 两端都动仍然配对
chapters.caption: 移动状态不会改变作用力与反作用力的配对。
chapters.captionEn: Motion does not remove the action–reaction pairing.

chapters.title: 发射与传播
chapters.caption: 迅速变化的电磁场带走能量。
chapters.captionEn: Rapidly changing fields carry energy outward.

chapters.title: 另一处间隙响应
chapters.caption: 接收环在传播延迟之后响应。
chapters.captionEn: The loop responds after the travel delay.

chapters.title: 反射产生干涉
chapters.caption: 同一空间出现固定的强弱位置。
chapters.captionEn: Fixed nodes and antinodes appear in space.

chapters.title: 进入另一种介质
chapters.caption: 传播方向改变，满足折射关系。
chapters.captionEn: The direction changes according to refraction.

chapters.title: 转动接收环
chapters.caption: 接收响应取决于方向投影。
chapters.captionEn: Reception depends on directional projection.

chapters.title: 通过有限狭缝
chapters.caption: 波长相同，狭缝越窄，衍射展开越明显。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed wavelength, a narrower slit spreads the wave more.

chapters.title: 先看火焰的颜色
chapters.caption: 钠原子发出的强黄光，让食盐焰色显得鲜明。
chapters.captionEn: Strong yellow emission from sodium gives the flame its characteristic color.

chapters.title: 把黄光再展开
chapters.caption: 放大黄色区域，两条相邻的钠谱线才被分开。
chapters.captionEn: Enlarge the yellow region to separate two nearby sodium lines.

chapters.title: 氢灯只留下几条亮线
chapters.caption: 可见的巴耳末谱线，来自不同高能级向同一低能级的跃迁。
chapters.captionEn: Visible Balmer lines correspond to transitions ending at the same lower level.

chapters.title: 用共同规律比较谱线
chapters.caption: 改变初始能级，谱线位置按同一里德伯关系变化。
chapters.captionEn: Changing the upper level moves the selected line according to one Rydberg relation.

chapters.title: 连续光谱里缺了哪些颜色
chapters.caption: 太阳光谱中的暗线，是特定波长被较冷气体吸收的结果。
chapters.captionEn: Dark solar lines mark wavelengths absorbed by cooler gas.

chapters.title: 把实验室亮线叠上去
chapters.caption: 同一元素的发射线与吸收线，在相应跃迁波长处对齐。
chapters.captionEn: Emission and absorption from the same transition align in wavelength.

chapters.title: 精密测量暴露小偏差
chapters.caption: 早期精密氢光谱发现的偏差，超出了简单能级公式。
chapters.captionEn: Early precision measurements revealed departures from simple level formulas.

chapters.title: 后来用微波直接比较能级
chapters.titleEn: Later probe the levels with microwaves
chapters.caption: 扫描微波频率，亚稳态氢原子的存活信号在共振附近下降。
chapters.captionEn: A microwave scan reduces the surviving metastable-atom signal near resonance.

chapters.title: 频率差对应能量差
chapters.caption: 共振频率约为1058 MHz；曲线宽度与深度在这里仅作示意。
chapters.captionEn: The separation is about 1058 MHz; this curve’s width and depth are illustrative.

chapters.title: 先有可重复基线
chapters.caption: 先固定频段、信号和传输条件。
chapters.captionEn: Fix the band, signal and traffic conditions first.

chapters.title: 同频与同时
chapters.caption: 只有交叠的数据包才满足碰撞条件。
chapters.captionEn: Only overlapping packets meet the collision condition.

chapters.title: 避开拥挤频点
chapters.caption: 跳频策略可以减少同频碰撞。
chapters.captionEn: Adaptive hopping can reduce frequency collisions.

chapters.title: 把Wi-Fi移到另一频段
chapters.caption: 频段分开，消除这个模型中的同频碰撞。
chapters.captionEn: Separate bands remove this model’s frequency collisions.

chapters.title: 回到手机做重复对照
chapters.caption: 多次交替测量，区分效应与波动。
chapters.captionEn: Alternate repeated measurements to distinguish effect from variation.

chapters.title: 先选择正确的测量面
chapters.caption: 外测量爪贴住小球两侧，才能读取外径。
chapters.captionEn: External jaws must contact both sides before reading the diameter.

chapters.title: 找第几条刻度对齐
chapters.caption: 主尺 23 mm，加上第七条对应的 0.7 mm。
chapters.captionEn: Add 23 mm on the main scale to 0.7 mm from the seventh aligned line.

chapters.title: 换成内测量爪
chapters.caption: 量槽宽时，让内测量爪向两侧撑开。
chapters.captionEn: To measure a slot, expand the internal jaws against both walls.

chapters.title: 一圈只前进半毫米
chapters.titleEn: One turn advances half a millimetre
chapters.caption: 螺杆平移与微分筒旋转来自同一螺距。
chapters.captionEn: Spindle translation and thimble rotation share one screw pitch.

chapters.title: 半毫米线有没有露出？
chapters.caption: 固定刻度与微分筒相加，并保留一位估读。
chapters.captionEn: Add sleeve and thimble readings, retaining one estimated digit.

chapters.title: 先检查零点，再量薄样品
chapters.titleEn: Check zero before a thin specimen
chapters.caption: 示数减去零点读数，才得到修正后的厚度。
chapters.captionEn: Subtract the zero reading to obtain corrected thickness.

chapters.title: 把十圈看成一个总长度
chapters.titleEn: Measure ten turns as one span
chapters.caption: 密绕后测总长，再除以圈数；间隙会带来偏大。
chapters.captionEn: Measure the tightly wound span and divide by turns; gaps cause overestimation.

chapters.title: 记录两个力的共同效果
chapters.titleEn: Record the effect of two forces
chapters.caption: 记住O点、两条方向和两个读数。
chapters.captionEn: Record O, two directions and both readings.

chapters.title: 单力恢复同一O点
chapters.caption: 同一位置，使橡皮条对圆环的力相同。
chapters.captionEn: The same position restores the same strip force.

chapters.title: 比较矢量记录
chapters.caption: 两个力作邻边，等效单力对应对角线。
chapters.captionEn: The pair forms adjacent sides; the single force matches the diagonal.

chapters.title: 交换操作研究分解
chapters.caption: 同一合力可由不同方向的一对分力实现。
chapters.captionEn: Different directed pairs can reproduce the same resultant.

chapters.title: 晶体让某些方向增强
chapters.caption: 晶面之间的相位关系，使散射强度随角度出现峰值。
chapters.captionEn: Phase relationships between planes produce angular intensity peaks.

chapters.title: 寻找相长叠加的位置
chapters.caption: 相邻晶面的路程差接近波长的整数倍时，信号增强。
chapters.captionEn: A path difference near an integer number of wavelengths enhances the signal.

chapters.title: 多种晶粒方向形成环
chapters.caption: 提高加速电压，电子波长缩短，薄膜衍射环收缩。
chapters.captionEn: Higher accelerating voltage shortens electron wavelength and contracts the rings.

chapters.title: 零散事件积累成条纹
chapters.caption: 一次次局域探测，积累后仍呈现干涉概率分布。
chapters.captionEn: Localized detections accumulate into an interference probability distribution.

chapters.title: 用晶体检验X射线
chapters.caption: 多色X射线通过规则晶格，只在满足条件的方向形成斑点。
chapters.captionEn: Polychromatic X-rays form spots in directions allowed by the crystal lattice.

chapters.title: 把斑点背后的相位展开
chapters.caption: 相邻晶面的路程差为2d sinθ；相位相合才持续增强。
chapters.captionEn: Adjacent-plane path difference is 2d sinθ; matching phases reinforce the signal.

chapters.title: 转动晶体，追踪斑点
chapters.titleEn: Rotate the crystal and track spots
chapters.caption: 晶格方向改变后，能满足衍射条件的波长和方向也改变。
chapters.captionEn: Crystal rotation changes which wavelengths and directions satisfy diffraction.

chapters.title: 磁场控制接触
chapters.titleEn: A magnetic field closes the contact
chapters.caption: 磁体靠近，软磁簧片相吸接通。
chapters.captionEn: A nearby magnet magnetizes the reeds and closes them.

chapters.title: 光敏电阻的明暗对照
chapters.caption: 遮光使电阻增大，强光使电阻减小。
chapters.captionEn: Shade raises resistance; stronger light lowers it.

chapters.title: 换成普通电阻
chapters.caption: 相同照度变化，不应让所有电阻都同样响应。
chapters.captionEn: The same illumination change need not affect every resistor.

chapters.title: 手温与冷水
chapters.caption: 这种NTC升温时降阻，降温时增阻。
chapters.captionEn: This NTC decreases resistance when warmed.

chapters.title: 水浴建立特性曲线
chapters.caption: 温度和电阻同时记录，建立对应关系。
chapters.captionEn: Record temperature and resistance together.

chapters.title: 开门改变继电器输出
chapters.titleEn: Opening the door changes relay output
chapters.caption: 干簧管控制线圈，继电器选择指示或报警。
chapters.captionEn: The reed controls the coil; relay contacts select indication or alarm.

chapters.title: 微小信号控制LED
chapters.titleEn: A small signal controls an LED
chapters.caption: 分压与晶体管放大共同决定点亮条件。
chapters.captionEn: Divider loading and transistor gain determine the light threshold.

chapters.title: 用继电器控制灯泡
chapters.titleEn: Use a relay to control a lamp
chapters.caption: 传感回路与执行触点承担不同任务。
chapters.captionEn: The sensing circuit and load contacts serve different roles.

chapters.title: 形变控制加热
chapters.caption: 感温触点接通，可让常闭加热回路断开。
chapters.captionEn: Closing the sensing contact can open the heater path.

chapters.title: 逐级均匀加载
chapters.caption: 框架初始载荷也必须计入总压力。
chapters.captionEn: Include the fixture in the total applied force.

chapters.title: 比较不同工作区间
chapters.caption: 相同力变化，在不同区间产生不同电阻变化。
chapters.captionEn: Equal force changes produce different resistance changes.

chapters.title: 把测量用于分拣
chapters.caption: 压力阈值驱动通道选择。
chapters.captionEn: A pressure threshold selects the sorting path.

chapters.title: 用缓坡把运动变慢
chapters.titleEn: Slow motion with a shallow slope
chapters.caption: 缓坡延长可测时间，流水提供计时参照。
chapters.captionEn: A shallow slope lengthens the measurable time; water gives a reference.

chapters.title: 比较等时间记录
chapters.caption: 时间翻倍，路程变为四倍。
chapters.captionEn: Doubling time produces four times the distance.

chapters.title: 分清滚动与自由落体
chapters.caption: 历史外推需要推理，滚动系数不能直接当作g。
chapters.captionEn: Historical extrapolation needs reasoning; the rolling coefficient is not g.

chapters.title: 在另一坡回到原高度
chapters.caption: 忽略耗散，回升最高点与释放高度相同。
chapters.captionEn: Without losses, the return peak matches the release height.

chapters.title: 把右坡逐次放缓
chapters.caption: 更缓需要更远；水平极限继续匀速。
chapters.captionEn: A gentler slope requires more distance; the horizontal limit continues uniformly.

chapters.title: 后续：寻找守恒量
chapters.caption: 势能与滚动动能此消彼长，总量不变。
chapters.captionEn: Potential and rolling kinetic energy exchange while their total stays fixed.

chapters.title: 遮光纸后的感光板
chapters.caption: 铀盐附近的感光板变暗，说明有能穿过遮光纸的作用。
chapters.captionEn: A plate near uranium darkens despite its opaque wrapping.

chapters.title: 撤去日照，信号仍在
chapters.caption: 没有日照激发，铀盐仍能使感光板留下信号。
chapters.captionEn: Without sunlight, uranium still leaves a photographic signal.

chapters.title: 把看不见的射线变成电流
chapters.caption: 射线使空气电离，微弱电流成为可比较的信号。
chapters.captionEn: Radiation ionizes air, producing a measurable weak current.

chapters.title: 跟随活度寻找成分
chapters.caption: 分离后某些组分的单位质量活度升高，指导后续化学鉴定。
chapters.captionEn: Increased activity per mass in a fraction guides further chemical identification.

chapters.title: 用磁场分开三种射线
chapters.titleEn: Separate radiation in a magnetic field
chapters.caption: α与β⁻向相反方向弯曲，γ保持直行。
chapters.captionEn: Alpha and beta-minus bend oppositely; gamma continues straight.

chapters.title: 反转磁场再检验
chapters.caption: 磁场反向，带电轨迹的弯曲方向互换，γ仍不偏转。
chapters.captionEn: Reversing the field reverses charged curvature but leaves gamma unchanged.

chapters.title: 先让气体膨胀冷却
chapters.caption: 膨胀降温使水汽达到过饱和，电离路径成为凝结线索。
chapters.captionEn: Expansion cooling creates supersaturation, allowing ionization paths to seed droplets.

chapters.title: 看见液滴，追踪粒子
chapters.titleEn: Read droplets as evidence of a path
chapters.caption: 径迹由许多液滴组成，不是放大的实体粒子。
chapters.captionEn: A track consists of droplets, not an enlarged material particle.

chapters.title: 电子在靶上产生X射线
chapters.caption: 高速电子在靶中减速，可产生穿透性X射线。
chapters.captionEn: Fast electrons decelerating in a target can produce penetrating X-rays.

chapters.title: 比较透过与阻挡
chapters.caption: 不同衰减形成影像；提高能量不等于所有细节都更清楚。
chapters.captionEn: Differential attenuation forms an image; higher energy does not guarantee clearer detail.

chapters.title: 同一导体的一条直线
chapters.caption: 温度不变时，U–I 图像的斜率表示电阻。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed temperature, the U–I slope represents resistance.

chapters.title: 只改变长度
chapters.caption: b 的长度加倍，电压与电阻都加倍。
chapters.captionEn: Doubling b’s length doubles its voltage and resistance.

chapters.title: 只改变横截面积
chapters.caption: c 的横截面积加倍，电压与电阻减半。
chapters.captionEn: Doubling c’s cross-sectional area halves voltage and resistance.

chapters.title: 只更换材料
chapters.caption: 长度和面积相同，不同材料仍有不同电阻。
chapters.captionEn: Equal length and area can still give different resistance for different materials.

chapters.title: 只加热另一段灯丝
chapters.caption: 被加热灯丝电阻增大，串联指示灯变暗。
chapters.captionEn: The heated filament’s resistance rises and the series indicator dims.

chapters.title: 测电阻，再测几何
chapters.caption: 由图像斜率、有效长度与平均直径求电阻率。
chapters.captionEn: Infer resistivity from slope, active length and mean diameter.

chapters.title: 电表也改变了测量
chapters.caption: 外接包含电压表电流，内接包含电流表压降。
chapters.captionEn: External placement includes voltmeter current; internal placement includes ammeter drop.

chapters.title: 先看一组核的变化
chapters.caption: 不能预报哪个核先衰变，但可以统计剩余数量。
chapters.captionEn: The next nucleus to decay is unpredictable, but the remaining number can be counted.

chapters.title: 把计数与期望曲线比较
chapters.caption: 每经过同样的半衰期，剩余数量的期望再减半。
chapters.captionEn: Each equal half-life halves the expected remaining population.

chapters.title: 给磷的迁移加上标记
chapters.caption: 放射性磷随磷的化学过程迁移，探测信号显示它到达哪里。
chapters.captionEn: Radioactive phosphorus follows phosphorus chemistry and reveals where it travels.

chapters.title: 迁移之外，还要校正衰变
chapters.caption: 各部位总信号会随衰变减少，不能把减少全当成养分流失。
chapters.captionEn: Total signal decreases through decay as well as movement between compartments.

chapters.title: 停止交换以后，比例下降
chapters.titleEn: After exchange stops, the ratio falls
chapters.caption: 古木与环境停止交换碳后，碳14相对含量逐渐降低。
chapters.captionEn: After a wood sample stops exchanging carbon, its relative carbon-fourteen content decreases.

chapters.title: 加入一点现代碳，再算一次
chapters.caption: 现代碳提高测得的碳14比例，使理想推断年龄偏年轻。
chapters.captionEn: Modern carbon raises the measured carbon-fourteen ratio and biases the inferred age younger.

chapters.title: 从桌面看抽纸
chapters.caption: 纸的位移很大，钢球只有较小真实位移。
chapters.captionEn: The paper travels far while the ball moves only slightly.

chapters.title: 跟随纸张再看
chapters.caption: 同一状态换坐标，钢球相对纸面后退。
chapters.captionEn: The same state in new coordinates moves backward relative to paper.

chapters.title: 去掉摩擦看边界
chapters.titleEn: Remove friction for the ideal comparison
chapters.caption: 无水平力时，桌面系静止，加速纸面系仍有相对变化。
chapters.captionEn: With no horizontal force, the ball rests in the table frame but changes motion relative to accelerating paper.

chapters.title: 慢拉检验接触作用
chapters.titleEn: Test contact with a slow pull
chapters.caption: 抽纸方式和摩擦改变真实运动，换镜头不会。
chapters.captionEn: Pulling conditions and friction change true motion; the camera does not.

chapters.title: 追踪可见的炭粒
chapters.caption: 炭粒运动是分子热运动的间接证据。
chapters.captionEn: Tracer motion indirectly reveals molecular thermal motion.

chapters.title: 同一炭粒与更高温度
chapters.titleEn: The same tracer at higher temperature
chapters.caption: 保持粒径，比较温度对运动的影响。
chapters.captionEn: Keep particle size fixed when comparing temperature.

chapters.title: 分别量取两种液体
chapters.caption: 两只量筒各有50毫升。
chapters.captionEn: Each cylinder begins with 50 millilitres.

chapters.title: 混合后的体积收缩
chapters.caption: 总体积小于直接相加，质量仍然守恒。
chapters.captionEn: Volume is smaller than the sum while mass is conserved.

chapters.title: 先校准每滴体积
chapters.caption: 用总量除以滴数，再乘油酸比例。
chapters.captionEn: Divide total volume by drop count, then apply dilution.

chapters.title: 油膜在水面铺展
chapters.caption: 溶剂处理以后，观察单层膜的稳定边界。
chapters.captionEn: Observe the stabilized monolayer boundary.

chapters.title: 用方格估计面积
chapters.caption: 统一边界计数规则，得到膜面积。
chapters.captionEn: Apply a consistent boundary-cell rule.

chapters.title: 由体积与面积估测尺度
chapters.titleEn: Estimate a scale from volume and area
chapters.caption: 单层近似下，厚度等于体积除以面积。
chapters.captionEn: For a uniform monolayer, thickness is volume divided by area.

chapters.title: 从远处的闪烁发现异常
chapters.titleEn: Notice scintillations beyond the usual range
chapters.caption: α粒子进入氮气后，出现可归因于氢核的长射程信号。
chapters.captionEn: Alpha bombardment of nitrogen produces long-range signals attributable to hydrogen nuclei.

chapters.title: 把产物放进守恒关系
chapters.caption: 氮14与α粒子反应，形成氧17并放出质子。
chapters.captionEn: Nitrogen fourteen captures an alpha particle and emits a proton, leaving oxygen seventeen.

chapters.title: 让看不见的中性辐射撞击石蜡
chapters.titleEn: Use paraffin to reveal neutral radiation
chapters.caption: 铍产生的中性辐射能打出质子，电离信号随之增加。
chapters.captionEn: Neutral radiation from beryllium ejects protons and increases the ionization signal.

chapters.title: 用不同靶核检验质量
chapters.caption: 与质子质量接近的中性粒子，能够有效传递动能。
chapters.captionEn: A neutral particle with mass near the proton’s can transfer substantial kinetic energy.

chapters.title: 先在产物中认出钡
chapters.titleEn: First identify barium among the products
chapters.caption: 中子轰击铀后的化学鉴定，发现远轻于铀的产物。
chapters.captionEn: Chemical analysis after neutron bombardment identifies a product much lighter than uranium.

chapters.title: 核裂变不只有一个通道
chapters.caption: 所选通道的核子数与电荷数守恒，还放出中子。
chapters.captionEn: One selected channel conserves nucleon number and charge while releasing neutrons.

chapters.title: 在重径迹之外寻找轻碎片
chapters.titleEn: Look beyond the two heavy tracks
chapters.caption: 同一顶点伸出的第三条较细径迹，提示额外带电碎片。
chapters.captionEn: A finer third track from the same vertex indicates an additional charged fragment.

chapters.title: 进一步检查四条相关径迹
chapters.caption: 多碎片证据来自相关径迹，而不是把普通分叉任意命名。
chapters.captionEn: Multiple-fragment evidence requires correlated tracks, not arbitrary branching.

chapters.title: 比较相邻两代的规模
chapters.caption: 每代平均引发的下一代事件数，决定规模增长还是减少。
chapters.captionEn: The mean reproduction per generation determines growth or decline.

chapters.title: 让平均规模保持稳定
chapters.caption: 平均再生数接近1时，各代期望规模相近。
chapters.captionEn: Near a reproduction factor of one, successive generations have similar expected size.

chapters.title: 追踪一颗小球
chapters.caption: 每次左右偏转，都改变最后的落槽。
chapters.captionEn: Each left or right choice changes the final bin.

chapters.title: 累计大量小球
chapters.caption: 中央落槽对应更多可能路径。
chapters.captionEn: Central bins can be reached by more paths.

chapters.title: 四枚硬币投十次
chapters.caption: 五种正面数不是等可能的。
chapters.captionEn: The five possible head counts are not equally likely.

chapters.title: 汇集更多实验数据
chapters.caption: 更大样本通常减小比例的波动。
chapters.captionEn: Larger samples usually reduce proportion fluctuations.

chapters.title: 一颗豆子的撞击
chapters.caption: 短时冲量与落下后的重量要分开。
chapters.captionEn: Separate the brief impulse from the later weight.

chapters.title: 连续落下许多豆粒
chapters.caption: 许多离散撞击形成更平稳的平均作用。
chapters.captionEn: Many separate impacts form a smoother average effect.

chapters.title: 只增加释放高度
chapters.caption: 更高落速带来更大的单次动量变化。
chapters.captionEn: Higher arrival speed transfers more momentum per bean.

chapters.title: 电压要并联
chapters.caption: 跨接同一只灯泡的两端，读电压挡。
chapters.captionEn: Probe both lamp terminals and read the voltage scale.

chapters.title: 电流要串联
chapters.caption: 打开一处导线，让该支路电流经过电表。
chapters.captionEn: Open a wire so the branch current passes through the meter.

chapters.title: 右端是零欧姆
chapters.titleEn: Zero ohms is on the right
chapters.caption: 短接表笔，调零；换倍率后要重新检查。
chapters.captionEn: Short and zero the probes; check again after changing the multiplier.

chapters.title: 非均匀的刻度
chapters.caption: 先读欧姆刻度，再乘倍率。
chapters.captionEn: Read the ohm scale, then multiply by the selected factor.

chapters.title: 灯丝也能测电阻
chapters.caption: 测得的是此时的冷态电阻。
chapters.captionEn: This reading is the filament’s present cold resistance.

chapters.title: 接触条件也重要
chapters.caption: 同一个人，接触方式改变，读数也会改变。
chapters.captionEn: Changing hand contact can change the reading for the same person.

chapters.title: 交换表笔，读数变了
chapters.caption: 本模拟式欧姆挡中，黑表笔向外供给正电势。
chapters.captionEn: This modeled analog ohmmeter supplies positive potential at the black probe.

chapters.title: 灯不亮，先检查电源
chapters.caption: 电池两端接近零，与有电压但断路不同。
chapters.captionEn: Near-zero battery voltage differs from a powered open circuit.

chapters.title: 寻找异常电压降
chapters.caption: 开关或导线断路时，其两端可能承担大部分电压。
chapters.captionEn: An open switch or wire can carry most of the circuit voltage.

chapters.title: 有电压，仍可能不发光
chapters.caption: 灯座外侧有电压，不能单凭这一点认定灯丝正常。
chapters.captionEn: Voltage outside the socket does not by itself prove the filament is intact.

chapters.title: 有推力，也能匀速
chapters.titleEn: A push can coexist with constant velocity
chapters.caption: 合力为零，速度不变。
chapters.captionEn: Zero net force preserves velocity.

chapters.title: 看速度怎样改变
chapters.caption: 看同一秒内速度增加多少。
chapters.captionEn: Compare velocity gained in one second.

chapters.title: 同质量，合力翻倍
chapters.titleEn: Same mass, twice the net force
chapters.caption: 同质量：合力翻倍，加速度翻倍。
chapters.captionEn: Same mass: twice the force, twice the acceleration.

chapters.title: 同合力，质量翻倍
chapters.titleEn: Same net force, twice the mass
chapters.caption: 同合力：质量翻倍，加速度减半。
chapters.captionEn: Same force: twice the mass, half the acceleration.

chapters.title: 撤力不等于停止
chapters.caption: 撤力仍匀速；反向合力使车减速。
chapters.captionEn: Release preserves velocity. Braking changes it.

chapters.title: 槽码也需要加速度
chapters.caption: 槽码向下加速，mg必须大于T。
chapters.captionEn: The falling mass needs mg > T to accelerate.

chapters.title: 先重建衰变产物
chapters.caption: 从两个光子的能量和夹角，可以重建候选母粒子的质量。
chapters.captionEn: Two photon energies and their angle reconstruct a candidate parent mass.

chapters.title: 让许多事件形成分布
chapters.titleEn: Build a distribution from many events
chapters.caption: 在背景之上稳定出现的质量峰，需要跨数据和通道检验。
chapters.captionEn: A mass excess above background requires checks across data and channels.

chapters.title: 先看到额外吸收
chapters.caption: 某些高能γ射线的透过信号，比简单基线预期更弱。
chapters.captionEn: Some energetic gamma-ray transmission is weaker than a simple baseline predicts.

chapters.title: 后来用成对产生解释线索
chapters.titleEn: Later interpret the clue through pair creation
chapters.caption: 超过能量阈值后，光子可在核场中产生电子与正电子。
chapters.captionEn: Above threshold, a photon can create an electron–positron pair in a nuclear field.

chapters.title: K俘获后，核为什么反冲
chapters.titleEn: Why does the nucleus recoil after electron capture?
chapters.caption: 捕获内层电子后，发出的中微子带走动量，子核反向运动。
chapters.captionEn: After inner-electron capture, a neutrino carries momentum and the daughter recoils.

chapters.title: 用阻挡电势读出反冲尺度
chapters.titleEn: Probe recoil with a retarding potential
chapters.caption: 反冲离子能否越过电势门槛，提供动能的信息。
chapters.captionEn: Whether recoil ions cross a retarding barrier constrains their kinetic energy.

chapters.title: 从产生点追踪带电轨迹
chapters.titleEn: Follow a charged track from its production vertex
chapters.caption: 产生点与后续衰变点之间的轨迹，是事件分析的第一段。
chapters.captionEn: A track from production to decay is one part of the event evidence.

chapters.title: 把衰变和湮灭联系起来
chapters.titleEn: Link decay to an annihilation vertex
chapters.caption: 带电π介子与不可见反中子的后续信号，共同约束解释。
chapters.captionEn: A charged pion and subsequent antineutron evidence jointly constrain the interpretation.

chapters.title: 先建立核自旋方向
chapters.caption: 低温极化后，沿自旋与反自旋方向的β计数不再相同。
chapters.captionEn: After polarization, beta counts along and opposite nuclear spin differ.

chapters.title: 比较整个过程的空间反演
chapters.caption: 空间反演改变电子动量方向，自旋方向保持不变。
chapters.captionEn: Spatial inversion reverses electron momentum while leaving spin unchanged.

chapters.title: 从固定靶中的电子对重建质量
chapters.titleEn: Reconstruct pairs from a fixed target
chapters.caption: 丁肇中团队从电子与正电子对的质量分布发现窄峰。
chapters.captionEn: Ting’s team found a narrow peak in electron–positron pair mass.

chapters.title: 在对撞机中扫描能量
chapters.titleEn: Scan collision energy in a collider
chapters.caption: 里克特团队通过对撞能量附近的产额增强，得到互补证据。
chapters.captionEn: Richter’s team found a strong production enhancement during a collision-energy scan.

chapters.title: 先让金属与沸水平衡
chapters.caption: 沸水充分加热后，金属的初温才可取100摄氏度。
chapters.captionEn: After equilibration, metal starts at 100 °C.

chapters.title: 转入量热杯
chapters.caption: 热量从金属传向水和杯，两个温度逐渐靠近。
chapters.captionEn: Energy passes from metal to water and cup until temperatures agree.

chapters.title: 量热杯也吸收能量
chapters.caption: 同样的金属和水，杯的热容会改变平衡温度。
chapters.captionEn: Cup heat capacity changes the final temperature.

chapters.title: 缓慢改变封闭气体体积
chapters.caption: 温度近似不变时，总体积减小，绝对压强增大。
chapters.captionEn: At constant temperature, reducing total volume raises absolute pressure.

chapters.title: 用体积倒数检验
chapters.caption: 同一批状态在p与1/V图上排成直线。
chapters.captionEn: The same states form a straight line when plotting p against 1/V.

chapters.title: 快速压缩会升温
chapters.caption: 绝热近似下，压强比等温预测更高。
chapters.captionEn: An adiabatic compression gives higher pressure than the isothermal prediction.

chapters.title: 水柱封住一定量气体
chapters.titleEn: A plug seals a fixed gas amount
chapters.caption: 水柱可移动，让内外压强近似平衡。
chapters.captionEn: The movable plug keeps inside and outside pressure nearly balanced.

chapters.title: 手捂烧瓶
chapters.caption: 气体升温膨胀，水柱向外移动。
chapters.captionEn: Warming expands the gas and moves the plug outward.

chapters.title: 冷却回到原状态
chapters.caption: 温度降低，体积缩小，水柱回移。
chapters.captionEn: Cooling contracts the gas and returns the plug.

chapters.title: 失重仍有惯性
chapters.caption: 不依赖重力读数，改测已知力引起的加速度。
chapters.captionEn: Replace a weight reading with acceleration under a known force.

chapters.title: 恒力牵引支架
chapters.titleEn: Pull the support with constant force
chapters.caption: 从静止释放，同一根绳带动平台和人体。
chapters.captionEn: Released from rest, one cable accelerates the platform and person.

chapters.title: 把位置转成加速度
chapters.caption: 同样的距离，越来越短的时间，形成上升的速度记录。
chapters.captionEn: Equal distances in shorter times produce rising velocity readings.

chapters.title: 从整体质量到人体质量
chapters.titleEn: From total moving mass to body mass
chapters.caption: 先算F/a，再扣除平台；同样的力，较大质量加速较小。
chapters.captionEn: Compute F/a and subtract the platform; greater mass accelerates less.

chapters.title: 比较食盐与松香
chapters.caption: 盐粒常有平直晶面，松香碎片外形不规则。
chapters.captionEn: Salt grains show crystal faces; rosin fragments are irregular.

chapters.title: 把结构与外形区分
chapters.caption: 晶体内部有周期排列；示意粒子不是显微镜可见的原子。
chapters.captionEn: Crystalline order is periodic; these particles are schematic.

chapters.title: 用熔化边界显出热传播
chapters.titleEn: Reveal heat flow with melting wax
chapters.caption: 同样从一点加热，玻璃与云母出现不同的熔化区域。
chapters.captionEn: Point heating produces different melting regions on glass and mica.

chapters.title: 同一温度，不同方向
chapters.caption: 圆形对应面内各向同性，椭圆反映面内各向异性。
chapters.captionEn: A circle indicates in-plane isotropy; an ellipse reveals anisotropy.

chapters.title: 胶带带走更薄的片层
chapters.caption: 层间分离，可以保留片层内部的碳原子网络。
chapters.captionEn: Separating layers can preserve each sheet’s carbon network.

chapters.title: 留下单层蜂窝网络
chapters.caption: 单层石墨烯保留二维蜂窝排列。
chapters.captionEn: A graphene monolayer retains a two-dimensional honeycomb network.

chapters.title: 多接灯泡，反而变暗
chapters.caption: 相同电源增加并联负载，路端电压降低。
chapters.captionEn: Adding parallel loads to the same source lowers terminal voltage.

chapters.title: 比较理想电源
chapters.caption: 只有内阻参与，才能解释这里的电压下降。
chapters.captionEn: Internal resistance explains this terminal-voltage decrease.

chapters.title: 改变负载，记录点
chapters.caption: 每次同时记录 U 和 I。
chapters.captionEn: Record U and I together at each load.

chapters.title: 从直线求参数
chapters.caption: U = E − Ir；截距是 E，斜率是 −r。
chapters.captionEn: U = E − Ir: intercept E, slope −r.

chapters.title: 铜锌插入梨
chapters.titleEn: Copper and zinc in a pear
chapters.caption: 水果电池是电源，几何改变也会影响内阻。
chapters.captionEn: The fruit cell is a source whose geometry affects internal resistance.

chapters.title: 用已知电阻推电流
chapters.titleEn: Infer current from a known load
chapters.caption: 电阻箱 R 和电压 U，给出 I = U/R。
chapters.captionEn: Known box resistance R and voltage U give I = U/R.

chapters.title: 另一条测量路径
chapters.caption: U = IR；拟合斜率还包含微安表内阻。
chapters.captionEn: U = IR; the fitted slope also includes microammeter resistance.

chapters.title: 先测充电宝输出端
chapters.caption: 教材样例的输出曲线在所测范围内近似直线。
chapters.captionEn: The textbook output curve is nearly linear over its measured range.

chapters.title: 电量变化，输出不同
chapters.caption: 比较教材同一研究中的六种电量。
chapters.captionEn: Compare six charge states from the same textbook study.

chapters.title: 直线有适用范围
chapters.titleEn: A line has a valid range
chapters.caption: 限流后的示意曲线不能继续用同一条直线描述。
chapters.captionEn: The illustrative current-limited curve no longer follows that line.

chapters.title: 水滴仍受重力
chapters.caption: 没有向上支持力，水滴会落下。
chapters.captionEn: Without an upward supporting force, the drop falls.

chapters.title: 强场本身还不够
chapters.caption: 理想均匀磁场没有产生所需的净平移磁力。
chapters.captionEn: An ideal uniform field supplies no net translational lift here.

chapters.title: 非均匀强磁场提供升力
chapters.caption: 抗磁物体趋向较弱场区，升力可以平衡重力。
chapters.captionEn: Diamagnetic material moves toward weaker field and can balance gravity.

chapters.title: 偏离后能否回来
chapters.caption: 稳定位置附近，偏离会产生恢复作用。
chapters.captionEn: Near a stable position, displacement produces a restoring response.

chapters.title: 从水滴到科学史中的青蛙
chapters.titleEn: From water to the historical frog
chapters.caption: 生物组织的抗磁性让强场悬浮成为可能。
chapters.captionEn: Diamagnetism of biological tissue allows strong-field levitation.

chapters.title: 下蹲时先轻后重
chapters.caption: 两段都向下，支持力却一小一大。
chapters.captionEn: Both stages move down, but support force first falls and then rises.

chapters.title: 力平台记录蹲起
chapters.titleEn: Record the full squat and rise
chapters.caption: 仪器记录支持力；质量与重力未改变。
chapters.captionEn: The instrument records support force; mass and gravity do not change.

chapters.title: 电梯上升的三个阶段
chapters.titleEn: Three stages of an upward journey
chapters.caption: 上升启动偏重，匀速恢复，上升制动偏轻。
chapters.captionEn: Heavier at upward start, normal at cruise, lighter while braking.

chapters.title: 换成下降再检验
chapters.caption: 下降减速时，加速度向上，仍然超重。
chapters.captionEn: A descending lift is heavier while braking upward.

chapters.title: 静止水瓶为什么漏水
chapters.caption: 水面通气，孔口处的压差驱动水流。
chapters.captionEn: A vented surface permits a pressure difference that drives the jet.

chapters.title: 瓶和水一起自由落下
chapters.titleEn: Let bottle and water fall together
chapters.caption: 持续压差消失；旧水滴仍按原来的速度和重力运动。
chapters.captionEn: Sustained pressure vanishes; earlier droplets retain their motion under gravity.

chapters.title: 记录不跟着模型走
chapters.titleEn: Records do not follow the model
chapters.caption: 先固定记录，再比较同一时刻的预测。
chapters.captionEn: Fix the records, then compare predictions.

chapters.title: 把新记录留到最后
chapters.titleEn: Save new records for the test
chapters.caption: 参数先锁定，余下记录后揭晓。
chapters.captionEn: Lock the parameters before revealing unused records.

chapters.title: 让望远镜延伸视线
chapters.caption: 凸物镜与凹目镜把远方光束送入眼睛。
chapters.captionEn: A positive objective and negative eyepiece deliver distant light to the eye.

chapters.title: 连续记录光点换位
chapters.caption: 反复围绕木星换位的光点，支持卫星解释。
chapters.captionEn: Points repeatedly changing position around Jupiter support the moon interpretation.

chapters.title: 偏差能由额外引力解释吗？
chapters.titleEn: Can extra gravity explain the discrepancy?
chapters.caption: 候选要解释固定偏差，还要预测新记录。
chapters.captionEn: Explain fixed discrepancies, then predict new records.

chapters.title: 让下一晚检验新光点
chapters.titleEn: Let the next night test the new point
chapters.caption: 真实记录独立于模型，下一夜检验是否移动。
chapters.captionEn: Independent records test whether the new point moves.

chapters.title: 把多次彗星记录联系起来
chapters.titleEn: Connect records of a returning comet
chapters.caption: 相似轨道使多次出现可以被解释为同一天体。
chapters.captionEn: Similar orbital records can connect separate appearances to one body.

chapters.title: 用未来回归检验判断
chapters.titleEn: Test the judgment with a future return
chapters.caption: 预测的回归到来，才为判断增加新的证据。
chapters.captionEn: A later observed return adds new evidence for the prediction.

chapters.title: 先建立实验参照
chapters.caption: 摩擦电可以储存，也能使带电指示器响应。
chapters.captionEn: Frictional electricity can be stored and produce an indicator response.

chapters.title: 比较历史报告
chapters.caption: 云中来源也能用于储存与同类电学实验。
chapters.captionEn: The reported cloud source also supported storage and similar electrical effects.

chapters.title: 相同性质，不等于相同数值
chapters.caption: 正负两种电荷都可能使指示器张开。
chapters.captionEn: Either charge sign can open an indicator.

chapters.title: 断开来源后仍能释放
chapters.caption: 接入释放支路，两路储存电荷都逐渐减少。
chapters.captionEn: Connect release paths and both stored charges decrease.

chapters.title: 把地面引力延伸到月球
chapters.titleEn: Extend Earth’s gravity to the Moon
chapters.caption: 距离约增为60倍，加速度约减为3600分之一。
chapters.captionEn: At about sixty Earth radii, acceleration is about one thirty-six-hundredth.

chapters.title: 用轨道数据独立核对
chapters.caption: 由周期和半径算出的向心加速度，与预测接近。
chapters.captionEn: Centripetal acceleration from radius and period agrees approximately with the prediction.

chapters.title: 用细丝承接微弱力矩
chapters.titleEn: Let a fine fibre respond to weak torque
chapters.caption: 大球的引力使小球转动，细丝提供反向恢复力矩。
chapters.captionEn: Attractor masses turn the small masses while the fibre supplies restoring torque.

chapters.title: 换位后，转向也改变
chapters.titleEn: Swap the attractors and reverse the deflection
chapters.caption: 对称换位让引力力矩反向，可帮助区分信号与固定偏差。
chapters.captionEn: A symmetric swap reverses gravitational torque and helps distinguish fixed offsets.

chapters.title: 先看较慢的水平发射
chapters.titleEn: Begin with a slower horizontal launch
chapters.caption: 引力不断改变速度方向，轨迹最终与地表相交。
chapters.captionEn: Gravity continually turns velocity until the trajectory meets the surface.

chapters.title: 提高横向速度，落下却绕过地球
chapters.titleEn: Increase tangential speed and keep falling around Earth
chapters.caption: 轨道运动仍是自由落体，引力没有消失。
chapters.captionEn: Orbital motion remains free fall; gravity has not disappeared.

chapters.title: 同时发射两种信号
chapters.caption: 红外提供起点，超声提供可测的延迟。
chapters.captionEn: Infrared supplies the reference; ultrasound supplies a measurable delay.

chapters.title: 一次单程测距
chapters.caption: x约等于声速乘时差，不需要除以二。
chapters.captionEn: Range is approximately sound speed times delay, without a factor of two.

chapters.title: 连续位置生成速度
chapters.caption: 0.02秒一次测距，位移除以对应时间。
chapters.captionEn: Sample every 0.02 seconds and divide displacement by the matching interval.

chapters.title: 改为发射与接收同一探头
chapters.titleEn: Use one transducer for the round trip
chapters.caption: 超声碰到反射面后返回，路程约为两倍距离。
chapters.captionEn: Ultrasound reflects from the target and returns along a two-way path.

chapters.title: 先算出可以被检验的预期
chapters.caption: 假设有以太风，转动等臂干涉仪应改变两束光的相位差。
chapters.captionEn: An ether wind would change the phase difference when an equal-arm interferometer rotates.

chapters.title: 把预期与实验结果比较
chapters.titleEn: Compare the expectation with the result
chapters.caption: 预期的条纹移动没有出现，简单的以太风解释受到挑战。
chapters.captionEn: The predicted fringe shift was absent, challenging the simple ether-wind explanation.

chapters.title: 先区分发出和接收
chapters.caption: 地面同时发出的光，先后到达向右运动的乘客。
chapters.captionEn: Light emitted simultaneously on the ground reaches the right-moving passenger at different times.

chapters.title: 变换同一对发光事件
chapters.titleEn: Transform the same two emission events
chapters.caption: 洛伦兹变换后，两次发光在车厢系中的时间不同。
chapters.captionEn: The Lorentz transformation assigns different train-frame times to the emissions.

chapters.title: 用固有寿命预测计数
chapters.caption: 高速μ子经历的固有时间较短，存活到地面的比例更大。
chapters.captionEn: Fast muons experience less proper time, increasing survival to the ground.

chapters.title: 从μ子参考系得到相同结论
chapters.titleEn: Reach the same conclusion in the muon frame
chapters.caption: 地面系的时间膨胀，与μ子系的距离收缩相互一致。
chapters.captionEn: Time dilation in the ground frame agrees with distance contraction in the muon frame.

chapters.title: 向东飞行：合并两项贡献
chapters.caption: 运动让飞行钟相对变慢，较高引力势让它相对变快。
chapters.captionEn: Motion slows the flying clock relative to the ground, while higher potential speeds it up.

chapters.title: 向西飞行：地球自转改变比较
chapters.titleEn: Westbound flight: Earth’s rotation changes the comparison
chapters.caption: 向西飞行的运动项可以反向，不能只说“飞机上的钟更慢”。
chapters.captionEn: Westbound motion can reverse the kinematic contribution; flying clocks are not simply always slower.

chapters.title: 沉入曲别针，水面隆起
chapters.caption: 曲别针排开的水形成杯口上方的微小隆起。
chapters.captionEn: Water displaced by submerged clips raises the surface above the brim.

chapters.title: 表面张力也有极限
chapters.caption: 边缘不能继续固定液面时，更多水会溢出。
chapters.captionEn: When edge pinning fails, additional displaced water spills.

chapters.title: 完整薄膜中的松弛棉线
chapters.titleEn: A slack thread in intact film
chapters.caption: 两侧都有薄膜时，牵拉可以相互平衡。
chapters.captionEn: With film on both sides, the pulls can balance.

chapters.title: 刺破棉线一侧薄膜
chapters.caption: 剩余薄膜把固定长度的棉线拉成弧线。
chapters.captionEn: The remaining film pulls the fixed-length thread into an arc.

chapters.title: 换成闭合棉线圈
chapters.caption: 线圈内外都有薄膜时，形状可以不规则。
chapters.captionEn: With film both inside and outside, the loop can remain irregular.

chapters.title: 刺破圈内薄膜
chapters.titleEn: Puncture the film inside the loop
chapters.caption: 同样长度的线圈张成圆形，外侧膜面积减少。
chapters.captionEn: A fixed-length loop becomes circular and reduces outer film area.

chapters.title: 洁净玻璃上的水滴
chapters.caption: 水滴摊开时，体积保持相同。
chapters.captionEn: The drop spreads while keeping its volume.

chapters.title: 涂蜡表面的同体积水滴
chapters.caption: 较大接触角对应更收拢的水滴。
chapters.captionEn: A larger contact angle gives a more compact drop.

chapters.title: 用纸托住缝衣针
chapters.caption: 纸湿后下沉，针仍可由界面支持。
chapters.captionEn: The tissue sinks after wetting, while the interface can support the needle.

chapters.title: 把针完全按入水下
chapters.caption: 界面支持消失后，针的浮力不足以平衡重力。
chapters.captionEn: After interface support disappears, buoyancy cannot balance its weight.

chapters.title: 把热气体封在碗内
chapters.caption: 刚合拢时，内部压强近似等于大气压。
chapters.captionEn: At sealing, inside pressure is approximately atmospheric.

chapters.title: 外部浇水冷却
chapters.caption: 温度降低，内部压强下降，外界空气压紧钢碗。
chapters.captionEn: Cooling lowers internal pressure and outside air presses the bowls together.

chapters.title: 逐渐增加两侧拉力
chapters.caption: 比较每侧拉力与压强差乘碗口面积。
chapters.captionEn: Compare each side’s pull with pressure difference times opening area.

chapters.title: 空气进入后容易分开
chapters.titleEn: Air entry removes the holding force
chapters.caption: 内外压强恢复相同，压强差支持消失。
chapters.captionEn: Equalized pressure removes the pressure-difference holding force.

chapters.title: 同一气球控制条件
chapters.caption: 体积和形状尽量不变，铁丝让重物便于读数。
chapters.captionEn: Keep volume and shape fixed; wire makes the load easier to track.

chapters.title: 先找等间距帧
chapters.caption: 相邻帧时间相同，位移相近才支持匀速判断。
chapters.captionEn: Equal frame times and nearly equal displacements support steady motion.

chapters.title: 改变负载重复记录
chapters.caption: 七组总重力与每帧位移，来自教材原表。
chapters.captionEn: Seven weights and frame displacements come from the textbook table.

chapters.title: 让数据选择关系
chapters.titleEn: Let the measurements choose a relation
chapters.caption: 本组数据的过原点线性拟合明显优于平方拟合。
chapters.captionEn: An origin-constrained linear fit describes this dataset much better than a quadratic fit.

chapters.title: 检验遗漏的条件
chapters.caption: 匀速、浮力、气球姿态与速度范围共同限制结论。
chapters.captionEn: Steady motion, buoyancy, posture and speed range limit the inference.

chapters.title: 用共振放大微弱响应
chapters.titleEn: Amplify a weak response with resonance
chapters.caption: 驱动频率接近共振频率时，金属棒的机械响应增强。
chapters.captionEn: A bar responds more strongly near its resonant frequency.

chapters.title: 共同出现，还要独立复核
chapters.caption: 早期韦伯棒的探测宣称，没有获得独立实验确认。
chapters.captionEn: Independent experiments did not confirm Weber’s early detection claims.

chapters.title: 把脉冲星当作计时信号
chapters.titleEn: Use a pulsar as a timing signal
chapters.caption: 轨道运动改变脉冲到达间隔，连续计时约束双星轨道。
chapters.captionEn: Orbital motion changes pulse arrival intervals, allowing repeated timing to constrain the orbit.

chapters.title: 看多年累积的轨道变化
chapters.titleEn: Track orbital change accumulated over years
chapters.caption: 引力辐射带走能量，轨道周期逐渐缩短。
chapters.captionEn: Gravitational radiation removes energy and gradually shortens the orbital period.

chapters.title: 比较两条垂直光臂
chapters.caption: 引力波使两臂长度反向变化，光的相位差随之改变。
chapters.captionEn: Opposite arm-length changes produce a change in optical phase difference.

chapters.title: 在两站比较啁啾和时延
chapters.titleEn: Compare chirps and delays at two sites
chapters.caption: 频率和振幅共同上升的信号，在两站之间存在传播时延。
chapters.captionEn: A signal with rising frequency and amplitude reaches separated sites with a delay.

chapters.title: 先看无遮罩的响应
chapters.caption: 带电球靠近，验电器内部电荷重新分布。
chapters.captionEn: As the sphere approaches, charge redistributes within the detector.

chapters.title: 罩上金属网
chapters.caption: 表面电荷重排，使内部的外加场被抵消。
chapters.captionEn: Redistributed surface charge cancels the applied field inside.

chapters.title: 形状相同还不够
chapters.caption: 绝缘网缺少自由电荷重排，不能提供同样的屏蔽。
chapters.captionEn: An insulating mesh cannot provide the same free-charge redistribution.

chapters.title: 烟先进入瓶内
chapters.caption: 未起电时，烟粒随空气运动。
chapters.captionEn: Before energizing, smoke follows the air.

chapters.title: 荷电后向收集片迁移
chapters.titleEn: Charge and migrate to the collector
chapters.caption: 负烟粒受力方向与电场方向相反。
chapters.captionEn: Negative particles move opposite the field direction.

chapters.title: 停止起电后再看
chapters.caption: 新烟仍进入，先前收集的烟粒仍留在片上。
chapters.captionEn: New smoke continues entering while earlier particles remain collected.

chapters.title: 先辨认同一组谱线
chapters.titleEn: Identify the same pattern of spectral lines
chapters.caption: 整组谱线按相同比例移向长波，给出红移量。
chapters.captionEn: A common wavelength scaling across spectral lines gives the redshift.

chapters.title: 把红移与独立距离比较
chapters.caption: 近距离范围内，退行速度与距离近似成正比。
chapters.captionEn: At low redshift, recession speed is approximately proportional to distance.

chapters.title: 先识别天线接收的不同分量
chapters.titleEn: Identify contributions to an antenna reading
chapters.caption: 接收机、大气和天空共同构成原始信号。
chapters.captionEn: Receiver noise, atmosphere and sky all contribute to the raw signal.

chapters.title: 逐项校准，解释剩余信号
chapters.titleEn: Calibrate contributions and interpret the remainder
chapters.caption: 扣除已知背景后，几乎各向同性的天空分量仍在。
chapters.captionEn: After known backgrounds are removed, a nearly isotropic sky component remains.

chapters.title: 在近乎均匀的背景中寻找微小温差
chapters.titleEn: Find tiny differences in an almost uniform background
chapters.caption: 全天图的颜色放大的是微开尔文级温差。
chapters.captionEn: Full-sky colors magnify temperature differences measured in microkelvin.

chapters.title: 从弧形轨道滚出
chapters.titleEn: Roll out of a curved track
chapters.caption: 出口后的印迹沿该点切线，而不是沿半径。
chapters.captionEn: The trace beyond the exit follows the tangent, not the radius.

chapters.title: 拆去一段再比较
chapters.caption: 新出口的位置改变，切线方向随之改变。
chapters.captionEn: A new exit location has a new tangent direction.

chapters.title: 磁铁放在正前方
chapters.caption: 力与速度共线，速度大小改变，路径仍直。
chapters.captionEn: Collinear force changes speed while the path remains straight.

chapters.title: 把磁铁移到旁边
chapters.titleEn: Move the magnet to the side
chapters.caption: 力有垂直于速度的分量，速度方向改变。
chapters.captionEn: A component perpendicular to velocity changes its direction.

chapters.title: 用尾翼显示方向
chapters.titleEn: Use a tail to reveal direction
chapters.caption: 飞镖上升与下降时，杆轴都近似沿轨迹切线。
chapters.captionEn: During ascent and descent, the shaft approximately follows the trajectory tangent.

chapters.title: 改变投射角再观察
chapters.titleEn: Change launch angle and observe again
chapters.caption: 轨迹改变，瞬时速度沿切线这一点不变。
chapters.captionEn: The trajectory changes; the tangent-velocity relationship does not.

chapters.title: 快速压缩气体
chapters.caption: 来不及向外传热，外界做功使气体升温。
chapters.captionEn: With little time for heat loss, work raises gas temperature.

chapters.title: 同样压缩，改变传热条件
chapters.titleEn: Compress with time for heat exchange
chapters.caption: 缓慢等温近似中，做功的能量传给环境。
chapters.captionEn: In the slow isothermal limit, work is transferred to the surroundings as heat.

chapters.title: 重物下降带动叶片
chapters.caption: 重力势能经搅拌转为水与容器的内能。
chapters.captionEn: Potential energy becomes internal energy through stirring.

chapters.title: 换质量和高度，保持功相同
chapters.titleEn: Change mass and height, retain equal work
chapters.caption: 质量减半、落高加倍，最终温升相同。
chapters.captionEn: Half the mass and twice the drop give the same final rise.

chapters.title: 把机械功先转为电功
chapters.titleEn: Convert mechanical work into electrical work
chapters.caption: 重物驱动发电机，闭合电路中的电阻丝加热水。
chapters.captionEn: The weight drives a generator and the closed heater circuit warms water.

chapters.title: 电流与时间可以不同
chapters.caption: 较小电流持续更久，也能传入相同电能。
chapters.captionEn: A smaller current for longer can deliver equal electrical energy.

chapters.title: 先准备湿润的压缩空气
chapters.caption: 少量水提供水汽，瓶中压强升高。
chapters.captionEn: A little water supplies vapor while pressure rises.

chapters.title: 塞子跳出，瓶内起雾
chapters.titleEn: The stopper leaves and fog forms
chapters.caption: 快速降压使剩余气体降温，水汽可凝结成小滴。
chapters.captionEn: Rapid blowdown cools the remaining gas and can condense vapor.

chapters.title: 炮筒加工持续生热
chapters.caption: 接触处摩擦把外界机械功转为内能。
chapters.captionEn: Contact friction converts supplied mechanical work into internal energy.

chapters.title: 刀具变钝，仍然生热
chapters.titleEn: A blunt tool still produces heat
chapters.caption: 热量不只来自切下的碎屑，持续做功能持续供能。
chapters.captionEn: Heating is not limited to removed chips; continued work supplies energy.

chapters.title: 先观察竖直上升
chapters.caption: 倒置后先加速，再进入近似匀速阶段。
chapters.captionEn: After inversion the float accelerates, then approaches steady rise.

chapters.title: 边上升边匀速移管
chapters.titleEn: Translate the tube while the wax rises
chapters.caption: 横向与竖直方向使用同一个时间。
chapters.captionEn: Horizontal and vertical components share the same elapsed time.

chapters.title: 合成位移和速度
chapters.caption: 合速度是矢量相加，方向由分速度之比决定。
chapters.captionEn: Velocity adds as vectors; their ratio sets its direction.

chapters.title: 改成横向匀加速
chapters.caption: 竖直等间隔，水平间隔越来越大。
chapters.captionEn: Vertical spacing stays equal while horizontal spacing grows.

chapters.title: 导线使磁针偏转
chapters.caption: 通电前指南北，通电后跟随合场。
chapters.captionEn: Before current it points north–south; afterward it follows the combined field.

chapters.title: 断电，再反向通电
chapters.caption: 电流方向反转，磁针向另一侧偏转。
chapters.captionEn: Reversing current deflects the needle to the other side.

chapters.title: 条形磁体上的铁屑
chapters.caption: 排列给出轴线，小磁针给出有向信息。
chapters.captionEn: Filings give local axes; a compass supplies directional information.

chapters.title: 蹄形磁体的间隙
chapters.caption: 把两极靠近，观察间隙中的场。
chapters.captionEn: Bring the poles near each other and inspect their gap.

chapters.title: 直导线周围的环绕
chapters.caption: 反向电流使方向反转，环绕形状保留。
chapters.captionEn: Current reversal reverses direction while preserving the circular pattern.

chapters.title: 环形电流的轴线
chapters.titleEn: The axis of a current loop
chapters.caption: 观察切面经过线圈轴线，电流方向决定轴向磁场。
chapters.captionEn: The section contains the loop axis; current determines the axial field.

chapters.title: 多匝电流的叠加
chapters.caption: 多匝线圈的场叠加，外部形态类似条形磁体。
chapters.captionEn: Several turns superpose into an external pattern resembling a bar magnet.

chapters.title: 描边界，确定入射光线
chapters.titleEn: Trace the faces and incident ray
chapters.caption: 两个针的位置确定入射方向，玻璃边界确定入射点。
chapters.captionEn: Two pins set the incident direction and the block face sets the entry point.

chapters.title: 让第三根针遮住前面的针像
chapters.titleEn: Align the third pin with the earlier images
chapters.caption: C针偏离时，眼端视图中不能完全重合。
chapters.captionEn: An offset pin C fails to overlap the earlier images in the eye view.

chapters.title: 连接两个界面上的交点
chapters.titleEn: Connect the intersections on both faces
chapters.caption: 砖内光线由入射点与出射点连接，再测角求折射率。
chapters.captionEn: Connect the entry and exit points, then measure angles to infer index.

chapters.title: 沿圆柱杯的曲面追踪光线
chapters.titleEn: Trace rays through curved cup interfaces
chapters.caption: 水、玻璃与空气的两个弯曲界面共同改变出射方向。
chapters.captionEn: Curved water–glass and glass–air interfaces jointly change the outgoing direction.

chapters.title: 移动筷子，看侧移与宽度一起变化
chapters.titleEn: Move the chopstick and compare shift with width
chapters.caption: 筷子两侧边缘分别成像，得到侧移和局部放大。
chapters.captionEn: Images of both edges determine displacement and local magnification.

chapters.title: 反向延长出射光，找到浅一些的像
chapters.titleEn: Extend outgoing rays backward to find a shallower image
chapters.caption: 透过玻璃看到的字，似乎比真实位置更靠近上表面。
chapters.captionEn: Text seen through glass appears closer to the upper surface.

chapters.title: 把近轴公式与较大角度比较
chapters.titleEn: Compare the paraxial formula with larger angles
chapters.caption: 接近正视时，像深约为厚度除以折射率。
chapters.captionEn: Near normal viewing, apparent depth is approximately thickness divided by index.

chapters.title: 干头为什么不动
chapters.caption: 头身温度相同，没有驱动液柱的压强差。
chapters.captionEn: At equal head and body temperatures, no pressure difference lifts the liquid.

chapters.title: 湿头蒸发带走热量
chapters.caption: 头部外面的水蒸发，内部蒸气压下降。
chapters.captionEn: External water evaporates; the head’s internal vapour pressure falls.

chapters.title: 压强差抬升液体
chapters.caption: 身体内较高的蒸气压推动液体上升。
chapters.captionEn: Higher vapour pressure in the body pushes liquid up the neck.

chapters.title: 质量上移后倾倒
chapters.titleEn: The raised mass tips the bird
chapters.caption: 液体分布改变重力矩，鸟喙接触清水。
chapters.captionEn: The new mass distribution changes gravitational torque and tips the beak into water.

chapters.title: 管口露出后复位
chapters.titleEn: An exposed tube resets the cycle
chapters.caption: 管口离开液面，两端连通，液体回落。
chapters.captionEn: The tube opening emerges, pressure equalizes and the liquid drains.

chapters.title: 环境维持的循环
chapters.titleEn: A cycle powered by the environment
chapters.caption: 持续蒸发才有循环；它不是永动机。
chapters.captionEn: Continued evaporation sustains the cycle; this is not perpetual motion.

chapters.title: 等时间记录位置
chapters.caption: 水平间距相同，竖直间距逐步增大。
chapters.captionEn: Horizontal gaps are equal; vertical gaps grow.

chapters.title: 比较同时释放的两球
chapters.caption: 同高度、同起始时刻、竖直初速度均为零。
chapters.captionEn: Same height and release instant, with zero initial vertical velocity.

chapters.title: 用复写纸逐点描迹
chapters.caption: 每次从同一位置释放，只调整挡板。
chapters.captionEn: Keep release conditions fixed and adjust only the catcher.

chapters.title: 用两次测距定位
chapters.titleEn: Locate the ball from two ranges
chapters.caption: 红外同步起点，两个超声距离确定位置。
chapters.captionEn: Infrared supplies timing references; two acoustic ranges locate the ball.

chapters.title: 用木板记录落点
chapters.titleEn: Record marks on a catching board
chapters.caption: 移动接球高度，把不同时间的落点留下。
chapters.captionEn: Change the catching height to preserve positions at different flight times.

chapters.title: 换成墙面再测量
chapters.titleEn: Use a wall for the alternative measurement
chapters.caption: 固定纸面方向，改变桌边到墙的距离。
chapters.captionEn: Keep paper on a vertical wall and vary its distance from the table edge.

chapters.title: 检验是否为抛物线
chapters.caption: 非零点的y/x²近似相同，支持y与x²成正比。
chapters.captionEn: A common y/x² at nonzero points supports proportionality to x².

chapters.title: 用一把尺反求初速度
chapters.titleEn: Infer launch speed using a ruler
chapters.caption: 高度决定飞行时间，水平距离给出速度。
chapters.captionEn: Height determines flight time; range then gives speed.

chapters.title: 在清水中滴入颜料
chapters.caption: 颜料起初集中，个体运动没有统一方向。
chapters.captionEn: Dye starts concentrated; individual motion has no common direction.

chapters.title: 均匀并不意味着静止
chapters.caption: 粒子持续运动，统计分布逐渐均匀。
chapters.captionEn: Particles keep moving while their statistical distribution becomes more uniform.

chapters.title: 先用隔板限制气体
chapters.caption: 四个有颜色编号的粒子都在A内，B为空。
chapters.captionEn: Four identified particles occupy A while B is empty.

chapters.title: 撤去隔板后进入另一半
chapters.caption: 粒子进入更大的空间，能量无需凭空增加。
chapters.captionEn: Particles gain access to more space without an extra energy input.

chapters.title: 逐一列出十六种归属
chapters.caption: 每个粒子可在A或B，共有2的4次方种归属。
chapters.captionEn: Each particle may be in A or B, giving two to the fourth assignments.

chapters.title: 少量起伏与宏观概率
chapters.caption: 全部回到A的概率是2的负N次方，随粒子数迅速下降。
chapters.captionEn: The probability that all return to A is two to the minus N.

chapters.title: 只增加电流
chapters.caption: 接点和磁场不变，比较偏转。
chapters.captionEn: Keep contacts and field fixed; compare deflection.

chapters.title: 改变通电长度
chapters.caption: 接点 2–3 与 1–4 使用相同电流。
chapters.captionEn: Both contact pairs carry the same current.

chapters.title: 区分总长与有效长
chapters.caption: 接点间距没变，浸场长度可以减小。
chapters.captionEn: Contact spacing can stay fixed while immersed length decreases.

chapters.title: 比较不同场强
chapters.caption: 相同 Iℓ 下，受力比值给出 B。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed Iℓ, the force ratio gives B.

chapters.title: 先让后轮离地
chapters.caption: 观察同一个传动过程，先区分两种快慢。
chapters.captionEn: Observe one drive and distinguish two meanings of speed.

chapters.title: 跟随同一段链条
chapters.caption: 无滑动传动中，两轮传递同一段链长。
chapters.captionEn: Without slipping, both sprockets transport the same chain length.

chapters.title: 比较同一时间的转角
chapters.titleEn: Compare angles over the same interval
chapters.caption: 齿数之比决定角速度的反比。
chapters.captionEn: Tooth counts set the inverse angular-speed ratio.

chapters.title: 比较同轴的两个点
chapters.titleEn: Compare two points on one wheel
chapters.caption: 同一角速度，半径加倍，线速度加倍。
chapters.captionEn: At a common angular speed, twice the radius means twice the linear speed.

chapters.title: 把两条散热途径分开
chapters.caption: 水的升温是有用部分，热水和火焰还会向环境散热。
chapters.captionEn: Water heating is useful output; hot water and flames also heat the surroundings.

chapters.title: 读取原始冷却记录
chapters.caption: 相同二十分钟，高温段散热约为低温段的六倍。
chapters.captionEn: Over equal twenty-minute intervals, the hotter water loses about six times as much heat.

chapters.title: 同样从26°C加热到50°C
chapters.caption: 相同水量和温升，中火耗气少于大火。
chapters.captionEn: For equal water amounts and temperature rise, medium flame uses less gas in these measurements.

chapters.title: 检验三种烧开策略
chapters.caption: 教材这组条件下，先中火后大火耗气最少。
chapters.captionEn: For this textbook setup, medium then high uses the least gas.

chapters.title: 第一次收集38°C出水
chapters.caption: 记录进水温度、相同水量与燃气表前后读数。
chapters.captionEn: Record inlet temperature, collected water amount and both gas-meter readings.

chapters.title: 第二次收集相同水量
chapters.titleEn: Repeat with the same water amount
chapters.caption: 出水升到50°C时，有用能量也随温升增加。
