chapters.captionEn: At 50°C, the useful energy increases with the temperature rise.

chapters.title: 用实测量计算效率
chapters.caption: 效率等于水吸收的能量除以燃气提供的能量。
chapters.captionEn: Efficiency is useful water heating divided by fuel energy.

chapters.title: 沿半径入射，看平面的分光
chapters.titleEn: Enter radially and watch the flat face
chapters.caption: 反射光增强，透射光逐渐贴近界面。
chapters.captionEn: Reflection grows while transmission approaches the interface.

chapters.title: 越过临界角
chapters.caption: 透射光消失，能量留在反射光中。
chapters.captionEn: Transmission vanishes and the reflected beam retains the power.

chapters.title: 逐次追踪弯棒中的光
chapters.titleEn: Trace successive reflections inside a curved rod
chapters.caption: 每段光路是直线，每次转向发生在边界。
chapters.captionEn: Each segment is straight; direction changes occur at the boundary.

chapters.title: 弯得太急，光会漏出
chapters.titleEn: A tight bend can leak light
chapters.caption: 曲率改变入射角，漏光由同一光路计算。
chapters.captionEn: Curvature changes incidence; the traced path determines leakage.

chapters.title: 用弯曲水流引导光
chapters.titleEn: Guide light through a falling water jet
chapters.caption: 重力弯曲水流，界面反射改变光的方向。
chapters.captionEn: Gravity bends the jet; boundary reflections redirect the light.

chapters.title: 改变水头，比较导光路径
chapters.titleEn: Change water head and compare the guide
chapters.caption: 水头决定流速，流速改变水形与反射位置。
chapters.captionEn: Water head sets outlet speed and changes the jet and reflection points.

chapters.title: 让软木塞挡住小角度光
chapters.titleEn: Let the cork block small-angle rays
chapters.caption: 从针尖到塞缘的光，决定最小可出射角。
chapters.captionEn: The tip-to-rim ray sets the smallest unblocked incidence.

chapters.title: 找出刚好看不见的临界深度
chapters.caption: 只有刚好消失时，几何比值才给出折射率。
chapters.captionEn: The geometric ratio gives the index only at disappearance.

chapters.title: 滑杆静止
chapters.caption: 磁通量存在，但没有变化。
chapters.captionEn: Flux exists, but does not change.

chapters.title: 沿磁场平移
chapters.caption: 整个回路保持闭合，面积与磁通量不变。
chapters.captionEn: The loop stays closed with unchanged area and flux.

chapters.title: 改变回路面积
chapters.caption: 滑杆前进与返回，电流方向相反。
chapters.captionEn: Outward and return strokes give opposite current directions.

chapters.title: 闭合线圈开关
chapters.caption: 初级电流增长，次级出现短暂感应。
chapters.captionEn: Primary current growth briefly induces a secondary current.

chapters.title: 断开线圈开关
chapters.caption: 同一装置，磁通量减小使感应方向反转。
chapters.captionEn: Decreasing flux reverses induction in the same apparatus.

chapters.title: 移动变阻器滑片
chapters.caption: 开关保持闭合，滑片动作改变电流。
chapters.captionEn: The switch stays closed while the slider changes current.

chapters.title: 电流不变，插拔线圈
chapters.caption: 相对位置改变，也能改变磁通量。
chapters.captionEn: Relative position can change flux too.

chapters.title: 先用黄光看膜的反射像
chapters.caption: 同一膜上的不同厚度，对同一波长给出不同明暗。
chapters.captionEn: Different thicknesses produce different brightness for the same wavelength.

chapters.title: 膜变薄，条纹会移动
chapters.caption: 位置改变的是等光程差的厚度轮廓。
chapters.captionEn: Contours of equal optical path difference move as thickness changes.

chapters.title: 换成白光，比较不同波长
chapters.caption: 不同波长的明条纹不在同一位置。
chapters.captionEn: Different wavelengths brighten at different positions.

chapters.title: 用两张纸片支起空气劈尖
chapters.titleEn: Support an air wedge with two sheets
chapters.caption: 等厚度位置形成平行条纹，接触端为暗纹。
chapters.captionEn: Equal-thickness contours form parallel bands; the contact is dark.

chapters.title: 抽掉一张，条纹间距加倍
chapters.titleEn: Remove one sheet to double fringe spacing
chapters.caption: 空气层厚度斜率减半，同一厚度差需要两倍距离。
chapters.captionEn: Half the thickness gradient requires twice the distance for the same thickness change.

chapters.title: 沿遮光筒轴线对准器件
chapters.caption: 光源、透镜、滤片、单缝、双缝与屏依次连接。
chapters.captionEn: Align the source, lens, filter, single slit, double slit and screen.

chapters.title: 把分划线对准第一条亮纹
chapters.titleEn: Align the reticle with the first bright center
chapters.caption: 记录亮纹中心，而不是亮暗交界。
chapters.captionEn: Record the bright center, not a bright–dark boundary.

chapters.title: 跨过五个间隔，记录第六条
chapters.titleEn: Span five intervals to the sixth center
chapters.caption: 总距离除以五，得到平均条纹间距。
chapters.captionEn: Divide the total distance by five to obtain mean fringe spacing.

chapters.title: 换滤片，比较条纹间距
chapters.caption: 较长波长形成更大的间距；换缝距也会改变间距。
chapters.captionEn: Longer wavelengths give wider spacing; slit separation also matters.

chapters.title: 让光照到固定的光敏阵列
chapters.caption: 教材的光路自上而下，各光敏单元同时接光。
chapters.captionEn: The textbook uses a downward beam and simultaneously illuminated detector elements.

chapters.title: 从强度曲线读取空间周期
chapters.titleEn: Read spatial period from the intensity curve
chapters.caption: 亮纹中心对应峰值，读数受像元宽度限制。
chapters.captionEn: Bright centers correspond to peaks; finite pixels limit resolution.

chapters.title: 用单面镜得到第二条路径
chapters.titleEn: Create a second path with one mirror
chapters.caption: 实源直达与经镜反射的光相遇，镜像只是构图工具。
chapters.captionEn: Direct and reflected light meet; the virtual source constructs the reflected path.

chapters.title: 计入反射相位，比较条纹
chapters.titleEn: Include reflection phase in the fringe pattern
chapters.caption: 零路程差处为暗纹，源与虚像距离决定间距。
chapters.captionEn: Zero path difference is dark; source–image separation sets spacing.

chapters.title: 从较宽的狭缝开始
chapters.caption: 缩小几何开口，屏上的分布不只是同比缩小。
chapters.captionEn: A smaller opening does not simply shrink the screen pattern.

chapters.title: 缝更窄，中央条纹更宽
chapters.titleEn: Narrow the slit and broaden the central band
chapters.caption: 传播范围变宽，同时透过的光更少。
chapters.captionEn: Light spreads farther while total transmitted power falls.

chapters.title: 把不同波长的图样叠加
chapters.caption: 中央各色重合，旁侧条纹随波长分开。
chapters.captionEn: Colors overlap centrally and separate toward the sides.

chapters.title: 换成圆孔，观察圆形图样
chapters.caption: 圆对称开口需要圆对称波场积分。
chapters.captionEn: A circular opening requires a radially symmetric field integral.

chapters.title: 用两支铅笔形成狭缝
chapters.titleEn: Form a slit with two pencils
chapters.caption: 改变缝隙，比较线光源的衍射展开。
chapters.captionEn: Change the gap and compare how a line source spreads.

chapters.title: 用卡脚控制狭缝宽度
chapters.titleEn: Control the gap with caliper jaws
chapters.caption: 同一宽度对应同一理想衍射分布。
chapters.captionEn: The same ideal gap width produces the same diffraction distribution.

chapters.title: 小圆盘阴影中也会有亮点
chapters.titleEn: Find a bright spot inside a disk shadow
chapters.caption: 圆周绕射的场在轴线上相长叠加。
chapters.captionEn: The diffracted field adds constructively on the axis.

chapters.title: 改变圆盘尺寸，比较亮点尺度
chapters.titleEn: Change disk size and compare the spot
chapters.caption: 理想轴上强度不随盘径消失，周围结构却改变。
chapters.captionEn: Ideal axial intensity persists while surrounding structure changes.

chapters.title: 让绳的振动沿狭缝通过
chapters.titleEn: Align transverse motion with the slit
chapters.caption: 横波的振动方向在传播方向的垂直平面内。
chapters.captionEn: Transverse motion lies in the plane perpendicular to propagation.

chapters.title: 旋转狭缝，分开透过和反射
chapters.titleEn: Rotate the slit to separate transmission and reflection
chapters.caption: 与狭缝垂直的分量不能通过。
chapters.captionEn: The component perpendicular to the slit is blocked.

chapters.title: 换成弹簧纵波
chapters.caption: 沿轴的位移不随横向狭缝的方向改变。
chapters.captionEn: Axial displacement does not depend on transverse slit orientation.

chapters.title: 先看窗中自然光
chapters.titleEn: Start with natural light through a window
chapters.caption: 转动一片理想偏振片，平均亮度不变。
chapters.captionEn: Rotating one ideal analyzer leaves average unpolarized brightness unchanged.

chapters.title: 观察玻璃表面反光
chapters.caption: 玻璃对两个偏振分量的反射率不同。
chapters.captionEn: Glass reflects the two polarization components differently.

chapters.title: 比较光滑桌面
chapters.caption: 未偏振的漫反射成分会留下不能完全消掉的亮度。
chapters.captionEn: An unpolarized diffuse component leaves residual brightness.

chapters.title: 转向液晶屏，跟踪文字亮度
chapters.caption: 出射光有固定偏振方向，文字和背景一起变化。
chapters.captionEn: A preferred output polarization makes text and background dim together.

chapters.title: 向上抖动一次
chapters.caption: 一个凸起向前传播，红色标记只上下运动。
chapters.captionEn: A raised pulse travels while the red marker moves vertically.

chapters.title: 向下抖动一次
chapters.caption: 向下的位移也向前传播，波的方向不随上下改变。
chapters.captionEn: A downward displacement also travels forward.

chapters.title: 连续振动形成波列
chapters.titleEn: Continuous driving makes a wave train
chapters.caption: 后面的绳段重复前面的动作，但开始得更晚。
chapters.captionEn: Each later segment repeats the source motion after a delay.

chapters.title: 同学依次起蹲
chapters.caption: 相邻同学稍迟重复动作，形成移动的人浪。
chapters.captionEn: Delayed standing and crouching form a travelling human wave.

chapters.title: 只看红衣同学
chapters.caption: 红衣同学没有沿队列走动，传播的是动作状态。
chapters.captionEn: The highlighted student stays in place while the action pattern travels.

chapters.title: 沿弹簧轴向推拉
chapters.titleEn: Push and pull along the spring
chapters.caption: 疏密交替向前传播，弹簧圈沿轴线往复。
chapters.captionEn: Compressions and rarefactions travel while coils oscillate along the axis.

chapters.title: 跟踪同一个弹簧圈
chapters.caption: 放大的红色标记往复回到原位，并不随密部迁移。
chapters.captionEn: The magnified marker oscillates around its original position, rather than following a compression.

chapters.title: 电流加倍的量热对照
chapters.caption: 相同电阻、相同时间，比较四倍发热。
chapters.captionEn: Same resistance and time: compare four times the heating.

chapters.title: 电阻加倍的对照
chapters.caption: 保持电流相同，热量与电阻成正比。
chapters.captionEn: At equal current, heating is proportional to resistance.

chapters.title: 热鸡蛋放入冷水
chapters.titleEn: A hot egg enters cold water
chapters.caption: 鸡蛋降温、水升温，共同趋于平衡。
chapters.captionEn: The egg cools and the water warms toward equilibrium.

chapters.title: 从相同温度开始
chapters.caption: 能量守恒并不保证任意过程都能自发发生。
chapters.captionEn: Energy conservation does not make every process spontaneous.

chapters.title: 不发可见光也有辐射
chapters.caption: 室温辐射以红外为主。
chapters.captionEn: Room-temperature thermal radiation is mainly infrared.

chapters.title: 可见辐射增强
chapters.caption: 温度升高，短波部分显著增强。
chapters.captionEn: Heating strengthens the shorter-wavelength portion.

chapters.title: 更热的铁块
chapters.caption: 可见占比继续增加，屏幕颜色不是温度计。
chapters.captionEn: Visible fraction rises; screen color is not a thermometer.

chapters.title: 发射与到达
chapters.caption: 电磁波传播需要时间。
chapters.captionEn: Propagation takes time.

chapters.title: 改变天线距离
chapters.caption: 对齐同一波包阶段，再比较响应。
chapters.captionEn: Align the packet phase before comparing response.

chapters.title: 发射停止之后
chapters.caption: 在途电磁波继续前进，接收响应随后衰减。
chapters.captionEn: The wave continues in transit; the detected response then decays.

chapters.title: 只改变亮度
chapters.caption: 相同内容与时间，分开比较一个因素。
chapters.captionEn: Hold content and duration fixed to isolate one factor.

chapters.title: 只改变音量
chapters.caption: 有声内容保持相同，才是音量对照。
chapters.captionEn: Keep audible content identical for a volume comparison.

chapters.title: 比较不同任务
chapters.caption: 固定设置与时长，再观察任务差异。
chapters.captionEn: Fix settings and duration before comparing tasks.

chapters.title: 识别混杂与读数限制
chapters.caption: 同时改变多个条件，就不能做单一归因。
chapters.captionEn: Multiple changed conditions prevent a single-factor conclusion.

chapters.title: 剪绳看离开方向
chapters.titleEn: Cut the string and observe departure
chapters.caption: 拉力消失，瞬时速度沿切线保留下来。
chapters.captionEn: Tension vanishes while tangent velocity remains.

chapters.title: 辨认手感中的张力
chapters.titleEn: Identify the tension felt by the hand
chapters.caption: 张力还有竖直分量，不能完全当成向心力。
chapters.captionEn: Tension also has a vertical component and is not entirely centripetal.

chapters.title: 看清演示器如何测力
chapters.caption: 球压挡板，经杠杆改变测力套筒位置。
chapters.captionEn: Ball pressure moves a spring sleeve through a lever.

chapters.title: 只改变质量
chapters.caption: 同半径、同角速度，质量加倍使力加倍。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed radius and angular speed, doubling mass doubles force.

chapters.title: 只改变半径
chapters.caption: 同质量、同角速度，半径加倍使力加倍。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed mass and angular speed, doubling radius doubles force.

chapters.title: 只改变角速度
chapters.caption: 塔轮使角速度加倍，向心力变为四倍。
chapters.captionEn: A pulley change doubles angular speed and quadruples force.

chapters.title: 漏斗里是谁推球转弯
chapters.titleEn: What turns the ball inside a funnel?
chapters.caption: 斜向支持力与竖直重力同时存在。
chapters.captionEn: Oblique support and vertical gravity act together.

chapters.title: 向心力是合力的名称
chapters.caption: 竖直分量抵消，水平向内分量留下。
chapters.captionEn: Vertical components cancel, leaving the inward horizontal part.

chapters.title: 把细绳的两端固定
chapters.caption: 绳长必须大于两个图钉的距离。
chapters.captionEn: Thread length must exceed pin separation.

chapters.title: 两段长度相加
chapters.caption: 一段变长，另一段相应变短。
chapters.captionEn: As one segment grows, the other shortens.

chapters.title: 留下完整轨迹
chapters.caption: 到两焦点距离之和不变，形成椭圆。
chapters.captionEn: A constant sum of distances to two foci traces an ellipse.

chapters.title: 让焦点逐渐靠近
chapters.caption: 保持绳长，焦点重合时得到圆。
chapters.captionEn: With fixed thread length, coincident foci give a circle.

chapters.title: 让下落留下位置记录
chapters.caption: 先通电，再释放；等时间隔打点。
chapters.captionEn: Start the timer before release; dots mark equal time intervals.

chapters.title: 用相邻三点求速度
chapters.caption: 中间时刻速度等于前后两点间平均速度。
chapters.captionEn: Middle-time speed equals the average across its two neighboring dots.

chapters.title: 保留不相等的结果
chapters.caption: 阻力使机械能减少，不把差值强行归零。
chapters.captionEn: Resistance removes mechanical energy; do not force the difference to zero.

chapters.title: 让空气层减小阻力
chapters.titleEn: Reduce resistance with an air layer
chapters.caption: 滑块和遮光条一起沿倾斜气轨运动。
chapters.captionEn: The slider and flag move together along the inclined air track.

chapters.title: 挡光时间怎样变成速度
chapters.caption: d/Δt 是过门平均速度，窄条才近似瞬时速度。
chapters.captionEn: d/Δt is a passage average; a narrow flag approximates instantaneous speed.

chapters.title: 先选对研究系统
chapters.caption: 滑块与悬挂物通过同一根不可伸长的绳相连。
chapters.captionEn: Slider and hanging load share one inextensible cord.

chapters.title: 把两部分动能相加
chapters.caption: 势能看悬挂质量；动能看全部运动质量。
chapters.captionEn: Potential loss uses hanging mass; kinetic gain uses all moving mass.

chapters.title: 把摆动保留为可检验方案
chapters.titleEn: Keep the pendulum as a testable proposal
chapters.caption: 理想摆动说明条件，实际验证仍需测量。
chapters.captionEn: An ideal pendulum illustrates conditions; verification still requires measurement.

chapters.title: 笔尖轻点水面
chapters.caption: 波纹向外，纸屑在原位附近运动。
chapters.captionEn: Ripples travel outward while paper moves near its mean position.

chapters.title: 重复轻点同一处
chapters.caption: 振源不断产生波纹，纸屑仍只作局部运动。
chapters.captionEn: Repeated waves do not carry the paper along with each crest.

chapters.title: 平面波遇到挡板
chapters.caption: 反射改变传播方向，入射角等于反射角。
chapters.captionEn: Reflection changes direction, with equal incident and reflected angles.

chapters.title: 改变入射方向
chapters.caption: 入射方向改变，反射方向按相同角度响应。
chapters.captionEn: The reflected direction responds by the same angle.

chapters.title: 波进入较浅水域
chapters.caption: 频率不变，波速和波长减小，传播方向偏折。
chapters.captionEn: Frequency stays fixed while speed, wavelength and direction change.

chapters.title: 对比深度差
chapters.caption: 深度差越小，方向和波长的变化也越小。
chapters.captionEn: Smaller depth contrast produces smaller changes in direction and wavelength.

chapters.title: 固定波长，改变狭缝
chapters.titleEn: Vary the gap at fixed wavelength
chapters.caption: 狭缝与波长接近时，缝后的展开更明显。
chapters.captionEn: Spreading becomes more pronounced when gap width approaches wavelength.

chapters.title: 固定狭缝，改变波长
chapters.caption: 决定明显程度的是缝宽与波长的相对大小。
chapters.captionEn: Relative gap width and wavelength determine the visible spreading.

chapters.title: 同一振动片带动双源
chapters.caption: 固定相位差的双源形成稳定强弱区。
chapters.captionEn: A fixed phase relationship creates stable reinforcement and cancellation regions.

chapters.title: 分开驱动作对照
chapters.caption: 改变相位会移动强弱区；频率不同则不再保持稳定图样。
chapters.captionEn: Changing phase moves the pattern; different frequencies prevent a fixed pattern.

chapters.title: 先观察静止振源
chapters.caption: 相同周期发出的波峰有相同的圆心。
chapters.captionEn: Crests emitted periodically by a still source share a centre.

chapters.title: 再让振源移动
chapters.caption: 前方波峰更密，后方波峰更疏。
chapters.captionEn: Crests are closer ahead and farther apart behind.

chapters.title: 接住直径约一米的气球
chapters.caption: 封闭空气也随气球运动，不能只算乳胶质量。
chapters.captionEn: Enclosed air moves with the balloon and contributes inertia.

chapters.title: 放气后，用相同速度比较
chapters.titleEn: Compare the deflated balloon at equal speed
chapters.caption: 减少质量会减少需要改变的动量。
chapters.captionEn: Less mass means a smaller momentum change to stop.

chapters.title: 保持动量变化，延长停止时间
chapters.titleEn: Keep momentum change fixed and lengthen the stop
chapters.caption: 冲量相同，平均力和峰值力可以改变。
chapters.captionEn: The same impulse can accompany different average and peak forces.

chapters.title: 跟踪车辆在刚性壁障前的停止
chapters.titleEn: Track a vehicle stopping at a rigid barrier
chapters.caption: 车体位移、减速度与受力来自同一停止过程。
chapters.captionEn: Vehicle motion, deceleration and force follow one stopping history.

chapters.title: 比较不同停止时间的力脉冲
chapters.titleEn: Compare force pulses for different stop durations
chapters.caption: 相同车速与质量给出相同总冲量，脉冲形状尺度不同。
chapters.captionEn: Equal speed and mass give equal total impulse with different pulse scales.

chapters.title: 分开车辆受力与乘员受力
chapters.titleEn: Separate vehicle force from occupant force
chapters.caption: 乘员相对车体的运动由约束模型另行计算。
chapters.captionEn: A separate restraint model determines occupant motion relative to the vehicle.

chapters.title: 先跟踪指尖和水滴
chapters.caption: 关节相连，水滴脱离后继承释放速度。
chapters.captionEn: Connected joints move together; a detached drop keeps release velocity.

chapters.title: 速度方向也要相加
chapters.titleEn: Add directions as well as magnitudes
chapters.caption: 把每一段速度贡献首尾相接。
chapters.captionEn: Join each velocity contribution head to tail.

chapters.title: 从照片读出速度
chapters.caption: 实际长度标定比例，帧率给出时间。
chapters.captionEn: A physical length calibrates scale; frame rate supplies time.

chapters.title: 局部圆周近似得到25g
chapters.caption: 6.5²/0.17 约为249 m/s²。
chapters.captionEn: 6.5²/0.17 is about 249 m/s².

chapters.title: 手机测的是手腕
chapters.caption: 先确认测点、坐标轴和重力处理。
chapters.captionEn: Establish measurement point, axes and gravity handling.

chapters.title: 用手腕测量作量级检验
chapters.caption: 约8×32，与约249量级接近。
chapters.captionEn: About 8×32 is comparable to about 249.

chapters.title: 把问题延伸到投掷
chapters.caption: 先跟踪出手前的手和枪，不虚构飞行数据。
chapters.captionEn: Track the hand and spear before release without inventing flight data.

chapters.title: 加入向前运动并提出测量
chapters.titleEn: Add forward motion and define measurements
chapters.caption: 同一关节动作，加上肩部平移速度。
chapters.captionEn: Add shoulder translation to the same joint motion.

chapters.title: 先保存一个do音
chapters.caption: 这条图线是同一测量位置的信号随时间变化。
chapters.captionEn: The trace shows a signal at one measuring point changing over time.

chapters.title: 并排保存一个sol音
chapters.caption: 同样的时间宽度里，sol完成更多次振动。
chapters.captionEn: Over the same duration, sol completes more oscillations.

chapters.title: 框住do的十个周期
chapters.caption: 同一窗口中do有10个周期，sol有15个周期。
chapters.captionEn: The same window contains ten do cycles and fifteen sol cycles.

chapters.title: 同时发出光与水下钟声
chapters.titleEn: Emit a flash and underwater sound together
chapters.caption: 接收船看到闪光后立即开始计时。
chapters.captionEn: The receiving boat starts timing when it sees the flash.

chapters.title: 等待水下声音到达
chapters.caption: 钟声在水中传播，计时器记录两次接收之间的延迟。
chapters.captionEn: Sound travels through water while the clock measures the arrival delay.

chapters.title: 用路程除以传播时间
chapters.caption: 14千米除以10秒，得到约1400米每秒。
chapters.captionEn: Fourteen kilometres divided by ten seconds gives about 1400 metres per second.

chapters.title: 同一个信号源带动两只扬声器
chapters.caption: 频率相同、相位关系稳定，才有稳定的强弱分布。
chapters.captionEn: A common frequency and stable phase relation support a stable pattern.

chapters.title: 移动一个接收点
chapters.caption: 接收点经过强弱区，声音并非处处一样。
chapters.captionEn: A moving receiver passes through alternating loud and quiet regions.

chapters.title: 两组同学寻找强弱位置
chapters.titleEn: Students find loud and quiet positions
chapters.caption: 白旗标出附近强处，黑旗标出附近弱处。
chapters.captionEn: White flags mark nearby loud locations and dark flags mark quiet ones.

chapters.title: 保留旗位，再改变频率
chapters.titleEn: Keep the flags and change frequency
chapters.caption: 波长改变后，原来的强弱位置不再保持。
chapters.captionEn: Changing wavelength changes which fixed positions are loud or quiet.

chapters.title: 等质量悬球
chapters.caption: 一个特殊现象，先不要直接推广。
chapters.captionEn: Observe the special case before generalizing.

chapters.title: 同大小，不同质量
chapters.caption: 较重入射球可使轻球摆得更高。
chapters.captionEn: A heavier incident ball can send the lighter one higher.

chapters.title: 保留教材实测值
chapters.caption: 动量近似相同，动能明显减少。
chapters.captionEn: Momentum is approximately unchanged while kinetic energy decreases.

chapters.title: 弹性架与光电门
chapters.caption: 从完整遮光时间得到带方向的速度。
chapters.captionEn: Use full flag transit and visible direction to obtain velocity.

chapters.title: 撞针插入橡皮泥
chapters.caption: 粘连后，两滑块保持共同速度。
chapters.captionEn: After sticking, both gliders share a velocity.

chapters.title: 由静止弹开
chapters.caption: 动量相反，动能来自弹性势能。
chapters.captionEn: Opposite momenta draw kinetic energy from the spring.

chapters.title: 用纸带读速度
chapters.caption: 选取碰撞前后各自稳定的点距。
chapters.captionEn: Select steady spacing before and after impact.

chapters.title: 分别核对动量与动能
chapters.caption: 理想弹性碰撞保持两种总量。
chapters.captionEn: Ideal elastic impact conserves both totals.

chapters.title: 粘连时动能去哪了
chapters.caption: 动量守恒不等于动能守恒。
chapters.captionEn: Momentum conservation is not kinetic-energy conservation.

chapters.title: 先把几何条件固定
chapters.caption: 同直径、重球入射、出口水平。
chapters.captionEn: Equal diameters, heavier incident ball, horizontal outlet.

chapters.title: 拿走靶球，留下P
chapters.titleEn: Remove the target and record P
chapters.caption: 标记释放位置，建立碰前速度基准。
chapters.captionEn: Mark the release point to establish the incident-speed baseline.

chapters.title: 放回靶球，记录M和N
chapters.titleEn: Replace the target and record M and N
chapters.caption: 仍从同一高度释放，分别跟踪两球。
chapters.captionEn: Release from the same height and track both balls separately.

chapters.title: 把速度比换成射程比
chapters.titleEn: Replace speed ratios with range ratios
chapters.caption: 同样的飞行时间，是换算成立的关键。
chapters.captionEn: Equal flight time is the key to the substitution.

chapters.title: 比较质量加权距离
chapters.caption: m₁·OP 对应 m₁·OM + m₂·ON。
chapters.captionEn: Compare m₁·OP with m₁·OM + m₂·ON.

chapters.title: 故意改变一次释放高度
chapters.caption: 基准不匹配，不能据此否定动量守恒。
chapters.captionEn: A mismatched baseline cannot disprove momentum conservation.

chapters.title: 水平频闪记录
chapters.caption: 水平频闪记录。
chapters.captionEn: Horizontal strobe recording.

chapters.title: 竖直录像记录
chapters.caption: 竖直录像记录。
chapters.captionEn: Vertical video recording.

chapters.title: 铅笔与匀速拖纸
chapters.caption: 铅笔与匀速拖纸。
chapters.captionEn: Pencil and moving paper.

chapters.title: 累计十次计时
chapters.caption: 累计十次计时。
chapters.captionEn: Time ten oscillations.

chapters.title: 振幅减半
chapters.caption: 振幅减半。
chapters.captionEn: Halve the amplitude.

chapters.title: 同时释放
chapters.caption: 同时释放。
chapters.captionEn: Release together.

chapters.title: 延迟四分之一周期
chapters.caption: 延迟四分之一周期。
chapters.captionEn: Delay by a quarter-period.

chapters.title: 保持弹簧改变质量
chapters.caption: 保持弹簧改变质量。
chapters.captionEn: Change mass with one spring.

chapters.title: 保持质量改变弹簧长度
chapters.titleEn: Change spring length at fixed mass
chapters.caption: 保持质量改变弹簧长度。
chapters.captionEn: Change spring length at fixed mass.

chapters.title: 固定蜂鸣器，建立基准
chapters.caption: 声源和听者静止，收到的频率与发声频率相同。
chapters.captionEn: A stationary source and listener give the same emitted and received frequency.

chapters.title: 把蜂鸣器举过头顶旋转
chapters.caption: 杆端靠近和远离听者，接收频率交替升高和降低。
chapters.captionEn: As the rod end approaches and recedes, received frequency rises and falls.

chapters.title: 比较同一批波峰的到达记录
chapters.caption: 发出间隔相同，到达间隔随传播路程改变。
chapters.captionEn: Equal emission intervals become different arrival intervals as paths change.

chapters.title: 站在队列旁数经过的人
chapters.caption: 每人间隔2米、每秒前进1米：每分钟经过30人。
chapters.captionEn: At 2 m spacing and 1 m/s, thirty people pass each minute.

chapters.title: 观察者逆着队伍走
chapters.caption: 间隔和队速未变，观察者每分钟遇到45人。
chapters.captionEn: Spacing and queue speed stay fixed, but forty-five people are met per minute.

chapters.title: 顺着队伍走，但走得更慢
chapters.titleEn: Follow more slowly than the queue
chapters.caption: 观察者每分钟只遇到15人，接收频率降低。
chapters.captionEn: Only fifteen people are met per minute, representing a lower received frequency.

chapters.title: 提起后释放
chapters.caption: 提起后释放。
chapters.captionEn: Lift and release.

chapters.title: 浸入长度与回复力
chapters.caption: 浸入长度与回复力。
chapters.captionEn: Immersion and restoring force.

chapters.title: 阻力与衰减
chapters.caption: 阻力与衰减。
chapters.captionEn: Damping and decay.

chapters.title: 完全浸没的边界
chapters.caption: 完全浸没的边界。
chapters.captionEn: The submersion boundary.

chapters.title: 松开气口
chapters.caption: 气体向后喷，气球向前加速。
chapters.captionEn: Backward gas flow accelerates the balloon forward.

chapters.title: 把喷出的气体算进系统
chapters.caption: 气球本身质量改变，完整系统动量仍平衡。
chapters.captionEn: Balloon mass changes while complete-system momentum balances.

chapters.title: 在同一时刻比较喷口
chapters.titleEn: Compare nozzle sizes at one time
chapters.caption: 同压差，面积加倍，初始推力加倍。
chapters.captionEn: Same pressure excess, twice the area, twice the initial thrust.

chapters.title: 让盛水容器自由转动
chapters.titleEn: Let the water vessel rotate freely
chapters.caption: 弯管沿切向喷水，容器绕悬点转动。
chapters.captionEn: Bent pipes eject tangential jets and rotate the suspended vessel.

chapters.title: 换一组反向弯管
chapters.caption: 重新从静止开始，喷流和转向一起反向。
chapters.captionEn: Start again from rest; reversing the jets reverses rotation.

chapters.title: 看角动量怎样流出
chapters.caption: 出口绝对速度包含容器的转动速度。
chapters.captionEn: Absolute exit velocity includes transport by container rotation.

chapters.title: 电机驱动两组弹簧
chapters.caption: 电机驱动两组弹簧。
chapters.captionEn: One motor drives two springs.

chapters.title: 改变电机转速
chapters.caption: 改变电机转速。
chapters.captionEn: Change motor speed.

chapters.title: 重摆经横梁传能
chapters.titleEn: A heavy pendulum drives the support
chapters.caption: 重摆经横梁传能。
chapters.captionEn: A heavy pendulum drives the support.

chapters.title: 同长轻摆响应
chapters.caption: 同长轻摆响应。
chapters.captionEn: Matching-length pendulums respond.

chapters.title: 改变重摆长度
chapters.caption: 改变重摆长度。
chapters.captionEn: Retune the heavy pendulum.

chapters.title: 滴墨摆与木板
chapters.caption: 滴墨摆与木板。
chapters.captionEn: Ink pendulum and board.

chapters.title: 墨迹与时间轴
chapters.caption: 墨迹与时间轴。
chapters.captionEn: Ink marks and time.

chapters.title: 不同摆长累计计时
chapters.caption: 不同摆长累计计时。
chapters.captionEn: Time different lengths.

chapters.title: 比较周期平方与摆长
chapters.caption: 比较周期平方与摆长。
chapters.captionEn: Compare period squared and length.

chapters.title: 把长度量到球心
chapters.caption: 把长度量到球心。
chapters.captionEn: Measure to the centre.

chapters.title: 计二十个全振动
chapters.caption: 计二十个全振动。
chapters.captionEn: Time twenty full oscillations.

chapters.title: 检查半径与计时误差
chapters.caption: 检查半径与计时误差。
chapters.captionEn: Audit radius and timing error.

chapters.title: 用杆线限制倾斜平面
chapters.caption: 用杆线限制倾斜平面。
chapters.captionEn: Constrain an inclined plane.

chapters.title: 计时检验等效重力
chapters.caption: 计时检验等效重力。
chapters.captionEn: Time effective-gravity motion.

chapters.title: 核对教材六组原始数据
chapters.caption: 核对教材六组原始数据。
chapters.captionEn: Audit six printed data rows.

chapters.title: 慢动作与快振动
chapters.caption: 手掌动作缓慢，不能把它的往复频率当成盆的声音频率。
chapters.captionEn: Slow hand strokes are not the basin’s sound frequency.

chapters.title: 摩擦使微扰增长
chapters.caption: 摩擦供能超过耗散时，小扰动逐渐变成明显振动。
chapters.captionEn: A disturbance grows when friction supplies more energy than is lost.

chapters.title: 四处强响应
chapters.caption: 盆壁模态决定强弱分布，水花集中在四处强响应区。
chapters.captionEn: The shell mode organizes four regions of strong water response.

chapters.title: 对照六腹模态
chapters.caption: 另一种耦合模态出现六处强响应，不等于加快手的往复。
chapters.captionEn: Another coupled mode gives six regions, not simply faster hand strokes.

chapters.title: 放开后逐渐衰减
chapters.caption: 摩擦停止，供能归零，已有振动与水花逐渐消退。
chapters.captionEn: Rubbing stops; stored vibration and spray gradually fade.

chapters.title: 留下来的小室
chapters.caption: 木栓的小室，留下的是细胞壁。
chapters.captionEn: Cork chambers reveal the remaining cell walls.

chapters.title: 从观察到归纳
chapters.caption: 不同组织的共同结构，支持细胞学说的归纳。
chapters.captionEn: Shared structures across tissues supported cell theory.

chapters.title: 先定位
chapters.caption: 先在低倍视野中，把目标移到中央。
chapters.captionEn: Center the target under low power first.

chapters.title: 再放大、细调焦
chapters.caption: 转入高倍后，视野缩小；只用细准焦调整。
chapters.captionEn: High power narrows the field; adjust fine focus.

chapters.title: 看形态和位置
chapters.caption: 绿色叶绿体分布在中央液泡周围的细胞质中。
chapters.captionEn: Green chloroplasts lie in cytoplasm around the central vacuole.

chapters.title: 追踪同一个标志
chapters.caption: 追踪带环的同一个叶绿体，细胞壁并没有转动。
chapters.captionEn: Follow the ringed chloroplast while the cell wall stays fixed.

chapters.title: 红色从哪里来？
chapters.titleEn: Where does the red solid come from?
chapters.caption: 红色固体中的铜，来自原来的蓝色试剂。
chapters.captionEn: The red solid contains copper from the blue reagent.

chapters.title: 蔗糖为什么不变红？
chapters.caption: 检测识别反应性质，不能只凭“糖”的名字。
chapters.captionEn: The test responds to chemical behavior, not the name “sugar”.

chapters.title: 橙色去了哪里？
chapters.titleEn: Where does the orange dye go?
chapters.caption: 有颜色的染料，更容易分配到脂肪中。
chapters.captionEn: The colored dye preferentially partitions into lipid.

chapters.title: 洗淡了，为什么更清楚？
chapters.titleEn: Why does rinsing make the droplets clearer?
chapters.caption: 背景变淡了，脂肪的数量没有增加。
chapters.captionEn: The background fades; the amount of fat has not increased.

chapters.title: 紫色的铜，还是原来的价态吗？
chapters.titleEn: Does violet copper have a new oxidation state?
chapters.caption: 新物质、再分配、配位：变色的原因并不相同。
chapters.captionEn: New substances, redistribution, coordination: color changes have different causes.

chapters.title: 看不见，不等于没有光
chapters.caption: 后方光屏亮着：两种样品都有光通过。
chapters.captionEn: Both rear screens are lit: light passed through.

chapters.title: 只挡住通往眼睛的光
chapters.titleEn: Block only the route to the eye
chapters.caption: 挡住侧向路径，眼睛变暗；直穿的光仍到达光屏。
chapters.captionEn: Block the side path: the eye darkens, but the screen stays lit.

chapters.title: 微粒怎样响应入射光
chapters.titleEn: How the particle responds to light
chapters.caption: 入射电场驱动电荷响应，变化的极化产生散射光。
chapters.captionEn: The incident field drives a charge response that produces scattered light.

chapters.title: 让解释预测新的现象
chapters.caption: 同一个散射解释，接受稀释、换色与新场景的检验。
chapters.captionEn: Test the same explanation by dilution, color and a new setting.

chapters.title: 固体中的离子
chapters.caption: 干燥盐有离子，晶格却限制了它们的自由移动。
chapters.captionEn: Dry salts contain ions, but the lattice prevents free movement.

chapters.title: 灯不亮的边界
chapters.caption: 蒸馏水只有很少的离子，微弱电流可能低于显示阈值。
chapters.captionEn: Distilled water has few ions, so its tiny current may be below the indication threshold.

chapters.title: 溶解释放可移动离子
chapters.caption: 两种盐溶于水后，原有离子分散到溶液中。
chapters.captionEn: Dissolving either salt disperses its existing ions through water.

chapters.title: 接通后才有定向迁移
chapters.caption: 电离先于通电；正负离子向相反电极移动。
chapters.captionEn: Dissociation precedes connection; opposite ions drift toward opposite electrodes.

chapters.title: 三份新鲜样液
chapters.caption: 起始值相同，先保留可比的条件。
chapters.captionEn: Begin at the same pH under comparable conditions.

chapters.title: 相同的酸进入
chapters.caption: 水迅速变化，缓冲样液暂时变化较小。
chapters.captionEn: Water changes sharply; buffer samples resist the addition.

chapters.title: 继续滴加并记录
chapters.caption: 缓冲对的组成在变，pH也逐步改变。
chapters.captionEn: The buffer pair changes composition as pH moves.

chapters.title: 换新样液再加碱
chapters.caption: 加碱比较必须从新鲜样液重新开始。
chapters.captionEn: Compare base additions using fresh aliquots.

chapters.title: 越过缓冲容量
chapters.caption: 超过容量后，缓冲样液也会明显变酸。
chapters.captionEn: A sufficiently large addition overwhelms the buffer.

chapters.title: 兴奋先到电极a
chapters.caption: a先变化，电表测到两点之差。
chapters.captionEn: Electrode a changes first, creating a difference.

chapters.title: 兴奋再到电极b
chapters.caption: 同一束兴奋先后经过，偏转方向反转。
chapters.captionEn: The same traveling excitation reverses the difference.

chapters.title: 跨膜电位改变
chapters.caption: 通透性改变，使局部电位暂时翻转。
chapters.captionEn: Changing permeability transiently changes local voltage.

chapters.title: 信号到达突触末梢
chapters.caption: 递质从突触前末梢释放，跨过间隙。
chapters.captionEn: Transmitter is released and crosses the cleft.

chapters.title: 受体响应，再清除
chapters.caption: 受体改变通道，递质随后被清除。
chapters.captionEn: Receptors alter channels before transmitter is cleared.

chapters.title: 金属连接的歧义
chapters.caption: 收缩是观察；电来自哪里仍需区分。
chapters.captionEn: Contraction is observed; its source remains a question.

chapters.title: 去掉金属再比较
chapters.caption: 去掉金属仍可收缩；断开接触，效应消失。
chapters.captionEn: Contraction can occur without metal; interrupting contact removes the effect.

chapters.title: 先刺激心脏A
chapters.caption: A变慢；B尚未接收到营养液。
chapters.captionEn: A slows before any fluid reaches B.

chapters.title: 让液体去到B
chapters.caption: 转移液体后，未连接神经的B也变慢。
chapters.captionEn: After fluid transfer, the unconnected heart B also slows.

chapters.title: 稀释与对照
chapters.caption: 液体不转移，或没有释放，B就缺少该信号。
chapters.captionEn: Without release or transfer, B lacks the signal.

chapters.title: 酸放在哪里
chapters.caption: 小肠内加酸与血液内加酸产生不同结果。
chapters.captionEn: Acid in the intestine and acid in blood give different outcomes.

chapters.title: 去掉神经保留血流
chapters.titleEn: Remove the nerve, retain blood flow
chapters.caption: 小肠神经被切断，分泌增加仍然出现。
chapters.captionEn: Secretion still increases after denervation.

chapters.title: 转移黏膜提取物
chapters.caption: 提取液进入血液后，胰腺作出响应。
chapters.captionEn: A blood-borne mucosal extract produces a pancreatic response.

chapters.title: 为什么有的分子更容易进去？
chapters.titleEn: Why do some molecules enter more readily?
chapters.caption: 先进入脂质，再穿膜：这是成分线索。
chapters.captionEn: Entering lipid helps a molecule cross.

chapters.title: 为什么约两倍面积支持双层？
chapters.titleEn: Why does roughly twice the area support two layers?
chapters.caption: 先测面积，再检验一层和两层的预测。
chapters.captionEn: Measure first; test one or two layers.

chapters.title: 张力低，就能画出蛋白质外套吗？
chapters.titleEn: Does low tension prove a protein coat?
chapters.caption: 吸附能改变张力，却不能唯一确定排列。
chapters.captionEn: Lower tension does not locate proteins.

chapters.title: 看见三条带，就知道三层成分吗？
chapters.titleEn: Do three image bands identify three chemical layers?
chapters.caption: 明暗不是成分标签，还需独立证据。
chapters.captionEn: Contrast alone cannot name a substance.

chapters.title: 颜色混合，排除了哪一种膜？
chapters.titleEn: What does marker mixing rule out?
chapters.caption: 固定预测仍分区，混合观察支持可动。
chapters.captionEn: Fixed markers stay apart; observed markers mix.

chapters.title: 怎样把不同证据放进同一张膜？
chapters.titleEn: How can one membrane model satisfy different evidence?
chapters.caption: 面积、亲疏水与运动共同约束结构。
chapters.captionEn: Area, water affinity and motion constrain structure.

chapters.title: 做得像，还是解释得通？
chapters.titleEn: Does the model explain, or merely resemble?
chapters.caption: 用证据检验模型，也检验它的局限。
chapters.captionEn: Evidence tests a model and its limits.

chapters.title: 同样加水，为何一热一冷？
chapters.titleEn: The same water, opposite temperature changes
chapters.caption: 外观相似，加水后的变化不同。
chapters.captionEn: Similar solids respond differently to water.

chapters.title: 能量的两笔账
chapters.titleEn: Two sides of the energy balance
chapters.caption: 分开原有作用需能；形成新的水合作用放能。
chapters.captionEn: Separating interactions costs energy; hydration releases it.

chapters.title: 名字里有氢，为什么仍显碱性？
chapters.caption: 颜色是线索，名字不能决定酸碱性。
chapters.captionEn: Colour is a clue; a name does not determine acidity.

chapters.title: 跟住水中的这个氢
chapters.caption: 碱性来自与水的平衡，钠离子不生成OH⁻。
chapters.captionEn: Alkalinity comes from equilibrium with water, not from sodium making OH⁻.

chapters.title: 颜色变淡，离子就消失了吗？
chapters.titleEn: Does fading colour mean the ions disappeared?
chapters.caption: 加水降低浓度；同一份碳仍在体系中。
chapters.captionEn: Water lowers concentration; the same carbon remains.

chapters.title: 加热后，白色固体还是原来的物质吗？
chapters.titleEn: After heating, is the white solid unchanged?
chapters.caption: 相同检验装置，先建立无明显分解的对照。
chapters.captionEn: Use the same detector to establish the comparison.

chapters.title: 跟住离开的碳和氢
chapters.titleEn: Follow the carbon and hydrogen that leave
chapters.caption: 同一批原子分到残渣、水和CO₂中。
chapters.captionEn: The original atoms enter residue, water and CO₂.

chapters.title: 用留下多少，检验你的解释
chapters.titleEn: Test the explanation with the residue
chapters.caption: 质量减少是产物离开；预测要与残渣核对。
chapters.captionEn: Mass falls because products leave; check the predicted residue.

chapters.title: 一颗分子往回走，整滴墨水却散开
chapters.titleEn: One doubles back; the drop spreads
chapters.caption: 无规则运动，形成有方向的净扩散。
chapters.captionEn: Random motion produces net spreading.

chapters.title: 水位停了，水分子没有停
chapters.titleEn: The level stops; molecules do not
chapters.caption: 混合降低水势，压力抬高水势，净流量由两侧之差决定。
chapters.captionEn: Mixing lowers water potential; pressure raises it. Their difference drives net flow.

chapters.title: 盐没有抽走整个细胞
chapters.titleEn: Salt does not remove the whole cell
chapters.caption: 失水使细胞变小，也使胞内溶质更浓。
chapters.captionEn: Water loss shrinks the cell and concentrates its contents.

chapters.title: 把失水推理带进植物细胞
chapters.titleEn: Bring the argument into a plant cell
chapters.caption: 液泡和原生质体缩小，细胞壁留在外面。
chapters.captionEn: The vacuole and protoplast shrink inside the wall.

chapters.title: 复原之后，为什么不继续胀大
chapters.titleEn: Why recovery does not mean endless swelling
chapters.caption: 靠近细胞壁后，膨压抵消进一步吸水。
chapters.captionEn: Wall contact builds turgor that opposes further uptake.

chapters.title: 水通道，改变快慢而不是方向
chapters.titleEn: Channels change speed, not the driving direction
chapters.caption: 水通道加快被动过水，反转梯度也加快失水。
chapters.captionEn: Channels speed passive flow, including water loss after reversal.

chapters.title: 蛋白质，不等于主动运输
chapters.titleEn: A protein does not make transport active
chapters.caption: 两条被动路径都消耗浓度差，平衡后仍能交换。
chapters.captionEn: Both passive routes reduce a gradient; exchange persists.

chapters.title: 用供能对照检验逆势运输
chapters.titleEn: Test uphill transport with an energy control
chapters.caption: 相同起点，供能的泵才能继续逆势积累。
chapters.captionEn: From the same start, only the energized pump accumulates uphill.

chapters.title: 接触决定表面变化
chapters.caption: 只有接触氧的表面生成新的氧化层。
chapters.captionEn: Only oxygen-exposed metal forms new oxide.

chapters.title: 同样的钠，不同的含氧量
chapters.caption: 氧化物与过氧化物的氧，记账不同。
chapters.captionEn: Oxide and peroxide oxygen have different oxidation states.

chapters.title: 把浮、熔、运动分开解释
chapters.caption: 浮入多少由密度决定；金属体积随消耗缩小。
chapters.captionEn: Density sets ideal immersion; consumption reduces metal volume.

chapters.title: 氢气里的氢从哪里来
chapters.caption: 跟住水中的同一颗氢。
chapters.captionEn: Follow the same hydrogen in water.

chapters.title: 这次改变的是氧的价态
chapters.caption: 钠仍为正一价，过氧化物的氧一升一降。
chapters.captionEn: Sodium stays +1 while peroxide oxygen is oxidized and reduced.

chapters.title: 碱性相同，气体可以不同
chapters.titleEn: Alkalinity does not fix the gas
chapters.caption: 相同钠原子数，可以对应不同气体。
chapters.captionEn: The same sodium count can give different gases.

chapters.title: 同族相似，产物不能只靠颜色
chapters.titleEn: A shared group does not fix every product
chapters.caption: 同样一个价电子，先支持一价离子的判断。
chapters.captionEn: One valence electron supports singly charged ions.

chapters.title: 更剧烈不等于更多氢气
chapters.titleEn: More vigorous does not mean more hydrogen
chapters.caption: 更剧烈，意味着更多氢气吗？
chapters.captionEn: Does more vigour mean more hydrogen?

chapters.title: 形成一个肽键
chapters.caption: 羧基和氨基连接，同时脱去一分子水。
chapters.captionEn: A carboxyl and amino group join with loss of one water molecule.

chapters.title: 先确认两条链
chapters.caption: 牛胰岛素有51个残基，分属21与30个残基的两条链。
chapters.captionEn: Bovine insulin has 51 residues divided into chains of 21 and 30.

chapters.title: 三处特定的二硫键
chapters.caption: 两处二硫键连A、B链，另一处连接A链内部。
chapters.captionEn: Two disulfides join A and B; a third joins two positions within A.

chapters.title: 结构之后，还要验活性
chapters.titleEn: Structure still needs a functional test
chapters.caption: 正确结构必须结合独立活性检验，不能只凭沉淀或外形判断。
chapters.captionEn: Structure must be supported by an independent activity test, not appearance alone.

chapters.title: 先排除金属丝的干扰
chapters.caption: 洁净金属丝不应引入明显焰色；钠盐使火焰显黄色。
chapters.captionEn: A clean wire should add no conspicuous colour; sodium salt produces yellow.

chapters.title: 钾的颜色可能被掩盖
chapters.caption: 钾的紫色可被微量钠产生的强黄光干扰。
chapters.captionEn: Potassium’s lilac appearance can be obscured by sodium’s strong yellow light.

chapters.title: 钴玻璃选择透过的波长
chapters.caption: 滤去大部分钠黄光后，更容易辨认钾的焰色。
chapters.captionEn: Suppressing much of the sodium yellow makes potassium easier to distinguish.

chapters.title: 能级下降，发出光子
chapters.titleEn: A downward transition emits a photon
chapters.caption: 光子带走的能量等于两个能级之差。
chapters.captionEn: The emitted photon carries the energy difference between levels.

chapters.title: 匹配的光也能被吸收
chapters.caption: 吸收光子可以使原子跃迁到较高能级。
chapters.captionEn: Absorbing a matching photon can raise the atom to a higher level.

chapters.title: 比较锂、氦、汞的谱线
chapters.caption: 不同元素的多条谱线组成不同的识别图样。
chapters.captionEn: Several lines form an element-specific pattern.

chapters.title: 从亮线到暗线
chapters.titleEn: From bright lines to dark lines
chapters.caption: 连续背景中缺少某些波长，可形成吸收谱线。
chapters.captionEn: Missing wavelengths in a continuous background appear as absorption lines.

chapters.title: 先看三个定位结果
chapters.caption: 三个时点，标记的位置不同。
chapters.captionEn: Three samples show changing label locations.

chapters.title: 从定位推断路径
chapters.titleEn: Infer a route from the locations
chapters.caption: 同一批标记，先后定位支持转运。
chapters.captionEn: Follow one cohort to infer its route.

chapters.title: 隔开的腔室怎样交接
chapters.titleEn: How separate compartments hand cargo over
chapters.caption: 出芽与融合，使货物留在膜围成的空间。
chapters.captionEn: Budding and fusion preserve the enclosed route.

chapters.title: 用阻断检验路线
chapters.titleEn: Test the route with a block
chapters.caption: 只堵住上游出口，会把标记留在哪里？
chapters.captionEn: Block the exit. Where does cargo collect?

chapters.title: 让货物检验细胞模型
chapters.titleEn: Let cargo test the cell model
chapters.caption: 连接是否合理，让货物走一遍。
chapters.captionEn: Test the connections by following cargo.

chapters.title: 同一个电子，换了归属
chapters.caption: 同一份电子，失去与得到相对应。
chapters.captionEn: The same electron is lost and gained.

chapters.title: 为什么需要两个钠？
chapters.titleEn: Why are two sodium atoms needed?
chapters.caption: 两个钠各给一个；两个氯各收一个。
chapters.captionEn: Two sodium atoms supply one electron each.

chapters.title: 形式分配，不等于真实分离
chapters.titleEn: Formal allocation is not physical separation
chapters.caption: 共用电子对还在，氧化数按规则记账。
chapters.captionEn: The pair remains shared; oxidation states follow a rule.

chapters.title: 用电子账本预测铜的数量
chapters.caption: 先预测，再用电子账本检验。
chapters.captionEn: Predict first, then check the electron account.

chapters.title: 合成的是基因组
chapters.caption: 化学合成的DNA片段经过装配，构成完整基因组。
chapters.captionEn: Chemically synthesized DNA pieces are assembled into a complete genome.

chapters.title: 已有细胞提供运行环境
chapters.titleEn: An existing cell supplies the machinery
chapters.caption: 合成基因组依赖受体细胞的膜、细胞质和既有分子机器。
chapters.captionEn: The synthetic genome depends on a recipient’s membrane, cytoplasm and existing machinery.

chapters.title: 十六条怎样变成一条
chapters.caption: 连续融合保留多数遗传内容，同时处理多余着丝粒。
chapters.captionEn: Successive fusions retain most genetic content while removing redundant centromeres.

chapters.title: 存活还需要检验
chapters.caption: DNA结构改变之后，仍要观察生长、繁殖和功能。
chapters.captionEn: After changing DNA organization, growth, reproduction and function still need testing.

chapters.title: 从血浆到组织液
chapters.caption: 示踪物可以交换，红细胞仍留在血管。
chapters.captionEn: Tracer can exchange while red cells stay in blood.

chapters.title: 淋巴路径接回循环
chapters.caption: 组织液的一部分进入淋巴，再回到血液。
chapters.captionEn: Part of the interstitial route returns through lymph.

chapters.title: 按时刻留下记录
chapters.caption: 观察值逐个出现，不由一条理论曲线生成。
chapters.captionEn: Observations appear individually, not from a theoretical curve.

chapters.title: 比较成员与气温
chapters.caption: 同一体温刻度比较个体，气温另用刻度。
chapters.captionEn: Compare people on one scale and air on a separate scale.

chapters.title: 让热量收支重新接近
chapters.caption: 散热响应减小温差，热量收支始终可核对。
chapters.captionEn: Heat-loss responses reduce the deviation while preserving the balance.

chapters.title: 少排出一些水
chapters.caption: ADH改变水的重吸收，不能制造水。
chapters.captionEn: ADH changes water retention; it does not create water.

chapters.title: 再区分钠的收支
chapters.caption: 保留钠与保留水有关联，但不是同一项作用。
chapters.captionEn: Sodium retention and water retention are related but distinct.

chapters.title: 来源与受体先分开
chapters.caption: 结扎胰管的供体，与去胰腺的受体不同。
chapters.captionEn: The duct-ligated donor differs from the pancreas-removed recipient.

chapters.title: 让提取物改变受体
chapters.titleEn: Test the extract in a recipient
chapters.caption: 加入提取物后，相对血糖下降。
chapters.captionEn: The recipient’s relative glucose falls after extract delivery.

chapters.title: 先拿走分泌来源
chapters.caption: 鸡冠逐渐退缩，正常对照仍保持。
chapters.captionEn: The comb regresses while the intact control remains.

chapters.title: 移植后再观察恢复
chapters.caption: 恢复来源后，表型逐步回升。
chapters.captionEn: Restoring a source allows gradual phenotypic recovery.

chapters.title: 观察不改写染色体
chapters.caption: 去性腺后，XX与XY的外生殖器表现趋同。
chapters.captionEn: After gonadal removal, the reported external outcomes converge.

chapters.title: 用假说预测补充条件
chapters.caption: 补雄激素这一列是条件预测。
chapters.captionEn: The androgen-supplemented column is a prediction.

chapters.title: 进食后增加利用
chapters.caption: 输入增加后，胰岛素响应减小血糖偏离。
chapters.captionEn: After an input, insulin response reduces the glucose deviation.

chapters.title: 禁食时增加输出
chapters.caption: 低血糖方向的偏离引出胰高血糖素响应。
chapters.captionEn: A downward deviation recruits the glucagon response.

chapters.title: 去掉中间一级
chapters.caption: 垂体缺失后，TSH与下游激素降低。
chapters.captionEn: Pituitary absence lowers TSH and downstream hormone.

chapters.title: 补回中间信号
chapters.caption: 补充TSH，在垂体缺失时部分恢复下游。
chapters.captionEn: TSH supplementation partially restores downstream output.

chapters.title: 再检查上游刺激
chapters.caption: TRH增加，推动垂体与甲状腺轴响应。
chapters.captionEn: Additional TRH drives the downstream axis.

chapters.title: 下游再影响上游
chapters.caption: 甲状腺激素增加，上游分泌受到抑制。
chapters.captionEn: Extra thyroid hormone suppresses upstream output.

chapters.title: 分开三种来源
chapters.caption: 核供体、卵细胞供体与妊娠环境不是同一来源。
chapters.captionEn: The nucleus, egg cytoplasm and gestational environment have distinct origins.

chapters.title: 颜色跟随哪一个来源
chapters.titleEn: Which source does the color follow?
chapters.caption: 黑色美西螈的核移入白色个体的去核卵，后代呈黑色。
chapters.captionEn: A dark axolotl nucleus in an enucleated pale donor egg produces dark offspring in this comparison.

chapters.title: 先有核，才继续分裂
chapters.caption: 无核半边延迟分裂，移入细胞核后才开始。
chapters.captionEn: The initially enucleated half starts division after receiving a nucleus.

chapters.title: 残留活动与持续维持
chapters.caption: 去核片段仍可短暂消化已有食物，持续活动依赖核质协作。
chapters.captionEn: An enucleated fragment can briefly digest existing food, but sustained activity needs nucleus–cytoplasm cooperation.

chapters.title: 帽形与基部细胞核
chapters.titleEn: Cap shape and the basal nucleus
chapters.caption: 再生帽的形态主要跟随基部细胞核来源。
chapters.captionEn: The regenerated cap primarily follows the basal nucleus’s origin.

chapters.title: 成功与困难一起记录
chapters.caption: 去核、激活和重编程都重要；历史成功不等于每次成功。
chapters.captionEn: Enucleation, activation and reprogramming matter; historical success is not universal success.

chapters.title: 分化不等于丢失全部潜能
chapters.titleEn: Differentiation does not erase all potential
chapters.caption: 分化的肠上皮细胞核，在合适卵细胞环境中仍可支持广泛发育。
chapters.captionEn: A differentiated intestinal nucleus can support broad development in a suitable egg environment.

chapters.title: 白色固体从哪里来？
chapters.titleEn: Where did the white solid come from?
chapters.caption: 同一批 Ba²⁺ 与 SO₄²⁻，从水相进入固相。
chapters.captionEn: Barium and sulfate enter the solid.

chapters.title: 把没有反应的离子留下
chapters.titleEn: Keep the ions that did not react
chapters.caption: 方程式省略的离子，仍留在水里。
chapters.captionEn: Spectator ions stay in the water.

chapters.title: 固体还在，过程就停止了吗？
chapters.titleEn: Does visible solid mean nothing is happening?
chapters.caption: 外观不变，少量溶解与析出仍可相互抵消。
chapters.captionEn: A steady solid can still exchange ions.

chapters.title: 先移走 OH⁻，再看固体补充
chapters.titleEn: Remove hydroxide, then follow the solid
chapters.caption: 酸先消耗溶液中的 OH⁻，固体溶解补充离子。
chapters.captionEn: Removing OH⁻ lets more solid dissolve.

chapters.title: 先固定这一份银
chapters.caption: 白色固体中的银，是后续两次转化的同一份银。
chapters.captionEn: Follow the same silver into new solids.

chapters.title: 新的固相接走银
chapters.titleEn: A new solid takes up silver
chapters.caption: AgI 接走溶液中的 Ag⁺，AgCl 继续溶解。
chapters.captionEn: AgI takes up silver; AgCl dissolves.

chapters.title: 两个银，组成一份新固体
chapters.titleEn: Two silvers in each new formula unit
chapters.caption: 银总量不变；每份 Ag₂S 必须接收两个银。
chapters.captionEn: Two silvers per Ag₂S; none are lost.

chapters.title: 褐色沉淀需要什么？
chapters.titleEn: What does the brown precipitate need?
chapters.caption: 先区分固体中的 OH 与原来额外加入的 OH⁻。
chapters.captionEn: Where does the new solid get its OH⁻?

chapters.title: 新沉淀促使旧沉淀溶解
chapters.titleEn: A new precipitate draws on the old solid
chapters.caption: Fe(OH)₃ 接走 OH⁻；镁转入水相。
chapters.captionEn: Fe(OH)₃ forms; magnesium enters water.

chapters.title: 同样褐色，能证明同一路径吗？
chapters.titleEn: Does the same brown colour prove the same route?
chapters.caption: 相同 Fe(OH)₃，可以对应不同的镁去向。
chapters.captionEn: Same brown solid, different Mg fate.

chapters.title: 先看到三份沉淀
chapters.caption: 氯化物与碳酸盐都能在银离子作用下出现沉淀。
chapters.captionEn: Both chloride and carbonate samples can precipitate with silver ions.

chapters.title: 给沉淀第二次考验
chapters.caption: 稀硝酸使碳酸银消失，氯化银仍然保留。
chapters.captionEn: Dilute nitric acid removes silver carbonate while silver chloride remains.

chapters.title: 写出共同离子变化
chapters.caption: 盐酸和氯化钠有不同阳离子，却给出同一氯离子证据。
chapters.captionEn: Different cations in hydrochloric acid and sodium chloride lead to the same chloride evidence.

chapters.title: 换成钡离子再比较
chapters.caption: 硫酸盐与碳酸盐也都能生成浅色钡盐沉淀。
chapters.captionEn: Sulfate and carbonate can both form pale barium precipitates.

chapters.title: 酸响应把证据分开
chapters.caption: 碳酸钡遇稀盐酸消失并放出气体，硫酸钡保留。
chapters.captionEn: Barium carbonate dissolves with gas evolution in dilute hydrochloric acid; barium sulfate persists.

chapters.title: 保留判断的适用范围
chapters.titleEn: Keep the scope of the conclusion
chapters.caption: 判断依靠前后两步的组合，不能只看最终的白色。
chapters.captionEn: The conclusion uses both observations, not the final white colour alone.

chapters.title: 先分开两种刺激
chapters.caption: 食物本来能引出反应，声音尚不能。
chapters.captionEn: Food evokes a response before the sound acquires one.

chapters.title: 让声音预告食物
chapters.caption: 重复配对后，声音单独测试的反应增强。
chapters.captionEn: After repeated pairing, the sound-alone response grows.

chapters.title: 声音不再得到强化
chapters.caption: 声音反复不伴随食物，反应逐渐减弱。
chapters.captionEn: Repeated sound without food reduces the response.

chapters.title: 刺激位置与对侧响应
chapters.caption: 皮层上部的表示联系对侧下肢。
chapters.captionEn: An upper cortical representation relates to the opposite leg.

chapters.title: 换一个皮层位置
chapters.caption: 位置改变后，对应的运动部位也改变。
chapters.captionEn: Changing the cortical location changes the related body region.

chapters.title: 表达与理解可以分离
chapters.caption: S病例理解保留，但流畅表达受损。
chapters.captionEn: The S case preserves comprehension but impairs fluent expression.

chapters.title: 再比较另一组保留与受损
chapters.caption: H病例能产生言语，却难以理解话语。
chapters.captionEn: The H case can produce speech but has impaired comprehension.

chapters.title: 笼子排除了哪一种解释？
chapters.titleEn: Which explanation does the cage exclude?
chapters.caption: 挡住直接研磨，仍允许胃液进入。
chapters.captionEn: Block direct grinding; let gastric fluid through.

chapters.title: 加热和加酶，差别在哪里？
chapters.titleEn: How do heating and catalysis differ?
chapters.caption: 升温改变能量条件；催化改变反应路径。
chapters.captionEn: Heating changes energy conditions; catalysis changes the pathway.

chapters.title: 没有完整细胞，反应还会继续吗？
chapters.titleEn: Can the reaction continue without intact cells?
chapters.caption: 完整细胞不是这段反应必需的存在形式。
chapters.captionEn: This reaction does not require intact cells.

chapters.title: 结晶怎样同时连接成分与功能？
chapters.titleEn: How do crystals link composition and function?
chapters.caption: 蛋白性质和催化活性，需要两条证据。
chapters.captionEn: Protein properties and catalytic activity require distinct evidence.

chapters.title: 同一种酶，为什么结果不同？
chapters.titleEn: Why does the same enzyme give different outcomes?
chapters.caption: 能结合并形成反应构型，才能走催化路径。
chapters.captionEn: Productive binding needs the right chemical arrangement.

chapters.title: 两支都慢的试管，原因一样吗？
chapters.titleEn: Can two slow samples have different causes?
chapters.caption: 低温减慢过程；强热还可能损伤催化结构。
chapters.captionEn: Cold slows turnover; severe heat can damage catalytic structure.

chapters.title: 酸碱改变了酶的什么？
chapters.titleEn: What does pH change in an enzyme?
chapters.caption: 酸碱改变基团状态；极端条件还可能破坏结构。
chapters.captionEn: pH changes group states; extremes may also damage structure.

chapters.title: 回到相同条件，能恢复吗？
chapters.titleEn: What recovers under the same conditions?
chapters.caption: 统一检测条件，才能读出处理留下的影响。
chapters.captionEn: A common assay condition reveals the effect of pretreatment.

chapters.title: 先确定溶质量
chapters.caption: 100 mL、1.00 mol/L对应0.100 mol NaCl。
chapters.captionEn: 100 mL at 1.00 mol/L requires 0.100 mol of NaCl.

chapters.title: 追踪转移后的残留
chapters.caption: 液体倒出后，原容器内壁仍可能留下溶质。
chapters.captionEn: Pouring out the solution can leave solute on the original vessel walls.

chapters.title: 把洗涤液也转入
chapters.caption: 洗涤把原容器中的溶质带回同一份溶液。
chapters.captionEn: Rinsing returns residual solute to the same solution.

chapters.title: 体积以凹液面为准
chapters.caption: 平视凹液面最低点，让它与刻度线相切。
chapters.captionEn: View at eye level and align the meniscus bottom with the calibration line.

chapters.title: 混匀后才处处相同
chapters.caption: 混匀改变局部分布，溶质总量与总体积保持不变。
chapters.captionEn: Mixing changes local distribution while total solute and volume remain fixed.

chapters.title: 稀释时保留所取溶质量
chapters.caption: 50.0 mL的1.00 mol/L母液，定容到100 mL后为0.500 mol/L。
chapters.captionEn: 50.0 mL of 1.00 mol/L stock made up to 100 mL gives 0.500 mol/L.

chapters.title: ATP与耦合
chapters.caption: ATP水解与吸能过程耦合，ADP可再合成ATP。
chapters.captionEn: ATP hydrolysis couples to energy-requiring processes; ADP can regenerate ATP.

chapters.title: 先清理进入的空气
chapters.caption: 空气先通过NaOH，再进入培养液，最后进入CO₂检测液。
chapters.captionEn: Air passes through NaOH, then culture and finally the carbon-dioxide detector.

chapters.title: 先处理残余氧
chapters.caption: 无氧组先封口放置，再连接检测瓶。
chapters.captionEn: The anaerobic culture is sealed before connecting the detector.

chapters.title: 两种产物，两种检测
chapters.caption: CO₂与酒精分别检测，残余葡萄糖会干扰酒精显色。
chapters.captionEn: Test carbon dioxide and ethanol separately; residual glucose interferes with the ethanol assay.

chapters.title: 先追踪六个碳
chapters.caption: 糖酵解在细胞质基质形成两个丙酮酸，净生成2 ATP。
chapters.captionEn: Cytosolic glycolysis forms two pyruvates and a net two ATP.

chapters.title: 氧在末端参与
chapters.caption: 碳形成CO₂；氧在线粒体内膜相关反应中形成水。
chapters.captionEn: Carbon becomes carbon dioxide; oxygen forms water in inner-membrane-linked reactions.

chapters.title: 碳仍有去处
chapters.caption: 酵母形成酒精和CO₂；乳酸发酵不放出CO₂。
chapters.captionEn: Yeast forms ethanol and carbon dioxide; lactate fermentation releases no carbon dioxide.

chapters.title: 把水作为唯一比较条件
chapters.caption: 干纸条保留颜色，湿纸条逐渐褪色。
chapters.captionEn: Dry paper retains its colour while damp paper fades.

chapters.title: 鲜花带着自己的水
chapters.titleEn: A fresh flower brings its own water
chapters.caption: 气体是干燥的，鲜花组织却含有水。
chapters.captionEn: The gas is dry, but fresh flower tissue contains water.

chapters.title: 把观察连接到化学变化
chapters.caption: 氯气与水反应形成HClO，氧化作用改变着色结构。
chapters.captionEn: Chlorine reacts with water to form HOCl, whose oxidizing action changes colour-bearing structures.

chapters.title: 先确认结构身份
chapters.caption: 淋巴内皮标记与血管标记相互区分。
chapters.captionEn: Lymphatic identity markers differ from vascular labels.

chapters.title: 让另一种示踪物检验通路
chapters.caption: 脑脊液示踪物沿路径到达引流方向。
chapters.captionEn: A CSF tracer tests the drainage route.

chapters.title: 先呈递，再匹配
chapters.caption: 辅助T细胞识别呈递的抗原信息。
chapters.captionEn: Helper T cells recognize presented antigen information.

chapters.title: 两个条件共同支持活化
chapters.caption: 相应抗原与辅助信号促成B细胞克隆扩增。
chapters.captionEn: Matching antigen and help support B-cell expansion.

chapters.title: 抗体在细胞外结合
chapters.caption: 浆细胞释放的抗体连续到达相应抗原。
chapters.captionEn: Plasma-cell antibodies reach matching extracellular antigen.

chapters.title: 把目标换成感染细胞
chapters.caption: 细胞毒性T细胞识别后诱导靶细胞凋亡。
chapters.captionEn: Recognition can induce apoptosis of an infected target.

chapters.title: 同一抗原，再遇一次
chapters.caption: 匹配的记忆缩短反应等待；异种抗原需初次反应。
chapters.captionEn: Matching memory accelerates recall; a new antigen needs a primary response.

chapters.title: 三个探头各测什么
chapters.caption: pH和氯离子探头读液相，氧气探头读瓶内气相。
chapters.captionEn: pH and chloride probes read the liquid; the oxygen probe reads the headspace.

chapters.title: 同时观察三个方向
chapters.caption: 光照反应推进时，pH下降，Cl⁻和O₂读数上升。
chapters.captionEn: As photolysis proceeds, pH falls while chloride and oxygen readings rise.

chapters.title: 把变化量放进同一本账
chapters.caption: 净反应每生成2份Cl⁻，对应1份O₂。
chapters.captionEn: The net reaction produces two amounts of chloride for one of oxygen.

chapters.title: 先把色素释放出来
chapters.caption: 破碎叶片，让色素溶入有机溶剂，再过滤。
chapters.captionEn: Break leaf tissue, dissolve pigments in solvent and filter.

chapters.title: 起点必须高于液面
chapters.titleEn: Keep the origin above the liquid
chapters.caption: 让纸接触层析液，让色素细线留在液面上方。
chapters.captionEn: The paper contacts solvent while the pigment line stays above it.

chapters.title: 前沿与色带分开追踪
chapters.caption: 溶剂前沿上升，四类色带以不同距离跟随。
chapters.captionEn: The solvent front rises while four pigment bands follow different distances.

chapters.title: 看透过了多少光
chapters.caption: 绿色附近透过较多，不等于绿色光完全不被吸收。
chapters.captionEn: More green light passes, but green absorption is not zero.

chapters.title: 不同色素补充不同波段
chapters.caption: 三种溶液的光谱不同；溶液谱不等于整片叶的光合效率。
chapters.captionEn: The three solution spectra differ and do not directly measure whole-leaf photosynthetic efficiency.

chapters.title: 先区分观察到的事实
chapters.caption: 1774年获得黄绿色气体，并不等于当时已确认一种元素。
chapters.captionEn: Obtaining a yellow-green gas in 1774 did not yet establish an element.

chapters.title: 解释在后续证据中改变
chapters.caption: 1810年戴维确认氯的元素身份，观察与解释相隔多年。
chapters.captionEn: In 1810 Davy recognized chlorine as an element, years after the original observation.

chapters.title: 追踪连续的气体路径
chapters.caption: 发生瓶、收集瓶和尾气吸收装置必须形成连续路径。
chapters.captionEn: Generator, collector and tail-gas absorber form one continuous path.

chapters.title: 把尾气也纳入物质守恒
chapters.titleEn: Include tail gas in the balance
chapters.caption: NaOH把流出的Cl₂转变为溶液中的Cl⁻和ClO⁻。
chapters.captionEn: Sodium hydroxide converts departing Cl₂ into dissolved Cl⁻ and ClO⁻.

chapters.title: 在氯气中观察火焰
chapters.caption: 氢气可与氯气反应并出现苍白色火焰。
chapters.captionEn: Hydrogen reacts with chlorine and produces a pale flame.

chapters.title: 白雾与无色气体分开看
chapters.caption: HCl气体无色，遇湿空气可形成含酸的细小液滴。
chapters.captionEn: HCl gas is colourless; in moist air it can form fine acid droplets.

chapters.title: 数清重组前后的原子
chapters.caption: 一份H₂与一份Cl₂形成两份HCl，原子种类和数量守恒。
chapters.captionEn: One amount of H₂ and one of Cl₂ form two of HCl, conserving both atom types.

chapters.title: 让细菌指示放氧位置
chapters.caption: 需氧细菌聚集在受光叶绿体附近。
chapters.captionEn: Aerobic bacteria gather near illuminated chloroplast regions.

chapters.title: 让不同波长照到不同位置
chapters.caption: 蓝紫光和红光区域附近，需氧细菌聚集较多。
chapters.captionEn: More bacteria gather near blue-violet and red illumination.

chapters.title: 无CO₂也能放氧
chapters.caption: 离体叶绿体在有光和适宜电子受体时可以放氧。
chapters.captionEn: Isolated chloroplasts can evolve oxygen with light and a suitable electron acceptor.

chapters.title: 标记水，还是标记CO₂
chapters.caption: 水中的氧标记进入放出的O₂。
chapters.captionEn: The oxygen label in water enters evolved O₂.

chapters.title: 光能支持ATP形成
chapters.caption: 叶绿体受光时可把ADP与Pi转成ATP。
chapters.captionEn: Illuminated chloroplasts can convert ADP and phosphate into ATP.

chapters.title: 两处反应相互供给
chapters.caption: 类囊体膜形成ATP与NADPH，基质中的碳反应消耗它们。
chapters.captionEn: Thylakoid reactions supply ATP and NADPH consumed by stromal carbon reactions.

chapters.title: 跟随碳标记进入有机物
chapters.titleEn: Follow labeled carbon into organic matter
chapters.caption: ¹⁴CO₂的标记进入C₃和后续糖类。
chapters.captionEn: The label from ¹⁴CO₂ enters three-carbon compounds and later sugars.

chapters.title: 先让所有圆片下沉
chapters.caption: 抽去细胞间隙中的气体，让水进入。
chapters.captionEn: Remove intercellular gas and replace it with water.

chapters.title: 比较同一时间的上浮
chapters.caption: 同样十片圆片，上浮速度随光强与气体净积累改变。
chapters.captionEn: Matched sets of ten discs rise as light changes net gas accumulation.

chapters.title: 先保留，再去掉尖端
chapters.caption: 完整胚芽鞘向光弯曲；去尖端组不再出现相同反应。
chapters.captionEn: The intact coleoptile bends toward light; removing its tip changes the response.

chapters.title: 把遮光位置换一下
chapters.caption: 尖端遮光与下段遮光，区分感光和弯曲部位。
chapters.captionEn: Shading the tip or lower region separates sensing from bending.

chapters.title: 在尖端下放琼脂
chapters.caption: 影响可以跨过琼脂间隔。
chapters.captionEn: The growth-promoting influence can cross an agar gap.

chapters.title: 让通路受到阻隔
chapters.caption: 允许传递与阻隔传递，形成路径对照。
chapters.captionEn: Allowing and blocking passage provide a pathway comparison.

chapters.title: 黑暗中偏放尖端
chapters.caption: 没有单侧光，偏置来源仍能形成两侧差异。
chapters.captionEn: An off-center source produces asymmetric growth in darkness.

chapters.title: 交换偏置的方向
chapters.caption: 来源换到另一侧，弯曲方向随之改变。
chapters.captionEn: Reversing the off-center source reverses the bend.

chapters.title: 让尖端先接触琼脂
chapters.titleEn: Condition the agar with a tip
chapters.caption: 代表标记跨过接触面，进入琼脂。
chapters.captionEn: Persistent representative markers cross the tip–agar contact.

chapters.title: 处理过与空白琼脂
chapters.caption: 偏放处理过的琼脂与空白块，产生不同结果。
chapters.captionEn: Offset conditioned and blank agar produce different responses.

chapters.title: 同一浓度，不同器官
chapters.caption: 根、芽、茎的响应区间不同。
chapters.captionEn: Roots, buds and stems have different response ranges.

chapters.title: 促生长也有范围
chapters.caption: 更高浓度可以越过促进区，进入抑制区。
chapters.captionEn: Higher concentrations can move beyond promotion into inhibition.

chapters.title: 只有正向阳性
chapters.caption: 一个阳性结果同时符合两个方向假说。
chapters.captionEn: One forward positive is compatible with both direction hypotheses.

chapters.title: 补上反向和空白
chapters.caption: 倒置茎段与无供体条件，帮助区分解释。
chapters.captionEn: An inverted segment and no-donor condition distinguish explanations.

chapters.title: 先复制DNA
chapters.caption: DNA复制后，染色体数不立即加倍。
chapters.captionEn: DNA replication does not immediately double chromosome number.

chapters.title: 把复制后的染色体排好
chapters.caption: 姐妹染色单体分别连接相对两极的纺锤丝。
chapters.captionEn: Sister chromatids attach toward opposite spindle poles.

chapters.title: 分开后，各有一套
chapters.caption: 姐妹染色单体分开成为子染色体，分别向两极移动。
chapters.captionEn: Sisters become daughter chromosomes and move toward opposite poles.

chapters.title: 重新建立两个细胞
chapters.caption: 植物形成细胞板；动物通过分裂沟完成胞质分裂。
chapters.captionEn: Plants form a cell plate; animal cells divide through a cleavage furrow.

chapters.title: 同样深度，不同占比
chapters.caption: 立方体越大，表面积与体积之比越小。
chapters.captionEn: Larger cubes have less surface area per unit volume.

chapters.title: 固定后才能清楚比较
chapters.caption: 解离、漂洗、染色和压片，使细胞分散并显示染色体。
chapters.captionEn: Dissociation, rinsing, staining and squashing separate cells and reveal chromosomes.

chapters.title: 换一个细胞，不是等它分裂
chapters.titleEn: Change cells, not their fixed stage
chapters.caption: 视野保持固定，只移动观察位置并统计时期。
chapters.captionEn: The field remains fixed while observation and stage counting move between cells.

chapters.title: 同一试剂比较两种铁离子
chapters.titleEn: Compare two iron ions with one reagent
chapters.caption: 含Fe³⁺的溶液遇SCN⁻显红色，Fe²⁺对照不出现同样红色。
chapters.captionEn: Fe³⁺ gives a red thiocyanate response; the Fe²⁺ control does not.

chapters.title: 先用铁粉还原
chapters.caption: 铁粉把Fe³⁺转变为Fe²⁺；随后SCN⁻检验的红色不再出现。
chapters.captionEn: Iron powder converts Fe³⁺ to Fe²⁺, removing the subsequent red thiocyanate response.

chapters.title: 把清液与剩余铁粉分开
chapters.caption: 转移上层清液，让剩余铁粉留在原管。
chapters.captionEn: Transfer the supernatant while leaving residual iron powder behind.

chapters.title: 氧化后红色重新出现
chapters.caption: 清液中的Fe²⁺被氧化为Fe³⁺，与已有SCN⁻重新显色。
chapters.captionEn: Fe²⁺ is oxidized to Fe³⁺, restoring colour with the thiocyanate already present.

chapters.title: 先保留原平衡参照
chapters.caption: 把同一红色平衡溶液分为三份，a管保持原状。
chapters.captionEn: Divide the same red equilibrium mixture into three portions and retain tube a unchanged.

chapters.title: 消耗Fe³⁺使红色减弱
chapters.titleEn: Consuming Fe³⁺ weakens the red colour
chapters.caption: b管铁粉消耗Fe³⁺，平衡体系中的有色配合物减少。
chapters.captionEn: Iron in tube b consumes Fe³⁺, reducing the amount of coloured complex.

chapters.title: 增加配体使红色加深
chapters.titleEn: Adding ligand deepens the red colour
chapters.caption: c管增加SCN⁻，更多铁进入有色配合物。
chapters.captionEn: More SCN⁻ in tube c shifts additional iron into coloured complexes.

chapters.title: 显色来自配离子
chapters.titleEn: Colour belongs to the complex ions
chapters.caption: 配体结合产生有色配离子，Fe的形式价态仍为+3。
chapters.captionEn: Ligand binding forms coloured complex ions while iron remains formally +3.

chapters.title: 菌体留下，可溶物通过
chapters.caption: 无菌体滤液把感染与可溶性作用分开。
chapters.captionEn: Cell-free filtrate separates infection from a soluble effect.

chapters.title: 把滤液作用与感染分开
chapters.caption: 同龄水稻接受不同液体，比较伸长。
chapters.captionEn: Matched rice seedlings receive different liquids.

chapters.title: 先用宽梯度摸索
chapters.caption: 逐组观察三根插条，保留个体根数。
chapters.captionEn: Observe three cuttings per dose and retain individual counts.

chapters.title: 缩小比较范围
chapters.caption: 在预实验提示的范围附近增加比较。
chapters.captionEn: Add comparisons near the promising preliminary range.

chapters.title: 从原始计数得到结论
chapters.caption: 均值来自原始记录；最佳已测组仍需限定。
chapters.captionEn: Means come from individual records; the best tested group has limits.

chapters.title: 先看释放条件
chapters.caption: 较低pH下较稳定，升高后释放更明显。
chapters.captionEn: Lower pH favors stability; higher pH increases release.

chapters.title: 处理组要配对应对照
chapters.caption: 同一初始成熟度下，同时比较颜色与硬度。
chapters.captionEn: At matched initial maturity, compare color and firmness.

chapters.title: 检查起点是否相同
chapters.caption: 初始成熟度不同，会混入处理效果。
chapters.captionEn: Different starting maturity confounds the treatment effect.

chapters.title: 先追踪水的去向
chapters.caption: 湿棉花提供水蒸气，导向同一管中的铁粉区域。
chapters.captionEn: Damp cotton supplies steam that passes toward the iron powder.

chapters.title: 红热条件下发生反应
chapters.caption: 红热铁与水蒸气反应，生成Fe₃O₄和H₂。
chapters.captionEn: Red-hot iron reacts with steam to produce Fe₃O₄ and H₂.

chapters.title: 用气体证据检验解释
chapters.titleEn: Test the explanation with gas evidence
chapters.caption: 气泡显示有气体经过；可燃性与物料分析共同支持氢气生成。
chapters.captionEn: Bubbles show gas passage; combustibility and the reaction account support hydrogen production.

chapters.title: 在条件中重新发育
chapters.caption: 分化的植物细胞可在适宜条件下表现全能性。
chapters.captionEn: Differentiated plant cells can express totipotency under suitable conditions.

chapters.title: 相同条件，比较增殖代数
chapters.caption: 教材数据描述特定培养比较，不预测人的寿命。
chapters.captionEn: The textbook comparison does not predict human lifespan.

chapters.title: 分别追踪核与质
chapters.caption: 先准确呈现教材的核质交换描述。
chapters.captionEn: First reconstruct the textbook’s stated nuclear-exchange comparison.

chapters.title: 核与质都需要研究
chapters.caption: 原始研究表明，年轻核并不保证恢复旺盛增殖。
chapters.captionEn: Original studies show that a young nucleus does not guarantee vigorous proliferation.

chapters.title: 追踪每一个分支
chapters.caption: 正常发育也包括特定细胞按程序死亡。
chapters.captionEn: Normal development includes programmed deaths of specific cells.

chapters.title: 改变执行，比较命运
chapters.caption: 凋亡执行基因缺失，原本会死亡的细胞可以保留。
chapters.captionEn: Loss of death-execution genes can preserve cells normally destined to die.

chapters.title: 同样滴碱，两种沉淀
chapters.caption: Fe³⁺生成红褐色沉淀；新生Fe(OH)₂很快受空气影响。
chapters.captionEn: Fe³⁺ gives a brown precipitate; freshly formed Fe(OH)₂ is quickly affected by air.

chapters.title: 追踪空气带来的改变
chapters.titleEn: Follow the change caused by air
chapters.caption: O₂参与，Fe(OH)₂逐步转成含三价铁的沉淀。
chapters.captionEn: O₂ participates as Fe(OH)₂ changes into a precipitate containing Fe(III).

chapters.title: 四个铁中心，一个氧分子
chapters.titleEn: Four iron centres, one oxygen molecule
chapters.caption: 每消耗1份O₂，最多使4份Fe(II)氧化成Fe(III)。
chapters.captionEn: One amount of O₂ can oxidize at most four amounts of Fe(II) to Fe(III).

chapters.title: 把氧气作为对照条件
chapters.titleEn: Use oxygen as the comparison condition
chapters.caption: 隔绝O₂与有O₂的理想对照分离了沉淀和后续氧化。
chapters.captionEn: An ideal comparison with and without O₂ separates precipitation from later oxidation.

chapters.title: 先控制花粉来自哪里
chapters.caption: 去雄与隔离，使杂交后代的来源可以解释。
chapters.captionEn: Emasculation and isolation make offspring parentage interpretable.

chapters.title: 第一代为什么都是高茎
chapters.titleEn: Why are the first offspring tall?
chapters.caption: DD与dd杂交，后代都获得D和d。
chapters.captionEn: A DD by dd cross gives every offspring D and d.

chapters.title: 隐性性状重新出现
chapters.caption: F1自交得到三种基因型、两种表型。
chapters.captionEn: Selfing the first-generation hybrid yields three genotypes and two phenotypes.

chapters.title: 每次取球，都放回
chapters.titleEn: Replace the balls after each draw
chapters.caption: 随机模拟会波动，三比一是概率预期。
chapters.captionEn: Random samples fluctuate; three to one is a probability prediction.

chapters.title: 用新实验检验解释
chapters.titleEn: Test the explanation with a new cross
chapters.caption: 杂合子与隐性纯合子测交，预测表型一比一。
chapters.captionEn: A heterozygote crossed with a recessive homozygote predicts equal phenotypes.

chapters.title: 同时追踪两对性状
chapters.caption: 黄色圆粒与绿色皱粒的纯种杂交，F1为双杂合子。
chapters.captionEn: Pure yellow-round and green-wrinkled parents produce a double heterozygote.

chapters.title: 四种配子，十六种结合
chapters.caption: 独立分配与随机受精，共同产生九比三比三比一。
chapters.captionEn: Independent assortment and random fertilization generate nine to three to three to one.

chapters.title: 让四种配子显露出来
chapters.caption: 双隐性测交把双杂合子的配子组成变成后代表型。
chapters.captionEn: A double-recessive tester reveals the hybrid’s gamete classes in its offspring.

chapters.title: 光先改变受体状态
chapters.caption: 光敏色素在细胞内感受光信号。
chapters.captionEn: Intracellular phytochrome responds to light.

chapters.title: 状态变化连到表达
chapters.caption: 光信号影响核内表达，并产生发育响应。
chapters.captionEn: Light signaling influences nuclear expression and development.

chapters.title: 同样温暖，经历不同
chapters.caption: 所选冬性类型需要先前低温经历。
chapters.captionEn: The selected winter type depends on previous cold exposure.

chapters.title: 把季节变化留在木质部
chapters.caption: 较大的早材与较致密的晚材构成环带。
chapters.captionEn: Larger earlywood and denser latewood form contrasting bands.

chapters.title: 在细胞里感受方向
chapters.caption: 淀粉体沿重力方向沉降，保持在细胞内。
chapters.captionEn: Amyloplasts sediment with gravity inside the cell.

chapters.title: 根与茎的响应不同
chapters.caption: 同一方向的差异，产生相反的两侧伸长关系。
chapters.captionEn: A shared directional asymmetry produces opposite elongation patterns.

chapters.title: 处理根冠，也保留对照
chapters.titleEn: Treat the cap and retain controls
chapters.caption: 完整、去根冠与假处理，放在相同条件下。
chapters.captionEn: Compare intact, decapped and sham-treated roots.

chapters.title: 检查弯曲与继续伸长
chapters.caption: 去根冠后弯曲减弱，同时仍能伸长。
chapters.captionEn: Reduced bending is interpreted alongside continued elongation.

chapters.title: 停长是另一种解释
chapters.caption: 伤及生长区的不弯曲，不能定位感受部位。
chapters.captionEn: No bending after growth injury cannot locate the sensor.

chapters.title: 先辨认三层材料
chapters.caption: 保护层覆盖要保留的铜；绝缘板在铜箔下面。
chapters.captionEn: Resist covers the copper to retain; the insulating board lies beneath the foil.

chapters.title: 从剖面观察铜的去向
chapters.caption: 裸露铜进入溶液；被完整保护的铜仍留在基材上。
chapters.captionEn: Exposed copper enters solution; copper beneath intact resist remains on the board.

chapters.title: 一份铜对应两份三价铁
chapters.titleEn: One copper amount uses two ferric amounts
chapters.caption: Cu失去2个电子；2份Fe³⁺各接受1个电子。
chapters.captionEn: Copper loses two electrons; two Fe³⁺ amounts each accept one.

chapters.title: 移去保护层，检查留下的铜
chapters.titleEn: Remove the resist and inspect the copper
chapters.caption: 图案来自选择性保留；没有保护层，铜会全部暴露。
chapters.captionEn: The pattern comes from selective retention; without resist, all copper is exposed.

chapters.title: 先遇到的是表面氧化膜
chapters.titleEn: The solution first meets the oxide film
chapters.caption: Al₂O₃溶于酸，这一步不生成H₂。
chapters.captionEn: Al₂O₃ dissolves in acid without producing H₂ in this step.

chapters.title: 膜后面的金属开始产氢
chapters.caption: 氧化膜去除后，Al与酸反应生成H₂。
chapters.captionEn: Once the oxide is removed, Al reacts with acid to form H₂.

chapters.title: 有膜与去膜的同条件比较
chapters.titleEn: Compare coated and stripped surfaces in base
chapters.caption: NaOH能溶解氧化膜；去膜铝更早显示产氢。
chapters.captionEn: NaOH can dissolve the oxide; stripped aluminium shows hydrogen sooner.

chapters.title: 酸与碱都能带走氧化膜
chapters.titleEn: Both acid and base can dissolve the film
chapters.caption: Al₂O₃具有两性；碱中用[Al(OH)₄]⁻表示溶解的铝。
chapters.captionEn: Al₂O₃ is amphoteric; dissolved aluminium in base is represented by [Al(OH)₄]⁻.

chapters.title: 从食物得到试验样品
chapters.titleEn: Obtain a sample from the food
chapters.caption: 研磨与水提取，是把待检组分带入液体的准备步骤。
chapters.captionEn: Grinding and water extraction prepare liquid containing recoverable components.

chapters.title: 过滤分开了什么
chapters.caption: 滤渣被截留；滤液只含被带出的部分待检组分。
chapters.captionEn: Residue is retained; the filtrate carries only the recovered portion.

chapters.title: 把显色所需的价态准备好
chapters.titleEn: Prepare the oxidation state needed for the test
chapters.caption: 稀硝酸的氧化作用，为Fe³⁺显色检验作准备。
chapters.captionEn: The oxidizing action of dilute nitric acid prepares Fe³⁺ for the colour test.

chapters.title: 显色证据与阴性结果
chapters.titleEn: Colour evidence and a negative result
chapters.caption: 显红支持可检Fe³⁺存在；不显红不能直接排除食品含铁。
chapters.captionEn: Red colour supports accessible Fe³⁺; no red colour alone does not exclude iron in the food.

chapters.title: 铁丝上为什么出现铜
chapters.caption: 铁被氧化为Fe²⁺，Cu²⁺被还原成铜。
chapters.captionEn: Iron is oxidized to Fe²⁺ as Cu²⁺ is reduced to copper.

chapters.title: 三价铁让铜进入溶液
chapters.caption: 2份Fe³⁺转为Fe²⁺，使1份铜氧化成Cu²⁺。
chapters.captionEn: Two Fe³⁺ amounts become Fe²⁺ as one copper amount becomes Cu²⁺.

chapters.title: 碘与淀粉提供第二条证据
chapters.titleEn: Iodine and starch provide another clue
chapters.caption: Fe³⁺氧化I⁻生成碘，随后淀粉显示蓝色。
chapters.captionEn: Fe³⁺ oxidizes I⁻ to iodine; added starch then gives a blue colour.

chapters.title: 亚铁离子也能接受电子
chapters.titleEn: Ferrous ions can also accept electrons
chapters.caption: Zn被氧化，Fe²⁺被还原为铁。
chapters.captionEn: Zinc is oxidized as Fe²⁺ is reduced to iron.

chapters.title: 先褪紫，再检验生成的三价铁
chapters.titleEn: Lose purple, then test the ferric product
chapters.caption: 酸性MnO₄⁻被还原；紫色褪去后KSCN检验生成的Fe³⁺。
chapters.captionEn: Acidified MnO₄⁻ is reduced; after purple disappears, KSCN tests the Fe³⁺ formed.

chapters.title: 先建立三价铁显色对照
chapters.caption: Fe³⁺与SCN⁻配位显红，铁的价态仍为+3。
chapters.captionEn: Fe³⁺ coordinates with SCN⁻ and appears red, while iron remains at +3.

chapters.title: 先用铁粉还原，再加入检验试剂
chapters.titleEn: Reduce with iron before adding the test reagent
chapters.caption: 足量铁粉先还原Fe³⁺，随后KSCN不再显示原来的红色。
chapters.captionEn: Sufficient iron first reduces Fe³⁺; subsequent KSCN no longer gives the original red colour.

chapters.title: 沿诱捕装置进入
chapters.caption: 同一批昆虫中，趋光反应不同。
chapters.captionEn: The same insect population contains different light responses.

chapters.title: 环境改变检测机会
chapters.caption: 种群未变，活动条件改变也会改变捕获量。
chapters.captionEn: Catch can change while the underlying population stays fixed.

chapters.title: 先捕获并标记
chapters.caption: 首捕个体进入暂留区，再获得标记。
chapters.captionEn: Initially captured individuals move to the holding area and receive marks.

chapters.title: 放回，再让它们混合
chapters.caption: 标记个体回到原种群，身份保留。
chapters.captionEn: Marked animals return to the same population.

chapters.title: 从重捕比例估算
chapters.caption: 用首捕数、重捕数及其中标记数共同估计。
chapters.captionEn: Use initial marks, total recaptures and recognized marks together.

chapters.title: 先抽坐标，再数植物
chapters.caption: 随机样方取自同一块固定草地。
chapters.captionEn: Random quadrats sample one fixed meadow.

chapters.title: 给边界一个一致约定
chapters.caption: 按根基部计上左，不计下右。
chapters.captionEn: Count stem bases on top and left, excluding bottom and right.

chapters.title: 样方多，也不能只挑密集区
chapters.titleEn: More plots do not repair biased selection
chapters.caption: 只挑茂盛位置改变了取样机会。
chapters.captionEn: Choosing dense patches changes inclusion probabilities.

chapters.title: 一只动物可以留下多张影像
chapters.titleEn: One animal can produce many images
chapters.caption: 同侧花纹帮助辨认重复记录。
chapters.captionEn: Same-flank patterns help identify repeated records.

chapters.title: 比较多个DNA位点
chapters.caption: 多位点组合用于归并样本，缺失不能强行匹配。
chapters.captionEn: Multilocus combinations support matching; missing evidence stays unresolved.

chapters.title: 声纹也要经过验证
chapters.caption: 声音特征可辅助识别，漏检仍需处理。
chapters.captionEn: Acoustic features can support identification; incomplete detection remains.

chapters.title: 复制一次，同源配对
chapters.caption: 每条染色体形成姐妹染色单体，同源染色体联会。
chapters.captionEn: Each chromosome forms sisters, and homologous chromosomes pair.

chapters.title: 保留身份，交换对应片段
chapters.caption: 交换发生在同源染色体的非姐妹染色单体之间。
chapters.captionEn: Reciprocal exchange occurs between non-sister chromatids of homologs.

chapters.title: 第一次，分开同源染色体
chapters.caption: 同源染色体分离，姐妹染色单体仍相连。
chapters.captionEn: Homologs separate while sister chromatids remain associated.

chapters.title: 第二次，分开姐妹
chapters.caption: 两次分裂之间不再复制DNA，最终形成四个单倍体细胞。
chapters.captionEn: No new DNA replication separates the divisions; four haploid cells result.

chapters.title: 改变朝向，改变配套
chapters.caption: 非同源染色体独立分配，产生不同的配子组合。
chapters.captionEn: Independent assortment changes combinations among gametes.

chapters.title: 两套汇合，恢复成对
chapters.titleEn: Combine two sets and restore pairing
chapters.caption: 精、卵各提供一套，受精卵恢复二倍体配套。
chapters.captionEn: Egg and sperm each contribute one set, restoring the diploid complement.

chapters.title: 在不同细胞中寻找时期
chapters.titleEn: Find stages in different fixed cells
chapters.caption: 固定装片里的同一细胞不会继续完成分裂。
chapters.captionEn: A cell in a fixed preparation does not continue dividing.

chapters.title: 平行行为支持新假说
chapters.caption: 成对、分离与重新组合，使染色体成为遗传因子的候选载体。
chapters.captionEn: Pairing, segregation and recombination suggest chromosomes can carry inherited factors.

chapters.title: 氯水与溴离子
chapters.caption: 与氯水参照比较，Br₂生成带来黄橙色。
chapters.captionEn: Compared with chlorine-water reference, Br₂ formation gives yellow-orange colour.

chapters.title: 同一氧化剂，换成碘离子
chapters.caption: 氯水能氧化I⁻，产生含碘的棕色。
chapters.captionEn: Chlorine water oxidizes I⁻, producing a brown iodine-containing solution.

chapters.title: 溴水也能置换碘
chapters.caption: Br₂能氧化I⁻，三组证据支持Cl₂ > Br₂ > I₂。
chapters.captionEn: Br₂ oxidizes I⁻; the three comparisons support Cl₂ > Br₂ > I₂.

chapters.title: 把镁放进冷水
chapters.caption: 冷水中反应不明显；比较时要记录温度与表面条件。
chapters.captionEn: Reaction is not appreciable in cold water; temperature and surface condition matter.

chapters.title: 加热后追踪产物
chapters.caption: 热水中现象增强；H₂与Mg(OH)₂对应水和镁的转化。
chapters.captionEn: Heating makes the reaction more evident; H₂ and Mg(OH)₂ account for water and magnesium.

chapters.title: 先制得两种白色沉淀
chapters.caption: 氨水分别使Al³⁺与Mg²⁺形成白色氢氧化物沉淀。
chapters.captionEn: Aqueous ammonia produces white hydroxide precipitates from Al³⁺ and Mg²⁺.

chapters.title: 酸让两种沉淀都减少
chapters.caption: Al(OH)₃与Mg(OH)₂都能消耗H⁺而溶解。
chapters.captionEn: Al(OH)₃ and Mg(OH)₂ both consume H⁺ and dissolve.

chapters.title: 强碱把两者区分开
chapters.caption: Al(OH)₃溶于强碱形成[Al(OH)₄]⁻，Mg(OH)₂保持沉淀。
chapters.captionEn: Al(OH)₃ dissolves in strong base as [Al(OH)₄]⁻; Mg(OH)₂ remains precipitated.

chapters.title: 每一代怎样得到下一代
chapters.titleEn: From one generation to the next
chapters.caption: 亮色是当前一代，祖先节点不是额外活细胞。
chapters.captionEn: The highlighted generation is alive; ancestor nodes are history.

chapters.title: 把规则写成预测
chapters.titleEn: Turn the rule into a prediction
chapters.caption: 倍增能外推很大数值，仍须用观察验证。
chapters.captionEn: Doubling extrapolates huge values that still require testing.

chapters.title: 先读历史培养观察
chapters.caption: 教材描述0.5 mL中从5个增至约375个。
chapters.captionEn: The textbook describes 5 cells rising to about 375 in 0.5 mL.

chapters.title: 让限制进入增长模型
chapters.caption: 曲线是独立模型；K取决于环境条件。
chapters.captionEn: This curve is a separate model; K depends on conditions.

chapters.title: 先把培养液混匀
chapters.caption: 固定示踪细胞从沉降状态重新分散。
chapters.captionEn: The same tracer cells disperse from a settled state.

chapters.title: 盖片到位，再充液
chapters.caption: 小样沿盖片边缘进入已知深度的计数室。
