chapters.captionEn: The aliquot fills a chamber with a known depth.

chapters.title: 由数格子换算浓度
chapters.titleEn: Convert a counted volume to concentration
chapters.caption: 计上左、不计下右；倍率来自这块格子的体积。
chapters.captionEn: Include top and left; derive the factor from this square’s volume.

chapters.title: 先有计数，再看变化
chapters.caption: 每天重复计数，缺测保持空白。
chapters.captionEn: Repeat daily counts; missing observations remain blank.

chapters.title: 不同植物的调查响应
chapters.caption: 不同物种对郁闭度的调查响应不同。
chapters.captionEn: Species respond differently to canopy closure.

chapters.title: 相关线索还要检验
chapters.caption: 降水、温度和日长可以同时改变。
chapters.captionEn: Rainfall, temperature and day length can change together.

chapters.title: 实心球是历史起点
chapters.titleEn: The solid sphere as a historical starting point
chapters.caption: 道尔顿模型把原子视为不可再分的实心球。
chapters.captionEn: Dalton’s model treats atoms as indivisible solid spheres.

chapters.title: 原子内部出现电子
chapters.caption: 电子的发现要求原子具有内部结构。
chapters.captionEn: The discovery of electrons requires internal atomic structure.

chapters.title: 正电荷集中到原子核
chapters.titleEn: Positive charge concentrates in a nucleus
chapters.caption: 核式模型把正电荷与主要质量集中到很小的中心。
chapters.captionEn: The nuclear model concentrates positive charge and most mass in a small centre.

chapters.title: 允许的能量变成离散值
chapters.caption: 玻尔模型用离散能级解释氢原子光谱的规律。
chapters.captionEn: Bohr’s model uses discrete energy levels to explain hydrogen spectral patterns.

chapters.title: 电子云不是一群电子
chapters.titleEn: An electron cloud is not many electrons
chapters.caption: 许多小点表示同一状态的概率分布，不表示许多电子。
chapters.captionEn: Many dots represent one state’s probability distribution, not many electrons.

chapters.title: 轮廓包围的是概率
chapters.caption: 概率轮廓不是硬边界，轮廓之外仍有非零概率。
chapters.captionEn: A probability contour is not a hard boundary; probability remains outside it.

chapters.title: 球对称不等于相同大小
chapters.titleEn: Spherical symmetry does not mean equal size
chapters.caption: 同一长度尺度下，2s比1s更弥散。
chapters.captionEn: On the same length scale, 2s is more diffuse than 1s.

chapters.title: p轨道的三个取向
chapters.caption: 2p的三个取向相互垂直，每一幅都是单独的概率分布。
chapters.captionEn: The three 2p orientations are perpendicular; each view is a separate probability distribution.

chapters.title: 先看杂交第一代
chapters.caption: 纯合红眼雌蝇与白眼雄蝇杂交，F1都表现红眼。
chapters.captionEn: A homozygous red-eyed female and white-eyed male produce red-eyed F1 offspring.

chapters.title: 把性别一起记下来
chapters.titleEn: Record sex as well as eye color
chapters.caption: F1雌雄交配，模型中的白眼后代都是雄性。
chapters.captionEn: When F1 flies mate, white-eyed offspring in this model are male.

chapters.title: 测交检验新预测
chapters.caption: 杂合红眼雌蝇与白眼雄蝇测交，四类后代可各占四分之一。
chapters.captionEn: A heterozygous red-eyed female crossed with a white-eyed male predicts four equal classes.

chapters.title: 亲本角色交换后会怎样
chapters.titleEn: What changes when parental roles reverse?
chapters.caption: 白眼雌蝇与红眼雄蝇杂交，女儿红眼、儿子白眼。
chapters.captionEn: A white-eyed female crossed with a red-eyed male predicts red daughters and white sons.

chapters.title: 先比较观察记录
chapters.caption: 同样的花朵与照明，不同观察者报告了不同颜色。
chapters.captionEn: Different observers reported different colors for the same flower and illumination.

chapters.title: 沿真实家系保留不确定性
chapters.titleEn: Follow the pedigree without erasing uncertainty
chapters.caption: 受影响父亲可把X传给女儿，再由女儿传给儿子。
chapters.captionEn: An affected father can transmit his X through a daughter to her son.

chapters.title: 先明确被调查的人群
chapters.caption: 人群比例的分母是被调查人数，不是家系中的配子概率。
chapters.captionEn: A surveyed proportion uses surveyed people as its denominator, not gamete probabilities.

chapters.title: 合并人数，而不是平均百分比
chapters.titleEn: Pool people instead of averaging percentages
chapters.caption: 不同样本量需要加权，重复登记的人只能计算一次。
chapters.captionEn: Different sample sizes require weighting, and each person is counted once.

chapters.title: 把元素排进周期
chapters.caption: 原子序数决定顺序；同一列保留相似的价层结构。
chapters.captionEn: Atomic number fixes the order; columns align related valence structures.

chapters.title: 同一元素，两种布局
chapters.caption: 抽出的14格重新插入，元素身份与先后顺序保持不变。
chapters.captionEn: The detached 14 cells rejoin each long period without changing element identities.

chapters.title: 一周期怎样闭合
chapters.caption: 第三周期依次填入3s、3p，氩完成价层排布。
chapters.captionEn: Period three fills 3s and then 3p, ending with argon’s filled valence shell.

chapters.title: 排布规则的边界
chapters.caption: Cr与Cu的实测基态排布提醒我们：简易填充顺序不是完整计算。
chapters.captionEn: Observed Cr and Cu configurations expose limits of the simple filling mnemonic.

chapters.title: 第三周期的电负性
chapters.caption: 教材电负性从Na到Cl增大；Ar的空白不代表零。
chapters.captionEn: Textbook electronegativities rise from Na to Cl; Ar’s blank is not zero.

chapters.title: 沿碱金属族向下
chapters.caption: Li到Cs总体减小；教材舍入使K与Rb显示相同值。
chapters.captionEn: Values decrease overall from Li to Cs; textbook rounding makes K and Rb equal.

chapters.title: 沿卤素族向下
chapters.caption: F、Cl、Br、I的教材电负性依次降低。
chapters.captionEn: Textbook electronegativities fall from F through Cl and Br to I.

chapters.title: 另一种性质，另一条曲线
chapters.caption: 第一电离能在Mg→Al、P→S处下降，并非一路上升。
chapters.captionEn: First ionization energy falls at Mg→Al and P→S instead of rising at every step.

chapters.title: 先看分别单独培养
chapters.caption: 单养记录给出每个物种自己的参照。
chapters.captionEn: Monocultures provide a reference for each species.

chapters.title: 放到共享条件中
chapters.caption: 混养改变大草履虫的增长；采样末值仍应如实保留。
chapters.captionEn: Mixed culture suppresses P. caudatum; preserve the recorded endpoint.

chapters.title: 把竞争假设单独建模
chapters.caption: 减小资源重叠，会改变模型中的相互限制。
chapters.captionEn: Reduced overlap changes mutual limitation in the model.

chapters.title: 长期记录中的相邻波峰
chapters.caption: 两条记录分别归一化，不能读成两种动物同样多。
chapters.captionEn: Each series is normalized separately; equal height is not equal abundance.

chapters.title: 从单向箭头到反馈
chapters.caption: 雪兔影响猞猁的食物，猞猁又影响雪兔死亡。
chapters.captionEn: Hares affect lynx food supply; lynx affect hare mortality.

chapters.title: 用交叉处理检验解释
chapters.caption: 补食与减少捕食者的合并效果，不是简单相加。
chapters.captionEn: The combined effect differs from simple addition.

chapters.title: 先改变捕食者
chapters.caption: 追踪移除动作，岩面与初始占位保持不变。
chapters.captionEn: Follow removal while retaining the rock surface and initial occupancy.

chapters.title: 空位先被谁占据
chapters.caption: 藤壶先扩展，占位总面积始终守恒。
chapters.captionEn: Barnacles expand first while total surface area is conserved.

chapters.title: 后来的优势者继续挤占空间
chapters.caption: 贻贝扩展，捕食与空间竞争共同改变群落。
chapters.captionEn: Mussel expansion connects predation with competition for space.

chapters.title: 四组对照，出现新结果
chapters.titleEn: Four groups reveal a new result
chapters.caption: R型活菌与热致死S型混合后，出现与两者单独不同的结果。
chapters.captionEn: Live R plus heat-killed S gives a different result from either alone.

chapters.title: 分离活菌，再看后代
chapters.titleEn: Recover live bacteria and examine descendants
chapters.caption: 混合组分离出的S型活菌能继续产生S型后代。
chapters.captionEn: Live S bacteria recovered from the mixture produce S descendants.

chapters.title: 把问题转到培养物
chapters.caption: S型细胞提取物使培养物中的部分R型发生转化。
chapters.captionEn: S-cell extract transforms some R cells in culture.

chapters.title: 逐一破坏，追问必要成分
chapters.caption: 蛋白酶、RNA酶和酯酶后仍可转化，DNA酶处理后失去活性。
chapters.captionEn: Activity remains after protease, RNase or lipase, but is lost after DNase.

chapters.title: 两批同位素，分别追踪
chapters.caption: 先通过带标记的宿主培养噬菌体，再感染未标记宿主。
chapters.captionEn: Grow labeled phage through labeled hosts, then infect unlabeled hosts.

chapters.title: 跟住外壳与DNA
chapters.caption: 主要路径是DNA经尾部进入宿主，蛋白质外壳留在外侧。
chapters.captionEn: The dominant path sends DNA through the tail while the coat remains outside.

chapters.title: 先脱离，再分层检测
chapters.caption: 搅拌分开吸附外壳，离心区分细菌沉淀与上清液。
chapters.captionEn: Blending detaches coats; centrifugation separates bacteria from the supernatant.

chapters.title: 再问标记能否进入子代
chapters.titleEn: Ask whether parental label reaches progeny
chapters.caption: 子代证据支持DNA的遗传作用，同时保留真实研究的限定。
chapters.captionEn: Progeny evidence supports a hereditary role for DNA, with experimental qualifications.

chapters.title: 一电子转移的记账
chapters.caption: Na失去一个电子、Cl得到一个电子，总电子数不变。
chapters.captionEn: Na loses one electron and Cl gains one; the total stays unchanged.

chapters.title: 吸引延伸到晶格
chapters.caption: 氯化钠晶体里，一个Na⁺有六个最近Cl⁻邻居。
chapters.captionEn: In a sodium chloride crystal, each Na⁺ has six nearest Cl⁻ neighbors.

chapters.title: 两核共用一对电子
chapters.caption: 两个Cl各提供一个电子，形成共用电子对。
chapters.captionEn: Each Cl contributes an electron to a shared pair.

chapters.title: 共用可以不均匀
chapters.caption: HCl仍是共用电子，但电子分布偏向Cl。
chapters.captionEn: HCl still shares electrons, with the distribution biased toward Cl.

chapters.title: s与s：核间相连
chapters.caption: 两个s型基函数重叠，核间方向没有π型节点。
chapters.captionEn: Two s-shaped bases overlap without a pi-type node along the internuclear axis.

chapters.title: s与p：沿轴重叠
chapters.caption: s区与一个p瓣沿核间轴相遇，仍属于σ型重叠。
chapters.captionEn: An s region meets a p lobe along the internuclear axis: sigma-type overlap.

chapters.title: 头碰头的p重叠
chapters.caption: 两侧p瓣沿核间轴相对，形成σ型重叠。
chapters.captionEn: Opposing p lobes meet end-on to give sigma-type overlap.

chapters.title: 肩并肩与节点
chapters.caption: π型分布在轴的两侧；包含核间轴的节点面密度为零。
chapters.captionEn: Pi density lies on either side of the axis, with a nodal plane containing it.

chapters.title: 方向改变，重叠改变
chapters.caption: 仅转动一个p方向，重叠积分在相互垂直时变为零。
chapters.captionEn: Rotate one p direction: the overlap integral reaches zero at orthogonality.

chapters.title: 把生境记录放回湿地
chapters.titleEn: Place habitat records in a wetland
chapters.caption: 出现率描述记录分布，不等于生境面积。
chapters.captionEn: Occurrence describes records, not habitat area.

chapters.title: 相似生境，还要比较资源
chapters.titleEn: Compare resources as well as habitat
chapters.caption: 胃中检出物保留原分类，沙砾不当营养食物。
chapters.captionEn: Retain content categories; grit is not nutritional food.

chapters.title: 回到自己的观察证据
chapters.caption: 先记录时间、位置和行为，再提出解释。
chapters.captionEn: Record time, place and behavior before interpretation.

chapters.title: 取样体积先保持一致
chapters.caption: 直径5 cm、深5 cm的土样约为98 mL。
chapters.captionEn: A 5 cm diameter, 5 cm deep core is about 98 mL.

chapters.title: 沿真实通路采集
chapters.caption: 热与干燥响应使部分动物向下，采集量仍有偏差。
chapters.captionEn: Heat and drying drive downward movement, with detection bias.

chapters.title: 动物入口和空气出口分开
chapters.titleEn: Separate animal intake from air outlet
chapters.caption: 动物进入收集瓶，出气口纱网只让空气通过。
chapters.captionEn: Animals enter the vial; air crosses the outlet screen.

chapters.title: 个体数与类群数分开
chapters.caption: 18个个体分为3个记录组，不声称已确定3个物种。
chapters.captionEn: Eighteen specimens form three recorded groups, not three proven species.

chapters.title: 从缺少土壤的起点开始
chapters.caption: 定居者改变基底，后来的植物逐渐获得条件。
chapters.captionEn: Colonizers modify the substrate for later plants.

chapters.title: 土壤与繁殖体没有清零
chapters.caption: 原有基底保留，恢复的起点不同。
chapters.captionEn: Retained substrate changes the starting conditions.

chapters.title: 终点也受环境约束
chapters.caption: 干燥条件下，不能把森林规定为必然终点。
chapters.captionEn: Dry conditions do not imply an inevitable forest.

chapters.title: 衍射约束，而不是分子照片
chapters.caption: 链形状改变，计算出的散射分布也改变；衍射不是直接拍到双螺旋。
chapters.captionEn: Changing strand geometry changes calculated scattering; diffraction is not a direct helix photograph.

chapters.title: 数量相等，还不够
chapters.caption: A=T、G=C约束整体组成，却不能独自确定逐位配对。
chapters.captionEn: A = T and G = C constrain composition without uniquely specifying local pairing.

chapters.title: 把化学配对放进空间
chapters.caption: 标准配对为A—T与G—C，每对结合一个双环碱基和一个单环碱基。
chapters.captionEn: Standard A–T and G–C pairs each combine one two-ring base with one single-ring base.

chapters.title: 先接对一个核苷酸
chapters.caption: 碱基连1′碳，骨架经3′氧、磷酸与下一糖的5′侧连接。
chapters.captionEn: A base attaches at 1′; the backbone links a 3′ oxygen through phosphate to the next sugar’s 5′ side.

chapters.title: 两条链，化学方向相反
chapters.titleEn: Two strands with opposite chemical directions
chapters.caption: 同一端一条为5′，另一条为3′；互补与反向平行都要检验。
chapters.captionEn: At either end, one strand is 5′ and the other 3′; test both pairing and orientation.

chapters.title: 用真实坐标检查空间关系
chapters.titleEn: Inspect spatial relationships in real coordinates
chapters.caption: 真实结构保留外侧骨架、内侧碱基及不等宽的沟槽。
chapters.captionEn: Real coordinates retain exterior backbones, interior bases and unequal grooves.

chapters.title: 四个方向展开
chapters.caption: 甲烷四个C—H方向指向正四面体顶点。
chapters.captionEn: Methane’s four C–H directions point to tetrahedral vertices.

chapters.title: 连接两个四面体中心
chapters.caption: 乙烷有六个C—Hσ键和一个C—Cσ键。
chapters.captionEn: Ethane contains six C–H sigma bonds and one C–C sigma bond.

chapters.title: 双键与同一平面
chapters.titleEn: A double bond and a plane
chapters.caption: 乙烯六个原子共面，具有5个σ键和1个π键。
chapters.captionEn: All six ethene atoms are coplanar, with five sigma bonds and one pi bond.

chapters.title: 三键与相互垂直的π方向
chapters.titleEn: A triple bond and two pi directions
chapters.caption: 乙炔为直线形：3个σ键，加2个相互垂直的π方向。
chapters.captionEn: Ethyne is linear: three sigma bonds and two perpendicular pi directions.

chapters.title: 不同摆法能否重合
chapters.caption: 二氯甲烷的六种顶点选法，可以靠空间旋转相互重合。
chapters.captionEn: The six choices of chlorine vertices in dichloromethane superpose by spatial rotation.

chapters.title: 相同分子式，不同连接
chapters.caption: 正丁烷与异丁烷都为C₄H₁₀，碳骨架的连接不同。
chapters.captionEn: Butane and isobutane both have formula C₄H₁₀, but different carbon connections.

chapters.title: 让碳四价约束结构
chapters.titleEn: Let carbon valence constrain the graph
chapters.caption: 改变连法、键级或闭环时，氢数必须随碳四价一起改变。
chapters.captionEn: Connectivity, bond order and ring closure change the hydrogen count required by carbon valence.

chapters.title: 沿食物链读取年能量
chapters.titleEn: Read annual energy along the food chain
chapters.caption: 固定与同化的能量，沿营养级逐级减少。
chapters.captionEn: Fixed and assimilated energy decreases across trophic levels.

chapters.title: 同一份能量去了哪里
chapters.titleEn: Account for the same energy input
chapters.caption: 呼吸、传递、分解者利用和本期未利用分别记账。
chapters.captionEn: Separate respiration, transfer, decomposition and unused energy.

chapters.title: 分母必须是前一级
chapters.titleEn: Use the preceding level as denominator
chapters.caption: 两次传递约为13.5%和20.1%，不是固定常数。
chapters.captionEn: The two transfers are about 13.5% and 20.1%, not constants.

chapters.title: 关系图要有证据来源
chapters.titleEn: Give food-web links an evidence source
chapters.caption: 观察、访谈和推测，不能混成同一种证据。
chapters.captionEn: Observation, interviews and hypotheses are distinct evidence.

chapters.title: 继续利用有机物中的能量
chapters.caption: 养分可以回田，能量仍单向经过系统。
chapters.captionEn: Nutrients can return to fields; energy flows through the system.

chapters.title: 跟住同一个碳标记
chapters.caption: 光合、取食、呼吸和分解转移碳，标记不凭空产生。
chapters.captionEn: Photosynthesis, feeding, respiration and decomposition transfer carbon.

chapters.title: 交换与化石碳释放分开
chapters.caption: 海气可以双向交换，燃烧把储存的碳送入空气。
chapters.captionEn: Ocean and air exchange carbon; burning releases stored fossil carbon.

chapters.title: 摄入与排出共同决定积累
chapters.caption: 体内负荷取决于进入与排出的差，不能只看食物链。
chapters.captionEn: Body burden depends on uptake minus elimination.

chapters.title: 累计摄食后再比较浓度
chapters.caption: 保留量除以体重，才得到消费者浓度。
chapters.captionEn: Divide retained burden by body mass to obtain concentration.

chapters.title: 标记DNA，再提取分析
chapters.caption: ¹⁵N和¹⁴N是稳定同位素，DNA在密度梯度中形成平衡条带。
chapters.captionEn: Nitrogen-15 and nitrogen-14 are stable isotopes; extracted DNA forms equilibrium density bands.

chapters.title: 第一代，检验全保留
chapters.titleEn: The first generation tests conservative copying
chapters.caption: 第一代只有中间带，不符合全保留复制预期的重、轻两带。
chapters.captionEn: One intermediate band after one generation contradicts the heavy-plus-light conservative prediction.

chapters.title: 第二代，出现中间与轻带
chapters.titleEn: Two bands appear in the second generation
chapters.caption: 第二代中间带与轻带并存，符合半保留复制的分配。
chapters.captionEn: Intermediate and light bands coexist after two generations, as semiconservative copying predicts.

chapters.title: 扩展检验：逐段混合
chapters.caption: 分散复制可产生第一代中间带，但第二代预期仍为一条更轻的混合带。
chapters.captionEn: Dispersive copying can give an intermediate first-generation band but predicts one lighter mixed band next.

chapters.title: 两条重链始终可追踪
chapters.caption: A、B两条原有重链不增加，含重标记的分子比例下降。
chapters.captionEn: Original heavy strands A and B do not multiply; their fraction among duplexes falls.

chapters.title: 解开母链，提供起始端
chapters.titleEn: Open templates and provide a starting end
chapters.caption: 两条母链作为模板，DNA聚合酶需要已有的引物起始端。
chapters.captionEn: Both parental strands act as templates; DNA polymerase requires a primer end.

chapters.title: 两边都只从5′向3′延伸
chapters.titleEn: Both sides extend only from 5′ to 3′
chapters.caption: 一侧连续延伸，另一侧先分段合成；合成方向都为5′到3′。
chapters.captionEn: One side extends continuously and the other in fragments; both synthesize 5′ to 3′.

chapters.title: 替换引物，再连接骨架
chapters.titleEn: Replace primers and join the backbone
chapters.caption: RNA引物被DNA替换，缺口连接；每个子代保留一条母链。
chapters.captionEn: DNA replaces RNA primers and nicks are joined; each daughter retains one parental strand.

chapters.title: 先确定核间距离
chapters.caption: 同一比例下，H₂与Cl₂的核间距离不同。
chapters.captionEn: At one scale, H₂ and Cl₂ have different bond lengths.

chapters.title: 两个方向彼此远离
chapters.caption: CO₂的两个成键区域沿相反方向排列。
chapters.captionEn: CO₂ has two bonding regions pointing in opposite directions.

chapters.title: 三个方向展开成平面
chapters.caption: 甲醛的三个成键区域近似平面三角形。
chapters.captionEn: Formaldehyde’s three bonding regions are approximately trigonal planar.

chapters.title: 四个方向走进空间
chapters.caption: 甲烷的四个成键方向组成正四面体。
chapters.captionEn: Methane’s four bonding directions form a tetrahedron.

chapters.title: 四气球的几何类比
chapters.caption: 四个等大气球围绕同一束口，呈四面体式分布。
chapters.captionEn: Four equal balloons share a tied neck and spread tetrahedrally.

chapters.title: 一对孤电子对保留空间
chapters.titleEn: One lone pair still occupies space
chapters.caption: NH₃有四个电子对区域，但原子骨架是三角锥。
chapters.captionEn: NH₃ has four electron regions, but a trigonal-pyramidal atomic framework.

chapters.title: 两对孤电子对留下折线
chapters.titleEn: Two lone pairs leave a bent framework
chapters.caption: 水有四个电子对区域，两个O—H方向形成折线。
chapters.captionEn: Water has four electron regions; its two O–H directions form a bend.

chapters.title: 有极性键，合向量仍可为零
chapters.caption: CO₂两条相反的键偶极相互抵消。
chapters.captionEn: The two opposing bond dipoles of CO₂ cancel.

chapters.title: 弯折后，分量不能全抵消
chapters.caption: 水的两个键偶极留下非零合向量。
chapters.captionEn: Water’s two bond dipoles leave a nonzero resultant.

chapters.title: 替换一个顶点，改变抵消条件
chapters.caption: CH₄的对称抵消，在CH₃Cl中不再成立。
chapters.captionEn: Methane’s symmetric cancellation no longer holds in CH₃Cl.

chapters.title: 只改变准备检验的条件
chapters.caption: 相同落叶和土层，比较处理土与自然土。
chapters.captionEn: Compare treated and natural soil with matched litter and depth.

chapters.title: 变化需要时间和环境
chapters.titleEn: Change takes time and suitable conditions
chapters.caption: 较低分解活性下，落叶在模型中保存较多。
chapters.captionEn: Lower activity preserves more litter in this model.

chapters.title: 把观察留下来再下结论
chapters.caption: 示例数据与个人实测分开，缺测保持空白。
chapters.captionEn: Separate example values from measurements; missing data stay blank.

chapters.title: 留下浸出液，取出粗土
chapters.titleEn: Retain the extract and remove coarse soil
chapters.caption: 纱布带走粗土，液体仍可含微生物与可溶物。
chapters.captionEn: Gauze removes coarse soil; microbes and solutes can remain.

chapters.title: 浸出液与水作对照
chapters.caption: A加30 mL浸出液，B加30 mL水，其他条件一致。
chapters.captionEn: A receives 30 mL extract; B receives 30 mL water.

chapters.title: 同一培养液分成两份
chapters.titleEn: Split the incubation into separate aliquots
chapters.caption: 碘液与斐林试剂检测不同份，不混在一起。
chapters.captionEn: Iodine and Fehling reagent test separate aliquots.

chapters.title: 先看还剩多少淀粉
chapters.caption: 碘液接触样品后，残留淀粉产生蓝紫色。
chapters.captionEn: Iodine contact reveals remaining starch as blue-purple color.

chapters.title: 另一份样品检测还原性
chapters.titleEn: Test reducing substances in the other aliquot
chapters.caption: 新配斐林试剂加热后，才观察砖红色沉淀。
chapters.captionEn: Heat fresh Fehling reagent before inspecting brick-red precipitate.

chapters.title: 产物也会继续被利用
chapters.caption: 淀粉已减少，末次还原糖仍可能很低。
chapters.captionEn: Starch can decline while final reducing sugar remains low.

chapters.title: 水为什么进入倒置试管
chapters.titleEn: Why water enters the inverted tube
chapters.caption: SO₂溶入水后，水进入原来的气体空间。
chapters.captionEn: As SO₂ dissolves, water enters the former gas space.

chapters.title: 同一溶液再检验酸性
chapters.titleEn: Test the same solution for acidity
chapters.caption: 取出的溶液使pH试纸显示酸性。
chapters.captionEn: The collected solution gives an acidic pH-paper result.

chapters.title: 品红进入后褪色
chapters.caption: 加入品红后，原有颜色逐渐消失。
chapters.captionEn: After fuchsin is added, its colour gradually disappears.

chapters.title: 加热后观察复色
chapters.caption: 加热后，已经褪去的品红颜色恢复。
chapters.captionEn: On heating, the faded fuchsin colour returns.

chapters.title: 用未加热样品作对照
chapters.caption: 同样褪色的两份样品，加热的一份恢复颜色。
chapters.captionEn: Of two equally bleached samples, the heated one regains colour.

chapters.title: 三个一组，起点固定
chapters.caption: 单个碱基增减，会改变后续三联体的分组。
chapters.captionEn: A one-base insertion or deletion changes downstream triplet grouping.

chapters.title: 恢复阅读框的限定
chapters.caption: 三个碱基的净增减可恢复后方阅读框，不保证原有功能。
chapters.captionEn: A net change of three bases restores the downstream frame, not necessarily protein function.

chapters.title: 用合成RNA指定产物
chapters.titleEn: Let synthetic RNA specify a product
chapters.caption: 教材简化对照中，多聚U对应多聚苯丙氨酸。
chapters.captionEn: In the simplified textbook comparison, poly-U specifies polyphenylalanine.

chapters.title: 把产物变成可测信号
chapters.caption: 原文记录的是标记氨基酸掺入，不是肉眼直接看见肽链。
chapters.captionEn: The original assay measured labeled amino-acid incorporation, not visible peptide chains.

chapters.title: 先合成一条RNA
chapters.caption: 模板按3′到5′被读取，RNA在3′端延长。
chapters.captionEn: The template is read 3′ to 5′ while RNA extends at its 3′ end.

chapters.title: 同一信息，不同分子
chapters.titleEn: The information passes to another molecule
chapters.caption: RNA与模板互补，与编码链对应位置以U替代T。
chapters.captionEn: RNA complements the template; relative to the coding strand, U replaces T.

chapters.title: 反密码子识别起始位点
chapters.caption: tRNA反密码子与mRNA反向互补，氨基酸接在tRNA的3′端。
chapters.captionEn: The tRNA anticodon pairs antiparallel to mRNA; its amino acid is attached at the tRNA 3′ end.

chapters.title: 转移肽链，再移动一格
chapters.caption: 肽链转到A位tRNA，随后tRNA与mRNA一起移动。
chapters.captionEn: The peptide transfers to the A-site tRNA, then tRNAs and mRNA translocate together.

chapters.title: 终止不是另一种氨基酸
chapters.titleEn: A stop signal is not another amino acid
chapters.caption: 释放因子识别终止密码子，完成的肽链与tRNA分离。
chapters.captionEn: A release factor recognizes the stop codon and releases the peptide from tRNA.

chapters.title: 网能挡住昆虫，挡不住所有线索
chapters.titleEn: Mesh blocks insects, not every cue
chapters.caption: 纱网排除直接接触，气味与视觉仍可能存在。
chapters.captionEn: Mesh excludes contact, while odor and visual cues may remain.

chapters.title: 遮挡视觉，还要保留气流对照
chapters.caption: 有源室和空室使用相同通气路径。
chapters.captionEn: Source and empty chambers share the same air pathway.

chapters.title: 记录每个重复，而不是先写答案
chapters.titleEn: Record trials before writing the answer
chapters.caption: 70%与20%只是练习示例，个人数据从空白开始。
chapters.captionEn: Seventy and twenty percent are practice values, not measured results.

chapters.title: 数量增加会改变限制条件
chapters.caption: 取食压力和捕食者响应，逐渐限制原来的增加。
chapters.captionEn: Food pressure and predator responses constrain the initial increase.

chapters.title: 抵抗与恢复回答不同问题
chapters.titleEn: Resistance and recovery ask different questions
chapters.caption: 先看偏离幅度，再看回返速度。
chapters.captionEn: Inspect initial displacement, then the rate of return.

chapters.title: 自我调节有条件和限度
chapters.caption: 强扰动可能把模型推到另一状态。
chapters.captionEn: Strong disturbance can move the model toward another state.

chapters.title: 先把基本组分放在真实空间里
chapters.titleEn: Arrange the components in a physical system
chapters.caption: 坡面、水域、生产者和分解者共同组成生态缸。
chapters.captionEn: Land, water, producers and decomposers form the tank.

chapters.title: 白天与夜间的氧收支不同
chapters.titleEn: Oxygen budgets differ between day and night
chapters.caption: 光合作用随光改变，呼吸在夜间仍继续。
chapters.captionEn: Photosynthesis follows light; respiration continues at night.

chapters.title: 相同光照，改变消费者负荷
chapters.titleEn: Change consumer load under the same light
chapters.caption: 更多耗氧需求，会改变同一个缸的结果。
chapters.captionEn: Higher oxygen demand changes the same tank’s outcome.

chapters.title: 稳定要靠连续观察判断
chapters.caption: 每周记录组成、数量与环境，不能只看一次。
chapters.captionEn: Record composition, counts and conditions each week.

chapters.title: 先看颜色，再看体积
chapters.caption: 蔗糖先变黄、变褐，再形成黑色物质。
chapters.captionEn: Sucrose yellows, browns and forms black material.

chapters.title: 按水的组成核对元素
chapters.caption: 简化脱水账本：一份蔗糖对应12C和11H₂O。
chapters.captionEn: Simplified dehydration inventory: one sucrose unit gives 12C and 11H₂O.

chapters.title: 气体把黑色物质撑成多孔结构
chapters.caption: 热与产气使黑色物质形成膨胀的多孔柱体。
chapters.captionEn: Heat and gas formation expand the black material into a porous column.

chapters.title: 浓硫酸还会参与氧化
chapters.caption: 部分碳继续被氧化，硫酸中的硫可从+6变为+4。
chapters.captionEn: Some carbon is further oxidized; sulfur can change from +6 to +4.

chapters.title: 把固体量和孔隙分开
chapters.titleEn: Separate solid amount from pore space
chapters.caption: 保持固体量不变，仅增大孔隙就能增大外观体积。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed solid amount, more pore space increases bulk volume.

chapters.title: 三种细胞，三种基因都在
chapters.titleEn: Three cell types retain all three genes
chapters.caption: 鸡的三种细胞都检出三个基因；红细胞在这里有细胞核。
chapters.captionEn: All three genes are detected in these chicken cells, including nucleated red blood cells.

chapters.title: 检测RNA，结果不再相同
chapters.caption: 三个基因都存在，但三种特定mRNA的检出模式不同。
chapters.captionEn: The genes are present in every cell type, but the three assayed mRNAs have different detection patterns.

chapters.title: 同一Lcyc序列，两种花型
chapters.titleEn: Two floral forms with the same Lcyc sequence
chapters.caption: 柳穿鱼Lcyc序列相同，表达与花型却不同。
chapters.captionEn: The Linaria Lcyc sequence is unchanged while expression and floral symmetry differ.

chapters.title: 附加标记，字母保留
chapters.titleEn: Add marks without replacing the letters
chapters.caption: 甲基化修饰发生在碱基上，示意序列本身保持不变。
chapters.captionEn: Methyl groups modify bases while the illustrated base sequence remains unchanged.

chapters.title: 还要检查后代
chapters.caption: 教材的F₁似A，F₂大多数似A、少数似B；不虚构精确比例。
chapters.captionEn: The textbook describes A-like F₁ flowers and mostly A-like, some B-like F₂ flowers, without an exact ratio.

chapters.title: 相同基因型，毛色有过渡
chapters.titleEn: One genotype, a range of coat colors
chapters.caption: Aᵛʸ/a小鼠可呈不同毛色；上游修饰与异位表达有关。
chapters.captionEn: Aᵛʸ/a mice can differ in coat color as upstream methylation affects ectopic expression.

chapters.title: 改变幼虫培养条件
chapters.caption: 31 ℃培养的残翅幼虫中，部分成虫翅长接近正常。
chapters.captionEn: Some vestigial larvae raised at 31 °C develop adult wings approaching normal length.

chapters.title: 回到正常温度看下一代
chapters.titleEn: Return the next generation to normal temperature
chapters.caption: 这些果蝇的后代在25 ℃培养，仍表现残翅。
chapters.captionEn: Their offspring raised at 25 °C still show vestigial wings.

chapters.title: 有处理，也要有对照
chapters.caption: X射线提高突变检出，不指定有利的变化方向。
chapters.captionEn: X irradiation increases mutation detection without prescribing a beneficial direction.

chapters.title: 把遗传表现变成检出信号
chapters.titleEn: Turn inheritance into a detection signal
chapters.caption: 追踪一条X染色体，隐性致死变化会改变后代类别。
chapters.captionEn: A tracked recessive-lethal X changes which offspring classes survive.

chapters.title: 分母决定能说什么
chapters.caption: 63.16%与39.06%是各组吸烟比例，不是吸烟者患癌概率。
chapters.captionEn: 63.16% and 39.06% are smoking proportions within the sampled groups, not cancer risks among smokers.

chapters.title: 处理活根尖，再固定
chapters.titleEn: Treat living root tips, then fix them
chapters.caption: 先低温、再生根与诱导；固定后观察的是保存的分裂象。
chapters.captionEn: Cold pretreatment, rooting and induction precede fixation; the slide preserves division states.

chapters.title: 复制了，却没有正常分开
chapters.caption: 纺锤体受抑制可导致复原核；DNA复制本身不等于倍性已经增加。
chapters.captionEn: Spindle disruption can lead to a restitution nucleus; DNA replication alone does not increase ploidy.

chapters.title: 回到真实材料的数量
chapters.titleEn: Return to the material’s chromosome count
chapters.caption: 蒜或洋葱正常为16条，加倍示例为32条；按着丝粒计数。
chapters.captionEn: Garlic or onion normally has 16 chromosomes; a doubled example has 32, counted by centromeres.

chapters.title: 多一条，不等于多一组
chapters.titleEn: One extra chromosome is not one extra set
chapters.caption: 个别染色体增减，与完整染色体组增减需要分开。
chapters.captionEn: Individual chromosome gains or losses differ from changes in complete sets.

chapters.title: 单倍体还要看来源
chapters.caption: 由配子发育成的个体可为单倍体；其细胞不一定只有一组。
chapters.captionEn: A gamete-derived haploid can contain more than one chromosome set.

chapters.title: 改变片段的拷贝数
chapters.caption: 缺失减少片段，重复增加拷贝；原有片段身份可以追踪。
chapters.captionEn: Deletion removes a segment; duplication adds a copy while identities remain traceable.

chapters.title: 改变顺序或所在染色体
chapters.caption: 倒位改变片段方向；易位涉及非同源染色体。
chapters.captionEn: Inversion reverses a segment; translocation moves material between nonhomologous chromosomes.

chapters.title: 先确定在哪里、何时调查
chapters.titleEn: Specify where and when to investigate
chapters.caption: 位置、时间、方法与重复共同定义样本。
chapters.captionEn: Location, time, method and replication define each sample.

chapters.title: 指标和评价依据要一起保留
chapters.caption: 单项溶解氧不等于综合水质等级。
chapters.captionEn: Dissolved oxygen alone does not establish overall water quality.

chapters.title: 通道恢复的是可移动的空间
chapters.caption: 同一个体通过桥面，始终与道路交通分开。
chapters.captionEn: The same individual crosses the bridge, separated from road traffic.

chapters.title: 不同结论需要不同证据
chapters.caption: 通行、个体身份和亲子遗传证据逐层补充。
chapters.captionEn: Movement, identity and parentage provide distinct evidence.

chapters.title: 回用要把输出也记进去
chapters.caption: 氮标记经过回用，收获与损失仍保留在账中。
chapters.captionEn: Nitrogen reuse retains harvest and loss in the accounting.

chapters.title: 选择组分还要匹配环境
chapters.caption: 环境适合与利用容量，限制系统能否维持。
chapters.captionEn: Environmental fit and uptake capacity constrain persistence.

chapters.title: 液体与气体沿各自通路走
chapters.titleEn: Follow distinct liquid and gas routes
chapters.caption: 养分留在所示液体路径，沼气从气室引出。
chapters.captionEn: Tracked nutrients follow the slurry route; biogas leaves the gas space.

chapters.title: 把参观转成可追溯的设计依据
chapters.titleEn: Turn a visit into traceable design evidence
chapters.caption: 观察、访谈和待核实效果分别记录。
chapters.captionEn: Record observations, interviews and unverified effects separately.

chapters.title: 先算清一个样方里的碳
chapters.titleEn: First account for carbon within one plot
chapters.caption: 植被、凋落物和土层分别计量，再统一面积。
chapters.captionEn: Measure vegetation, litter and soil separately before area conversion.

chapters.title: 样方多，不等于面积大
chapters.titleEn: More sampled plots do not mean more land
chapters.caption: 全国或区域汇总要按各类生态系统面积加权。
chapters.captionEn: Regional aggregation weights ecosystem densities by their areas.

chapters.title: 库存、年变化和年代不能混用
chapters.titleEn: Keep stocks, annual change and dates distinct
chapters.caption: 201.1 Tg C/年是2001—2010的历史综合估计。
chapters.captionEn: 201.1 Tg C per year is a historical 2001–2010 synthesis.

chapters.title: 先找硫的起点和终点
chapters.titleEn: Locate sulfur’s starting and ending states
chapters.caption: 同一种元素，可以通过得失电子改变价态。
chapters.captionEn: One element changes oxidation state through electron transfer.

chapters.title: 低价和高价走向同一中间价
chapters.titleEn: Two states meet at an intermediate state
chapters.caption: 硫化物与亚硫酸的反应可生成黄色硫。
chapters.captionEn: Sulfide and sulfurous acid can form yellow sulfur.

chapters.title: 换氧化剂，再观察
chapters.titleEn: Change the oxidant and observe again
chapters.caption: 酸性高锰酸钾的紫色消退，硫化物被氧化。
chapters.captionEn: Acidified permanganate loses purple colour as sulfide is oxidized.

chapters.title: 沿导管追踪生成气体
chapters.titleEn: Trace the product gas through the tube
chapters.caption: 铜与热浓硫酸反应，气体通入品红后使其褪色。
chapters.captionEn: Copper reacts with hot concentrated acid; the product gas fades fuchsin.

chapters.title: 结束反应，保留观察对象
chapters.titleEn: End the reaction and preserve the sample
chapters.caption: 结束反应后，先让反应体系冷却。
chapters.captionEn: End the reaction and let the system cool.

chapters.title: 冷却后的铜进入溶液
chapters.titleEn: Observe copper in the cooled solution
chapters.caption: 冷却后按教材观察稀释的溶液，出现蓝色。
chapters.captionEn: The cooled material gives a blue solution in the textbook’s dilution observation.

chapters.title: 只点热粉末条的一端
chapters.titleEn: Heat one end of the powder strip
chapters.caption: 局部热源让一小段铁硫混合物开始反应。
chapters.captionEn: A local heat source starts reaction in a small part of the iron–sulfur mixture.

chapters.title: 移开热源，红热带继续前进
chapters.titleEn: The glowing front continues without the rod
chapters.caption: 放热与热传递推动反应前沿，反应后的区域逐渐冷却。
chapters.captionEn: Released heat and heat transfer sustain the front; reacted regions cool.

chapters.title: 检查空气与过量物质
chapters.caption: 价态账本解释转化，颜色不能证明产物绝对纯净。
chapters.captionEn: Oxidation-state balances explain changes; colour alone does not prove purity.

chapters.title: 盐水和水封承担不同作用
chapters.titleEn: Brine and the seal have different roles
chapters.caption: 菜料在液面下，坛盖裙边插在水槽中。
chapters.captionEn: Food stays below brine; the lid skirt enters the water trough.

chapters.title: 发酵进程需要实际记录
chapters.caption: 这里选择乳酸生成的简化路径，不预测可食用时间。
chapters.captionEn: This selected lactic pathway does not predict edibility.

chapters.title: 从样品开始保留量的关系
chapters.titleEn: Keep quantities traceable from the sample
chapters.caption: 提取液先进入移液器，再到达接收管。
chapters.captionEn: Extract enters the pipette before reaching the receiving tube.

chapters.title: 空白、标准和稀释一起计算
chapters.titleEn: Calculate with blank, standards and dilution
chapters.caption: 同批校准后，再把提取液浓度换回食品质量。
chapters.captionEn: Calibrate first, then convert extract concentration to food mass.

chapters.title: 糖转成乙醇，碳也进入气体
chapters.titleEn: Sugar forms ethanol and gaseous carbon
chapters.caption: 理想反应同时生成乙醇和二氧化碳。
chapters.captionEn: The ideal reaction forms both ethanol and carbon dioxide.

chapters.title: 限制空气进入，同时留出排气路径
chapters.titleEn: Limit incoming air while venting gas
chapters.caption: 气泡沿瓶颈和水弯离开，不穿过瓶壁。
chapters.captionEn: Gas follows the neck and water bend, never the bottle wall.

chapters.title: 醋酸菌需要新的供氧条件
chapters.caption: 乙醇氧化为乙酸，需要从外界供给氧气。
chapters.captionEn: Oxidizing ethanol to acetic acid requires external oxygen.

chapters.title: 大罐不是按比例放大的小瓶
chapters.titleEn: A large tank changes transport demands
chapters.caption: 相似放大时，面积增长慢于体积。
chapters.captionEn: With similar scaling, surface area grows slower than volume.

chapters.title: 比较流程需要有出处的资料
chapters.caption: 菌种、灭菌、发酵与分离分别留下依据。
chapters.captionEn: Document strain, sterilization, fermentation and recovery separately.

chapters.title: 部件要连到真正工作的地方
chapters.titleEn: Connect each component to its working location
chapters.caption: 空气到达底部散气器，电机连接叶轮。
chapters.captionEn: Air reaches the bottom sparger; the motor connects to impellers.

chapters.title: 溶氧取决于传入和消耗
chapters.titleEn: Dissolved oxygen balances transfer and use
chapters.caption: 供氧与搅拌改变传质，微生物持续耗氧。
chapters.captionEn: Aeration and mixing affect transfer while microbes consume oxygen.

chapters.title: 冷却夹套改变的是热量收支
chapters.titleEn: The jacket changes the heat balance
chapters.caption: 产热仍在继续，夹套把热量带走。
chapters.captionEn: Heat production continues while the jacket removes heat.

chapters.title: 有水，不等于气体就被吸收
chapters.titleEn: Water alone does not absorb every gas
chapters.caption: NO与水接触后仍为无色气体，气相没有明显消失。
chapters.captionEn: NO remains colourless in contact with water; the gas does not visibly disappear.

chapters.title: 吸入空气，出现红棕色
chapters.caption: 空气中的O₂把部分NO氧化成红棕色NO₂。
chapters.captionEn: O₂ in the admitted air oxidizes part of the NO to red-brown NO₂.

chapters.title: 颜色消退，仍有NO留下
chapters.caption: NO₂与水作用后颜色消退，同时又生成一部分NO。
chapters.captionEn: NO₂ reacts with water, losing colour while regenerating some NO.

chapters.title: 检查氧气账本
chapters.caption: 要把剩余NO继续转入液相，还需要足够的O₂。
chapters.captionEn: Transferring the remaining NO into solution requires enough O₂.

chapters.title: 浓硝酸与铜的产物
chapters.caption: 教材浓硝酸条件下，铜反应主要生成NO₂。
chapters.captionEn: In the textbook concentrated-acid case, copper mainly produces NO₂.

chapters.title: 稀硝酸的主要气体不同
chapters.titleEn: Dilute acid gives a different main gas
chapters.caption: 教材稀硝酸条件下，铜反应主要生成无色NO。
chapters.captionEn: In the textbook dilute-acid case, copper mainly produces colourless NO.

chapters.title: 分清直接生成与后续氧化
chapters.titleEn: Separate primary product from later oxidation
chapters.caption: NO接触O₂后也会变成NO₂，出现红棕色。
chapters.captionEn: NO also turns into red-brown NO₂ after contact with O₂.

chapters.title: 化石中的组合特征
chapters.caption: 近鸟龙的骨骼与羽毛特征相结合，为共同由来提供证据。
chapters.captionEn: Anchiornis combines skeletal and feather features that inform common ancestry.

chapters.title: 功能不同，骨骼关系仍对应
chapters.caption: 前肢的骨骼类型与连接关系对应，比例和功能可以不同。
chapters.captionEn: Forelimbs retain corresponding bone types and relationships despite different proportions and functions.

chapters.title: 比较同源的发育结构
chapters.caption: 咽部结构与尾部的相似性，不等于胚胎重演成体进化。
chapters.captionEn: Similar pharyngeal and tail regions do not mean embryos replay adult evolutionary stages.

chapters.title: 比较同一分子的差异
chapters.titleEn: Compare differences in the same molecule
chapters.caption: 同源蛋白质的差异个数提供另一类证据，不能直接当成年代尺。
chapters.captionEn: Differences in a homologous protein add evidence without serving as a universal clock.

chapters.title: 环境改变，个体颜色保留
chapters.titleEn: The environment changes; individuals retain their color
chapters.caption: 树皮变黑改变选择条件，不把浅色个体直接染成黑色遗传型。
chapters.captionEn: Darkened bark changes selection conditions without rewriting pale individuals into dark genotypes.

chapters.title: 用当年的总数重新计算
chapters.caption: 教材模型第二年为11、22、63，总数96，S频率约23%。
chapters.captionEn: The model’s second year has 11, 22 and 63 individuals, totaling 96, with S near 23%.

chapters.title: 空白纸片与三个平行对照
chapters.titleEn: A blank disk and three matched drug disks
chapters.caption: 抑菌边界来自扩散与生长阈值；虚拟数值不能当作临床药敏结果。
chapters.captionEn: Inhibition boundaries depend on diffusion and growth thresholds; virtual values are not clinical susceptibility results.

chapters.title: 跟住被选中的克隆
chapters.caption: 选择已有克隆可改变后代平板；抑菌圈不一定每轮继续缩小。
chapters.captionEn: Selecting an existing clone can change a descendant plate, but zones need not shrink in every round.

chapters.title: 屏障先改变交流
chapters.titleEn: A barrier first changes gene flow
chapters.caption: 地理隔离可以减少交流；等位基因频率分化不自动等于新物种。
chapters.captionEn: Geographic isolation can limit exchange; allele-frequency divergence alone does not establish new species.

chapters.title: 屏障消失，还要检验生殖
chapters.caption: 是否能产生可育后代，需要独立的生殖证据。
chapters.captionEn: Whether reunited populations produce fertile offspring requires independent reproductive evidence.

chapters.title: 合适的培养基还要避免外来污染
chapters.titleEn: Suitable medium also needs contamination control
chapters.caption: 制备、灭菌、冷却与倒平板有先后。
chapters.captionEn: Prepare, sterilize, cool and pour in sequence.

chapters.title: 每一段只带出上一段的一小部分
chapters.titleEn: Each streak carries a small part of the last
chapters.caption: 接种环处理并冷却后，重新接触已有菌体。
chapters.captionEn: Treat and cool the loop before picking up cells again.

chapters.title: 菌落、空白和平板纯度分别判断
chapters.titleEn: Assess colonies, the blank and purity separately
chapters.caption: 未接种对照检验污染；单菌落仍需核查。
chapters.captionEn: An uninoculated control checks contamination; colonies still need verification.

chapters.title: 并行筛选先统一指标
chapters.titleEn: Use a consistent metric for parallel screening
chapters.caption: 孔位对应候选身份，颜色表示示例产量。
chapters.captionEn: Well positions preserve candidate identity; colour represents example output.

chapters.title: 初筛最高还要经过重复验证
chapters.titleEn: The initial leader needs replicated confirmation
chapters.caption: B3的初筛优势没有在复筛中保持。
chapters.captionEn: B3’s initial advantage does not persist in the retest.

chapters.title: 选择的是适应培养条件的能力
chapters.titleEn: Selection favours growth under specific conditions
chapters.caption: 以尿素为唯一氮源，与普通和无氮对照比较。
chapters.captionEn: Compare urea-only nitrogen with general and no-nitrogen controls.

chapters.title: 稀释链同时保存体积和样品量
chapters.titleEn: Dilution preserves volume and sample accounting
chapters.caption: 每次一毫升进入九毫升，混匀后浓度降为十分之一。
chapters.captionEn: One millilitre into nine gives a tenfold dilution after mixing.

chapters.title: 在合适稀释度保留重复平板
chapters.titleEn: Use replicate plates at a suitable dilution
chapters.caption: 示例重复为96、103和101个菌落。
chapters.captionEn: The example replicates have 96, 103 and 101 colonies.

chapters.title: CFU计的是形成菌落的单位
chapters.caption: 一团相连细胞也可能只形成一个菌落。
chapters.captionEn: An attached group can form just one colony.

chapters.title: 空气检测要知道是否采了已知体积
chapters.titleEn: Air counts require a known sampled volume
chapters.caption: 主动采样与自然沉降的单位不能混用。
chapters.captionEn: Active sampling and settling require different units.

chapters.title: 水和牛奶要保留各自检测条件
chapters.titleEn: Water and milk retain their own test conditions
chapters.caption: 相同菌落数不代表相同原样浓度。
chapters.captionEn: Equal colony counts need not mean equal original concentrations.

chapters.title: 土壤调查保留地点和质量基准
chapters.titleEn: Soil investigations retain site and mass basis
chapters.caption: 每克结果须说明干重、湿重与培养方法。
chapters.captionEn: Per-gram results need dry/wet mass and culture conditions.

chapters.title: 水还没有进入
chapters.caption: 干燥充氨烧瓶内外气压近似平衡，水不会自行上升。
chapters.captionEn: Before water enters, the gas pressure is near ambient and water does not rise by itself.

chapters.title: 第一滴水改变气相
chapters.titleEn: The first drop changes the gas
chapters.caption: 少量水溶解氨，气相分子数减少，瓶内压强下降。
chapters.captionEn: A little water dissolves ammonia, reducing the gas inventory and the inside pressure.

chapters.title: 大气压推动连续入水
chapters.caption: 外界大气压推动水沿玻璃管进入；更多水又溶解更多氨。
chapters.captionEn: Atmospheric pressure drives water through the tube; more water dissolves more ammonia.

chapters.title: 粉红色发生在水相
chapters.caption: 氨在水中形成少量NH₄⁺和OH⁻，含酚酞的水显粉红色。
chapters.captionEn: Dissolved ammonia forms some NH₄⁺ and OH⁻, turning the indicator water pink.

chapters.title: 残余空气留下不同终点
chapters.titleEn: Residual air leaves a different endpoint
chapters.caption: 空气不随氨同样被大量吸收，会限制烧瓶的最终进水量。
chapters.captionEn: Air is not absorbed like ammonia and limits the final water intake.

chapters.title: 实验室里的尿素
chapters.caption: 1828年，维勒由氰酸铵得到尿素。
chapters.captionEn: In 1828, Wöhler obtained urea from ammonium cyanate.

chapters.title: 组成相同，连接改变
chapters.caption: 氰酸铵是离子化合物；尿素中原子按另一方式连接。
chapters.captionEn: The ionic salt and molecular urea have different connections.

chapters.title: 碳骨架的三种连接
chapters.caption: 五个碳、十二个氢，可以对应三种碳骨架。
chapters.captionEn: Five carbons and twelve hydrogens give three different skeletons.

chapters.title: 双键换了位置
chapters.caption: 碳骨架相同，双键位置不同。
chapters.captionEn: The carbon skeleton stays the same; the double-bond position changes.

chapters.title: 氧连接谁
chapters.caption: 乙醇含羟基；二甲醚的氧连接两个碳。
chapters.captionEn: Ethanol has an O–H group; dimethyl ether has C–O–C.

chapters.title: 双键的旋转限制
chapters.titleEn: Why the double bond resists rotation
chapters.caption: 两个p轨道的侧向重叠，在正交时消失。
chapters.captionEn: Sideways p-orbital overlap vanishes when the orbitals are perpendicular.

chapters.title: 同侧与异侧
chapters.caption: 双键每端各接两种不同基团，才可能有顺反异构。
chapters.captionEn: Each double-bond carbon must have two different substituents.

chapters.title: 先称样品
chapters.caption: 已知样品只含C、H、O，先记录质量。
chapters.captionEn: Start with a weighed sample known to contain only C, H and O.

chapters.title: 让碳氢变成可收集的产物
chapters.titleEn: Convert carbon and hydrogen into collectable products
chapters.caption: 充分氧化后，碳进入CO₂，氢进入H₂O。
chapters.captionEn: Complete oxidation transfers carbon into CO₂ and hydrogen into H₂O.

chapters.title: 分别收集，分别称量
chapters.caption: 先吸收水，再吸收CO₂，增重来自各自产物。
chapters.captionEn: Collect water first, then CO₂; each mass gain identifies a product amount.

chapters.title: 由质量求原子比
chapters.caption: 先算元素质量，再除以原子量，最后约成最简比。
chapters.captionEn: Find element masses, divide by atomic masses, then reduce the ratio.

chapters.title: 结论能到哪一步
chapters.titleEn: How far does the evidence go?
chapters.caption: 元素分析给出组成，不能独自确定原子的连接。
chapters.captionEn: Elemental analysis gives composition, not the atomic connections.

chapters.title: 外植体是整个过程的起点
chapters.titleEn: The explant anchors the whole process
chapters.caption: 同一茎段在适宜条件下形成愈伤组织。
chapters.captionEn: The same stem segment forms callus under suitable conditions.

chapters.title: 更换培养条件后再诱导芽
chapters.titleEn: Change culture conditions to induce shoots
chapters.caption: 芽从原来的组织上长出，不是换一个植物图标。
chapters.captionEn: Shoots emerge from the existing tissue, preserving its origin.

chapters.title: 完整植株还需要根的再生
chapters.titleEn: A plantlet also needs regenerated roots
chapters.caption: 根与已有的茎组织保持连接。
chapters.captionEn: Roots remain connected to the existing stem tissue.

chapters.title: 从瓶内到瓶外需要适应
chapters.caption: 先逐步适应，再观察移栽后的存活。
chapters.captionEn: Acclimatize gradually, then record survival after transplanting.

chapters.title: 去除的是细胞壁，膜仍保留
chapters.titleEn: Remove the wall while retaining the membrane
chapters.caption: 原生质体仍由完整细胞膜包围。
chapters.captionEn: An intact membrane still surrounds each protoplast.

chapters.title: 先接触，才形成共同细胞边界
chapters.titleEn: Contact precedes a shared cell boundary
chapters.caption: 共同膜边界形成后，内部仍保留两来源成分。
chapters.captionEn: A shared membrane encloses components from both origins.

chapters.title: 核来源与细胞壁再生分别观察
chapters.titleEn: Track nuclei and wall regrowth separately
chapters.caption: 共同细胞内发生后续变化，再培养和筛选。
chapters.captionEn: Further changes occur inside the shared cell before culture and selection.

chapters.title: 杂种身份不保证期待的性状组合
chapters.titleEn: Hybrid identity does not guarantee desired traits
chapters.caption: 核编码产物的双亲本证据，与整株性状分开判断。
chapters.captionEn: Evidence from both nuclear parents differs from whole-plant performance.

chapters.title: 无外源激素是独立对照
chapters.titleEn: No added hormones is a separate control
chapters.caption: 零比零没有可计算的激素比例。
chapters.captionEn: Zero divided by zero is not a defined hormone ratio.

chapters.title: 配比改变分化倾向
chapters.caption: 根、芽和愈伤组织是需要记录的不同结果。
chapters.captionEn: Roots, shoots and callus are distinct outcomes to record.

chapters.title: 相同比例也可能得到不同结果
chapters.titleEn: The same ratio can give different results
chapters.caption: 绝对浓度、材料和培养背景仍然重要。
chapters.captionEn: Absolute dose, material and culture context still matter.

chapters.title: 先追踪两种无色气体
chapters.caption: NH₃与HCl从玻璃棒附近扩散，气体本身均为无色。
chapters.captionEn: NH₃ and HCl spread from the glass-rod tips; both gases are colourless.

chapters.title: 接触区出现新的物质
chapters.titleEn: A new substance appears at contact
chapters.caption: 两种气体接触并反应，生成白色氯化铵微粒。
chapters.captionEn: Where the gases meet and react, white ammonium chloride particles form.

chapters.title: 白烟由微粒构成
chapters.caption: 教材中的白烟由悬浮的固体微粒形成，不能等同于水雾。
chapters.captionEn: The textbook white smoke consists of suspended solid particles, not simply water mist.

chapters.title: 缺少一种气体的对照
chapters.caption: 只保留NH₃时，模型没有生成氯化铵白烟。
chapters.captionEn: With NH₃ alone, no ammonium chloride cloud forms in the model.

chapters.title: 把样品放进磁场
chapters.titleEn: Place the sample in a magnetic field
chapters.caption: 磁场与射频激发后，探头接收随时间衰减的信号。
chapters.captionEn: After radiofrequency excitation in a magnetic field, the probe receives a decaying signal.

chapters.title: 给六个氢分组
chapters.caption: 乙醇有三种氢环境，分别包含3、2、1个氢。
chapters.captionEn: Ethanol has three proton environments containing 3, 2 and 1 hydrogens.

chapters.title: 读峰面积，别数峰高
chapters.caption: 相对积分为3∶2∶1；宽峰可以低，却仍有面积。
chapters.captionEn: Relative integrated areas are 3:2:1; a broad low peak still has area.

chapters.title: 另一种连接只有一组氢
chapters.titleEn: One environment in the alternative structure
chapters.caption: 二甲醚的两个甲基等效，六个氢给出一组信号。
chapters.captionEn: The equivalent methyl groups of dimethyl ether give one six-proton signal.

chapters.title: 一组信号可以分裂
chapters.caption: 乙醇的甲基和亚甲基信号可分成三重峰与四重峰。
chapters.captionEn: Ethanol’s methyl and methylene signals can form a triplet and a quartet.

chapters.title: 羟基峰不是固定指纹
chapters.titleEn: The hydroxyl signal is not fixed
chapters.caption: OH峰位和可见性依赖条件，交换后其¹H信号可减弱。
chapters.captionEn: The OH position and visibility depend on conditions; exchange can reduce its ¹H signal.

chapters.title: 不同铵盐，共同的离子
chapters.caption: NH₄Cl、NH₄NO₃和(NH₄)₂SO₄都含有NH₄⁺。
chapters.captionEn: NH₄Cl, NH₄NO₃ and (NH₄)₂SO₄ all contain NH₄⁺.

chapters.title: 加碱后，以气体建立证据
chapters.titleEn: Use the released gas as evidence
chapters.caption: 铵根与OH⁻反应，生成氨；逸出的氨使湿润红色石蕊变蓝。
chapters.captionEn: Ammonium reacts with OH⁻ to form ammonia; released gas turns damp red litmus blue.

chapters.title: 把试纸的条件分开
chapters.caption: 湿润且只接触气体的试纸，才提供这里需要的气体证据。
chapters.captionEn: Damp paper contacting only the gas provides the required gas-test evidence.

chapters.title: 同一性质用于制取氨
chapters.titleEn: Use the same chemistry to generate ammonia
chapters.caption: NH₄Cl与Ca(OH)₂反应生成NH₃，导管连接发生端与收集端。
chapters.captionEn: NH₄Cl and Ca(OH)₂ form NH₃; the delivery tube connects generation to collection.

chapters.title: 氨进入，空气向下排出
chapters.titleEn: Ammonia enters and air leaves below
chapters.caption: 氨比空气轻，倒置收集；它进入上部并逐渐排出原有空气。
chapters.captionEn: Ammonia is lighter than air: the inverted vessel fills as air leaves below.

chapters.title: 管口变蓝，不等于精确验纯
chapters.titleEn: A mouth test does not measure purity
chapters.caption: 管口试纸变蓝说明氨到达这里，不能证明空气已经全部排尽。
chapters.captionEn: Blue paper at the mouth shows ammonia has arrived, not that every trace of air is gone.

chapters.title: 吸收路径中的空气间隙
chapters.titleEn: An air gap in the absorption path
chapters.caption: 浅浸漏斗的几何体积可以让空气先进入，打断连续吸水。
chapters.captionEn: A shallow funnel can expose an air gap before water reaches its narrow stem.

chapters.title: 苯中溴的去向
chapters.caption: 水层变浅、苯层变深，溴只是转移到了另一相。
chapters.captionEn: The water layer fades while benzene gains color: bromine changes phase.

chapters.title: 苯与酸性高锰酸钾
chapters.caption: 在教材比较条件下，苯不使酸性高锰酸钾褪色。
chapters.captionEn: Under the textbook comparison conditions, benzene does not decolorize acidified permanganate.

chapters.title: 苯与甲苯：萃取对照
chapters.caption: 两种有机相都能萃取溴；总量转移不等于消耗。
chapters.captionEn: Both organic phases extract bromine; redistribution is not consumption.

chapters.title: 苯与甲苯：氧化对照
chapters.caption: 条件化氧化模型中，甲苯消耗氧化剂，苯对照保留紫色。
chapters.captionEn: In the conditioned oxidation model, toluene consumes oxidant while the benzene control stays purple.

chapters.title: 被氧化的是哪一部分
chapters.caption: 苯环保留，甲苯的苄位碳可成为羧基碳。
chapters.captionEn: The ring remains; toluene’s benzylic carbon can become a carboxyl carbon.

chapters.title: 从组织获得分散细胞
chapters.caption: 分散前后保留同一组细胞标记。
chapters.captionEn: The same cell identities remain before and after dissociation.

chapters.title: 贴壁与生长限制分开判断
chapters.caption: 接触抑制不是所有动物细胞的共同开关。
chapters.captionEn: Contact inhibition is not a universal animal-cell switch.

chapters.title: 分瓶传代保留来源和液量
chapters.titleEn: Passage preserves origins and liquid balance
chapters.caption: 同十六个标记分为八与八，液量同步变化。
chapters.captionEn: The same sixteen markers split eight and eight with matching liquid changes.

chapters.title: 气体条件与缓冲体系配套
chapters.titleEn: Match gas conditions to the buffer
chapters.caption: 固定碳酸氢盐时，二氧化碳增加使模型pH下降。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed bicarbonate, more carbon dioxide lowers the model pH.

chapters.title: 融合两种互补的细胞
chapters.caption: B细胞来源与骨髓瘤来源保留在共同细胞中。
chapters.captionEn: B-cell and myeloma origins enter one shared cell.

chapters.title: 选择培养只是第一道筛选
chapters.titleEn: Selective culture is only the first screen
chapters.caption: 两种抗体特异性不同的杂交瘤都可能存活。
chapters.captionEn: Hybridomas with different antibody specificities can both survive.

chapters.title: 检测抗体是否识别目标
chapters.titleEn: Test recognition of the target antigen
chapters.caption: 相同检测条件下，只有H-A的示意抗体与目标结合。
chapters.captionEn: Under matched conditions, only H-A antibodies bind the illustrated target.

chapters.title: 单细胞来源需要独立确认
chapters.caption: 有限稀释降低多细胞概率，但不自动证明单克隆。
chapters.captionEn: Limiting dilution reduces multiple occupancy but does not prove monoclonality.

chapters.title: 移出MⅡ纺锤体—染色体复合物
chapters.caption: 卵细胞质和其中的线粒体仍保留。
chapters.captionEn: Oocyte cytoplasm and its mitochondria remain.

chapters.title: 供体核进入保留的卵细胞质
chapters.titleEn: The donor nucleus enters retained oocyte cytoplasm
chapters.caption: 已置于卵周隙的供体细胞先接触，再与卵融合。
chapters.captionEn: A donor cell already placed in the perivitelline space contacts and fuses with the oocyte.

chapters.title: 融合以后仍需激活与发育
chapters.titleEn: Fusion must be followed by activation and development
chapters.caption: 早期卵裂不等于已经获得正常出生个体。
chapters.captionEn: Early cleavage does not establish a normal live-born animal.

chapters.title: 三种来源承担不同角色
chapters.caption: 核遗传来源、线粒体来源和孕育环境分别说明。
chapters.captionEn: Distinguish nuclear origin, mitochondrial origin and gestational environment.

chapters.title: 先区分溶液与不溶物
chapters.titleEn: Separate dissolved ions from insoluble matter
chapters.caption: 溶解后，Na⁺、Cl⁻与杂质离子同在水中；不溶物仍是固体。
chapters.captionEn: After dissolution, Na⁺, Cl⁻ and impurity ions share the water; insoluble matter remains solid.

chapters.title: 硫酸根转移到沉淀
chapters.caption: Ba²⁺与SO₄²⁻生成BaSO₄；略过量的Ba²⁺仍留在溶液中。
chapters.captionEn: Ba²⁺ and SO₄²⁻ form BaSO₄; excess Ba²⁺ stays in solution.

chapters.title: 在上层清液中检验
chapters.caption: 静置后再检验上层清液：新的浑浊提示仍有可反应的SO₄²⁻。
chapters.captionEn: After settling, new cloudiness in a supernatant test indicates residual reactive sulfate.

chapters.title: 用氢氧化物带走镁
chapters.caption: Mg²⁺与2OH⁻形成Mg(OH)₂，过量OH⁻留待最后处理。
chapters.captionEn: Mg²⁺ and 2OH⁻ form Mg(OH)₂; excess OH⁻ remains for later treatment.

chapters.title: 碳酸根同时处理钙和钡
chapters.caption: CO₃²⁻使Ca²⁺及前面过量加入的Ba²⁺进入沉淀。
chapters.captionEn: Carbonate precipitates both calcium and the barium left from the earlier addition.

chapters.title: 把固体与溶液真正分开
chapters.caption: 滤纸截留沉淀和不溶物；Na⁺、Cl⁻及过量碱性成分随滤液通过。
chapters.captionEn: The paper retains precipitates and insoluble matter; dissolved ions pass with the filtrate.

chapters.title: 为什么不能把加酸提到过滤前
chapters.caption: 先过滤再加酸可处理过量OH⁻与CO₃²⁻；提前加酸会使部分沉淀重新溶解。
chapters.captionEn: Acid treats excess OH⁻ and carbonate after filtration; adding it earlier can redissolve precipitates.

chapters.title: 蒸发不能补救漏掉的反应
chapters.titleEn: Evaporation cannot repair a missed reaction
chapters.caption: 处理后的滤液蒸发留下盐；未除去的非挥发杂质也会留下。
chapters.captionEn: Evaporating treated filtrate leaves salt; nonvolatile impurities that escaped removal remain too.

chapters.title: 两类生殖细胞分别准备
chapters.caption: 卵母细胞成熟与精子获能是不同过程。
chapters.captionEn: Oocyte maturation and sperm capacitation are separate processes.

chapters.title: 先接触，再进入卵细胞
chapters.titleEn: Contact precedes entry into the oocyte
chapters.caption: 追踪进入的精子来源，区分两个原核。
chapters.captionEn: Track the entering sperm origin and distinguish two pronuclei.

chapters.title: 卵裂先增加细胞数
chapters.caption: 早期总体积近似不变，各细胞变小。
chapters.captionEn: Early total volume remains approximately constant as cells become smaller.

chapters.title: 收集以后逐枚检查
chapters.caption: 形态筛选与最终妊娠结果不是同一证据。
chapters.captionEn: Morphological selection differs from eventual pregnancy evidence.

chapters.title: 让胚胎阶段与受体周期对应
chapters.titleEn: Match embryo stage to the recipient cycle
chapters.caption: 胚胎阶段需要与受体生理状态相适应。
chapters.captionEn: The embryo stage must suit the recipient’s physiological state.

chapters.title: 胚胎沿导管进入正确腔道
chapters.titleEn: The embryo travels through the catheter into the lumen
chapters.caption: 同一E1标记在导管内移动，再从管口释放。
chapters.captionEn: The same E1 marker travels inside the catheter before release.

chapters.title: 先识别囊胚的不同区域
chapters.caption: 内细胞团、滋养层与囊胚腔承担不同角色。
chapters.captionEn: Inner cell mass, trophectoderm and cavity are distinct structures.

chapters.title: 分割线同时考虑内细胞团
chapters.titleEn: Place the cut through the inner cell mass
chapters.caption: 刀具先通过组织，两份才逐渐分开。
chapters.captionEn: The blade crosses the tissue before the two portions separate.

chapters.title: 切线偏移会改变两份的组成
chapters.titleEn: An offset cut changes the composition of each portion
chapters.caption: 一份缺少内细胞团，不能只看分出了两块。
chapters.captionEn: One portion lacks inner cell mass: two pieces are not sufficient evidence.

chapters.title: 水相中的取代
chapters.caption: 水溶液中，羟基取代溴，溴离子进入水相。
chapters.captionEn: In the aqueous route, hydroxyl replaces bromine and bromide enters water.

chapters.title: 取上层水样
chapters.caption: 溴乙烷在下层；检验应取上层水相到另一管。
chapters.captionEn: Bromoethane is the lower layer; transfer the upper aqueous phase for testing.

chapters.title: 先酸化再检验
chapters.caption: 先排除氢氧根干扰，再把浅黄色沉淀解释为 AgBr。
chapters.captionEn: Remove hydroxide interference before interpreting pale yellow AgBr.

chapters.title: 确认醇类产物
chapters.caption: 分离后的产物需要组合证据；O—H 峰本身不能区分两种醇。
chapters.captionEn: Use combined evidence after separation; an O–H band alone cannot distinguish two alcohols.

chapters.title: 醇溶液中的消去
chapters.caption: 相邻碳上的氢与溴被脱去，碳骨架上形成双键。
chapters.captionEn: Removing hydrogen and bromine from adjacent carbons creates a double bond.

chapters.title: 水洗气的对照
chapters.caption: 先除去乙醇蒸气，减少高锰酸钾检验的假阳性。
chapters.captionEn: Remove ethanol vapor before interpreting the permanganate test.

chapters.title: 乙醇脱水与碱洗气
chapters.caption: 乙醇脱水装置中的碱洗气，针对的是酸性杂质。
chapters.captionEn: The alkaline wash in ethanol dehydration targets acidic impurities.

chapters.title: 净化后的烯烃检验
chapters.caption: 分别检验净化气体，并用杂质对照检查结论。
chapters.captionEn: Test separate portions of purified gas and check impurity controls.

chapters.title: 取样先确定比较对象
chapters.titleEn: Define the sample and its reference
chapters.caption: 直接收集雨水并保留参照水；清澈的外观不能说明酸度相同。
chapters.captionEn: Collect rain directly and retain reference water; clear appearance does not establish equal acidity.

chapters.title: 同一样品，两种测量
chapters.titleEn: Two methods for the same sample
chapters.caption: 试纸提供有限分辨率的颜色比较，pH计的数字也需要校准与质量检查。
chapters.captionEn: Paper gives a colour comparison with limited resolution; a meter still needs calibration and quality checks.

chapters.title: 校准后再看判断边界
chapters.caption: 教材用pH5.6作参考；读数区间跨过参考线时，不能作精确二分判断。
chapters.captionEn: The textbook uses pH 5.6 as a reference; an interval crossing it does not support a precise binary decision.

chapters.title: 连续记录并保留缺测
chapters.titleEn: Keep a sequence and preserve missing records
chapters.caption: 连续记录要标明样品、时间与缺测；没有样品不能记作pH0。
chapters.captionEn: A sequence records samples, times and gaps; no sample must not become pH 0.

chapters.title: 平均酸度需要先定义
chapters.caption: pH是对数。平均pH与先按水量平均H⁺再换算，是不同的统计量。
chapters.captionEn: pH is logarithmic: averaging pH differs from weighting H⁺ by water amount before converting back.

chapters.title: 苯酚与碱
chapters.caption: 形成可溶的苯酚盐，原先分离的苯酚逐渐消失。
chapters.captionEn: Soluble phenolate forms, reducing the separated neutral phenol.

chapters.title: 加酸恢复苯酚
chapters.caption: 加酸使苯酚根重新获得质子，溶解限度之外的苯酚析出。
chapters.captionEn: Acid reprotonates phenolate; neutral phenol beyond its solubility separates.

chapters.title: 碳酸与苯酚
chapters.caption: 二氧化碳进入水中，也能使苯酚根转回苯酚。
chapters.captionEn: Carbon dioxide in water can also convert phenolate back to phenol.

chapters.title: 邻对位溴代
chapters.caption: 羟基影响苯环，2、4、6 位的氢被溴取代。
chapters.captionEn: The hydroxyl group activates substitution at positions 2, 4 and 6.

chapters.title: 铁盐显色
chapters.caption: 苯酚与铁盐的紫色，属于另一种配合显色证据。
chapters.captionEn: The violet ferric-ion response is a different kind of evidence.

chapters.title: 利斯特的防腐证据
chapters.caption: 历史病例与多项防腐干预支持实践，证据类型需要说清。
chapters.captionEn: Historical cases and combined antiseptic measures supported practice.

chapters.title: 验证羧酸的酸性
chapters.caption: 甲酸、苯甲酸和乙二酸，分别提供可检验的酸性证据。
chapters.captionEn: Formic, benzoic and oxalic acids each provide testable acidic behavior.

chapters.title: 一次性酸性比较
chapters.caption: 乙酸先释放 CO₂，净化后的 CO₂ 再使苯酚钠变浑浊。
chapters.captionEn: Acetic acid releases CO₂; purified CO₂ then clouds sodium phenolate.

chapters.title: 去除乙酸的干扰
chapters.caption: 只保留乙酸蒸气的反例，显示洗气为什么属于证据链。
chapters.captionEn: An acetic-vapor-only counterexample reveals why washing matters.

chapters.title: 新制银氨溶液
chapters.caption: 制备阶段的沉淀溶解，尚不是银镜反应。
chapters.captionEn: Dissolving the preparation precipitate is not yet the silver-mirror reaction.

chapters.title: 银沉积到内壁
chapters.titleEn: Silver deposits on the inner wall
chapters.caption: 乙醛失去两个电子，两个银离子被还原为金属银。
chapters.captionEn: Ethanal supplies two electrons, reducing two silver ions to metal.

chapters.title: 新制氢氧化铜
chapters.caption: 过量碱中制得的蓝色 Cu(OH)₂，是反应前的悬浊液。
chapters.captionEn: Blue Cu(OH)₂ in excess base is the starting suspension.

chapters.title: 砖红色氧化亚铜
chapters.caption: 两份 Cu(II) 接受两个电子，生成一份 Cu₂O。
chapters.captionEn: Two Cu(II) centers accept two electrons to produce one Cu₂O unit.

chapters.title: 切断的位置在DNA骨架上
chapters.titleEn: Cut the DNA backbone at specified sites
chapters.caption: EcoRI产生互补的AATT黏性末端。
chapters.captionEn: EcoRI produces complementary AATT cohesive ends.

chapters.title: 末端配对还没有修复骨架
chapters.titleEn: Pairing does not yet seal the backbone
chapters.caption: 碱基配对以后，两处骨架缺口仍然存在。
chapters.captionEn: Two backbone nicks remain after the bases pair.

chapters.title: 连接酶修复磷酸二酯键
chapters.caption: 连续的是糖—磷酸骨架，不是新增一段碱基。
chapters.captionEn: The sugar–phosphate backbone becomes continuous without adding a base segment.

chapters.title: 载体还需要复制与筛选功能
chapters.titleEn: Vectors also need maintenance and selection
chapters.caption: 复制原点与标记基因不是目的基因的替代品。
chapters.captionEn: An origin and selectable marker do not substitute for the target gene.

chapters.title: 破碎组织后获得粗滤液
chapters.titleEn: Disrupt tissue and collect crude filtrate
chapters.caption: DNA经过滤路，较大的组织碎屑被截留。
chapters.captionEn: DNA follows the filtration route while larger debris is retained.

chapters.title: 预冷酒精使粗提物析出
chapters.titleEn: Cold alcohol precipitates a crude extract
chapters.caption: 白色丝状物的出现与纯度证明分开。
chapters.captionEn: A white fibrous precipitate is not proof of purity.

chapters.title: 用相同处理的空白作比较
chapters.caption: 相同试剂和加热条件下，比较样品与空白。
chapters.captionEn: Compare sample and blank under matched reagent and heating conditions.

chapters.title: 目标片段需要合适的获取方法
chapters.caption: PCR依赖已知引物与相应模板条件。
chapters.captionEn: PCR requires suitable primers and corresponding template conditions.

chapters.title: 把表达元件按方向接入载体
chapters.caption: 启动子、目的基因和终止子形成明确顺序。
chapters.captionEn: Promoter, target and terminator have a defined order.

chapters.title: 进入细胞以后仍要分层检验
chapters.titleEn: Entry still requires separate levels of verification
chapters.caption: DNA存在、RNA产生、蛋白表达分别需要证据。
chapters.captionEn: DNA presence, RNA production and protein expression need distinct evidence.

chapters.title: 温度循环控制三种分子事件
chapters.titleEn: A thermal cycle controls three molecular events
chapters.caption: 变性、引物结合与延伸按顺序发生。
chapters.captionEn: Denaturation, primer binding and extension occur in sequence.

chapters.title: 每轮产物成为下一轮模板
chapters.titleEn: Products become templates in later cycles
chapters.caption: 指数增长是条件理想时的上限示意。
chapters.captionEn: Exponential growth illustrates ideal conditions.

chapters.title: 用标准和对照阅读条带
chapters.titleEn: Read bands with a ladder and controls
chapters.caption: 小片段迁移更远，同大小仍不等于同序列。
chapters.captionEn: Smaller fragments migrate farther; equal size does not establish equal sequence.

chapters.title: 先有初温，才有温差
chapters.caption: 先记录盐酸初温，再把镁条反应后的温度与它比较。
chapters.captionEn: Record the acid’s initial temperature before comparing it with the reacting mixture.

chapters.title: 气泡、镁条与温升
chapters.titleEn: Connect bubbles, magnesium consumption and warming
chapters.caption: 镁与H⁺反应产生H₂，反应释放的能量使溶液与器物升温。
chapters.captionEn: Magnesium reacts with H⁺ to form H₂, while released energy warms the solution and apparatus.

chapters.title: 反应完成后仍可降温
chapters.titleEn: Cooling can continue after reaction completion
chapters.caption: 镁已反应完，热的试管仍向较冷环境传热；降温不表示反应倒转。
chapters.captionEn: After magnesium is consumed, the warm tube still transfers heat outward; cooling does not imply reversal.

chapters.title: 两种晶体混合后降温
chapters.titleEn: Two crystals react and cool the mixture
chapters.caption: Ba(OH)₂·8H₂O与NH₄Cl的反应吸热，混合物出现液相并降温。
chapters.captionEn: Hydrated barium hydroxide and ammonium chloride react endothermically, forming liquid and cooling.

chapters.title: 追踪杯底的水层
chapters.titleEn: Follow the water beneath the beaker
chapters.caption: 水层先冷却，再在凝固时释放潜热；继续吸热可使它形成冰层。
chapters.captionEn: The water layer first cools, then releases latent heat as it freezes and supplies the endothermic process.

chapters.title: 用干湿木片检验连接原因
chapters.caption: 有冰层时木片可随烧杯抬起；干木片即使变冷，也没有这层冰连接。
chapters.captionEn: An ice layer can lift the wet wood with the beaker; dry wood lacks that ice connection even when cold.

chapters.title: 三条酯键的皂化
chapters.caption: 甘油骨架保留，三条脂肪酸链成为羧酸盐。
chapters.captionEn: The glycerol backbone remains while three fatty-acid chains become carboxylates.

chapters.title: 盐析分离
chapters.caption: 盐降低皂在水相中的溶解程度，皂相与母液分开。
chapters.captionEn: Salt reduces soap solubility, separating a soap-rich phase from the mother liquor.

chapters.title: 洗涤与成形
chapters.caption: 滤去母液、减少夹带杂质，再得到可成形的皂相。
chapters.captionEn: Remove mother liquor and carried impurities before shaping the soap-rich phase.

chapters.title: 油水界面上的肥皂
chapters.caption: 亲水端留在水中，疏水链进入油相。
chapters.captionEn: Hydrophilic heads face water while hydrophobic chains enter oil.

chapters.title: 去污与硬水对照
chapters.caption: 界面覆盖配合扰动帮助油污脱离；硬水会消耗肥皂。
chapters.captionEn: Interfacial coverage and agitation help oil detach; hard water consumes soap.

chapters.title: 表面活性剂的类型
chapters.caption: 两亲性相似，亲水基团的电性可以不同。
chapters.captionEn: Amphiphilic architecture can have different head-group charges.

chapters.title: 逆推两个酯键
chapters.caption: 把目标酯倒推为乙二酸与两份乙醇，保留六个碳的来源。
chapters.captionEn: Plan oxalic acid and two ethanols while preserving the six-carbon accounting.

chapters.title: 分支合成路线
chapters.caption: 两条乙烯支路分别提供乙醇与乙二酸，再汇合成酯。
chapters.captionEn: Ethene branches provide ethanol and oxalic acid before esterification.

chapters.title: 碳碳双键的检验
chapters.caption: 1-己烯的褪色需要与萃取和其他氧化反应区分。
chapters.captionEn: Distinguish 1-hexene reactions from extraction and other oxidation.

chapters.title: 水解后检验卤素
chapters.caption: 先把共价卤素转为水相离子，再排除氢氧根干扰。
chapters.captionEn: Release aqueous halide before excluding hydroxide interference.

chapters.title: 酚羟基的证据
chapters.caption: 溴代白色沉淀与铁盐显色，是两项相互补充的检验。
chapters.captionEn: Bromination precipitate and ferric-ion color provide complementary tests.

chapters.title: 醛基的还原检验
chapters.caption: 新制 Cu(OH)₂ 在所示条件下被乙醛还原为 Cu₂O。
chapters.captionEn: Ethanal reduces fresh Cu(OH)₂ to Cu₂O under the specified conditions.

chapters.title: 组合证据鉴别样品
chapters.caption: 每次排除候选，都要能指出独立观察与适用条件。
chapters.captionEn: Every eliminated candidate must follow from an independent valid observation.

chapters.title: 阿司匹林的两个官能团
chapters.caption: 分别取样看酸性；水解并中和过量酸后，再检验显露的酚羟基。
chapters.captionEn: Use separate samples for acidity and for hydrolysis followed by the phenolic test.

chapters.title: 核磁共振作为补充证据
chapters.caption: 氢环境与积分比例补充化学检验，示意谱不冒充实测数据。
chapters.captionEn: Hydrogen environments and integrals complement tests; these are schematic spectra.

chapters.title: 从同一组原子出发
chapters.titleEn: Start with the same tracked atoms
chapters.caption: H₂与Cl₂变为HCl时，原子种类与数目不变，连接关系改变。
chapters.captionEn: When H₂ and Cl₂ form HCl, atom identities and counts stay fixed while bonds change.

chapters.title: 把断键成本记进去
chapters.titleEn: Account for the energy needed to break bonds
chapters.caption: 断开1mol H—H与1mol Cl—Cl，教材分别记436kJ和243kJ的吸能。
chapters.captionEn: Breaking 1 mol each of H—H and Cl—Cl costs 436 kJ and 243 kJ in the textbook account.

chapters.title: 形成新键时释放能量
chapters.titleEn: Release energy when new bonds form
chapters.caption: 形成2mol H—Cl键，教材记862kJ的放能；原子仍是先前那一组。
chapters.captionEn: Forming 2 mol of H—Cl bonds releases 862 kJ in the textbook account, using the same atoms.

chapters.title: 比较吸收与释放的总量
chapters.caption: 679kJ−862kJ≈−183kJ，净结果是向环境放出能量。
chapters.captionEn: 679 kJ −862 kJ ≈ −183 kJ: the net result releases energy to the surroundings.

chapters.title: 不同途径，相同始态与终态
chapters.caption: 石墨与O₂生成CO₂，直接完成或经CO分步完成，总焓变相同。
chapters.captionEn: Graphite and O₂ forming CO₂ have the same total enthalpy change directly or through CO.

chapters.title: 消去中间物种，求未知量
chapters.titleEn: Cancel the intermediate and solve the unknown
chapters.caption: 直接反应的−393.5kJ减去CO氧化的−283.0kJ，得到生成CO的−110.5kJ。
chapters.captionEn: Subtracting −283.0 kJ for CO oxidation from −393.5 kJ overall gives −110.5 kJ for CO formation.

chapters.title: 从预期功能开始设计
chapters.caption: 设计推理反向展开，表达仍沿DNA到蛋白质进行。
chapters.captionEn: Design reasoning works backward; expression proceeds from DNA to protein.

chapters.title: 一个短肽对应多种编码方案
chapters.titleEn: One short peptide admits multiple coding choices
chapters.caption: Ala–Trp–Lys–Glu–Phe有32种所示编码链组合。
chapters.captionEn: The illustrated five-residue peptide has 32 coding-strand combinations.

chapters.title: 优劣取决于预先定义的测定
chapters.titleEn: Performance depends on a specified assay
chapters.caption: 改变温度，合成测定中两种酶的排名可以改变。
chapters.captionEn: Changing temperature can reverse the ranking in this synthetic assay.

chapters.title: 从真实结构找出改造位置
chapters.titleEn: Locate the changes in measured coordinates
chapters.caption: A链21个残基、B链30个残基，三条二硫键保留。
chapters.captionEn: The 21-residue A chain and 30-residue B chain retain three disulfides.

chapters.title: 交换相邻残基改变相互作用
chapters.titleEn: Exchange adjacent residues to alter interactions
chapters.caption: 赖脯胰岛素将B28的P和B29的K交换。
chapters.captionEn: Insulin lispro exchanges P at B28 and K at B29.

chapters.title: 减少关联不等于永不聚集
chapters.titleEn: Reduced association does not mean none
chapters.caption: 示意曲线满足C=M+2D；关联仍随浓度改变。
chapters.captionEn: The illustrative model conserves C=M+2D while association varies with concentration.

chapters.title: 先确认数据库版本和比较范围
chapters.titleEn: Check record versions and comparable regions
chapters.caption: 前体中的A链、B链需要按注释分别提取。
chapters.captionEn: Extract the annotated mature A and B chains separately from precursors.

chapters.title: 把差异放回同源位置
chapters.caption: 分别对齐两条成熟链后，汇总相同位置。
chapters.captionEn: Align the two mature chains separately before aggregating matches.

chapters.title: 一致性必须连同比对范围阅读
chapters.caption: B链前20位完全相同，只覆盖30位中的三分之二。
chapters.captionEn: The identical first 20 B-chain residues cover only two-thirds of the chain.

chapters.title: 反应前，两种溶液分别量温
chapters.caption: 等体积稀溶液近似有相同热容量，初温取两者平均。
chapters.captionEn: For equal volumes of dilute solutions, use the mean starting temperature.

chapters.title: 混合后，追踪最高温度
chapters.caption: 内筒、隔热层与杯盖减少散热；温度计浸入液体，搅拌使读数有代表性。
chapters.captionEn: The inner cup, insulation and lid reduce heat loss; an immersed thermometer follows the stirred liquid.

chapters.title: 三次温差，换算到一摩尔
chapters.titleEn: Repeat three times and convert per mole
chapters.caption: 先平均三次温差，再算100g溶液吸热；生成水为0.025mol。
chapters.captionEn: Average three temperature rises, then calculate heat absorbed by 100 g of solution; 0.025 mol of water forms.

chapters.title: 没有计入的热量去了哪里
chapters.titleEn: Account for heat outside the solution
chapters.caption: 反应放热分到溶液、杯体和环境；重复测量不能消除同方向的系统偏差。
chapters.captionEn: Released heat enters the solution, vessel and surroundings; repeated trials do not remove systematic bias.

chapters.title: 冰量热计的三层空间
chapters.caption: 中央放热，测量冰吸热；外围防护冰截留环境热，两层融水分别排出。
chapters.captionEn: The central source melts measurement ice; outer guard ice intercepts ambient heat, with a separate drain.

chapters.title: 反应热化成多少融水
chapters.titleEn: Turn released energy into melted ice
chapters.caption: 冰与水共存时，吸收的热量用于相变；测量层的融水逐渐积累。
chapters.captionEn: With ice and water coexisting, absorbed heat drives melting and the measurement melt accumulates.

chapters.title: 把融水质量换回热量
chapters.titleEn: Convert measurement melt mass to heat
chapters.caption: 在零摄氏度融冰、完整收集等理想条件下，Q=m融冰L；防护层融水不相加。
chapters.captionEn: For ice initially at 0 °C and complete collection, Q = mL; do not add guard melt.

chapters.title: 从单体到链段
chapters.caption: 双键参与加聚，碳与氯的身份保留，不生成小分子副产物。
chapters.captionEn: Addition retains the carbon and chlorine identities without a small-molecule byproduct.

chapters.title: 连接一次，排出一份水
chapters.titleEn: A link and a water molecule
chapters.caption: 二酸与二醇形成一条开链时，2n 个单体形成 2n − 1 个连接。
chapters.captionEn: An open chain from 2n diacid and diol molecules has 2n − 1 links.

chapters.title: 水浴中的酚醛树脂
chapters.titleEn: Phenolic resin in a water bath
chapters.caption: 实验比较酸、碱条件；教材用酸催化与等物质的量配比解释线型结构。
chapters.captionEn: The experiment compares catalysts; the textbook explains a linear structure with acid catalysis and equimolar reactants.

chapters.title: 继续反应形成交联网
chapters.caption: 碱催化、甲醛过量与继续反应共同构成此处的网状树脂条件。
chapters.captionEn: Base catalysis, excess formaldehyde and further reaction support this crosslinked resin model.

chapters.title: 吸水而不溶解
chapters.caption: 亲水基团帮助吸水，少量交联让原有网络在膨胀时保持相连。
chapters.captionEn: Hydrophilic groups support water uptake while sparse crosslinks retain a connected network.

chapters.title: 同质量、同水量的对照
chapters.titleEn: Equal dry mass and water supply
chapters.caption: 两份 1.0 g 材料接触相同水量；本片容量是明确标出的假设值。
chapters.captionEn: Equal 1.0 g samples receive equal water; capacities here are explicitly hypothetical.

chapters.title: 倾水、扣皮重、计算
chapters.caption: 先倾出未吸收的水，再用湿样质量计算 g/g；残留游离水会高估结果。
chapters.captionEn: Drain unabsorbed water and subtract tare; retained free water inflates the g/g result.

chapters.title: 从具体对象和原始清单开始
chapters.titleEn: Start with an identified event and original list
chapters.caption: 同是安全证书，条目中的对象、用途和区域不同。
chapters.captionEn: Certificate entries specify different events, purposes and regions.

chapters.title: 改变用途会越出证据范围
chapters.titleEn: Changing the proposed use exceeds the evidence
chapters.caption: 加工原料条目不能直接支持种植用途。
chapters.captionEn: An imported-processing entry does not establish permission to plant.

chapters.title: 生产过程与最终产品分开记录
chapters.titleEn: Record manufacturing origin and final product separately
chapters.caption: 重组DNA生产证据不等于产品里存在活的工程菌。
chapters.captionEn: Recombinant production does not mean the product contains living engineered bacteria.

chapters.title: 翻面后再核对原料与目录
chapters.caption: 先记录标签原文，再核对原料、类别与适用规定。
chapters.captionEn: Record exact wording before checking ingredients, category and applicable rules.

chapters.title: 缺失记录不能变成阴性结论
chapters.titleEn: Missing observations are not negative findings
chapters.caption: 八条教学记录中，三条未记录仍保持未知。
chapters.captionEn: Three of the eight teaching records remain unrecorded, not negative.

chapters.title: 营销语句不能代替比较研究
chapters.titleEn: Marketing language cannot replace comparison evidence
chapters.caption: “非转基因”几个字不能独立证明“更安全”。
chapters.captionEn: The words non-GM alone do not establish greater safety.

chapters.title: 把观察、证据和边界带入科普
chapters.caption: 科普草案保留原始链接、资料日期和未解决问题。
chapters.captionEn: A communication draft retains original links, dates and unresolved questions.

chapters.title: 保持混合气相同，只改变光照
chapters.titleEn: Hold the mixture fixed and change light
chapters.caption: 相同甲烷—氯气混合物，一组遮光、一组在光亮处比较。
chapters.captionEn: Compare identical methane–chlorine mixtures in darkness and in light.

chapters.title: 光照一侧颜色变浅
chapters.caption: 光照引发反应，Cl₂消耗，黄绿色逐渐变浅；新鲜遮光对照保持原状。
chapters.captionEn: Light initiates reaction and Cl₂ is consumed, while the fresh dark control remains unchanged.

chapters.title: 液滴与液面提供另一组证据
chapters.titleEn: Look for droplets and liquid rise
chapters.caption: 管壁出现有机液滴，HCl进入水相，气相减少而液面上升。
chapters.captionEn: Organic droplets appear; HCl enters the aqueous phase and the liquid level rises as gas is removed.

chapters.title: 跟踪一个氢和两个氯
chapters.titleEn: Track one hydrogen and two chlorines
chapters.caption: 每次净取代消耗1份Cl₂：一个Cl连到碳，另一个与离去的H组成HCl。
chapters.captionEn: Each net substitution uses one Cl₂: one Cl bonds to carbon and the other forms HCl with the displaced H.

chapters.title: 继续取代，形成多种产物
chapters.caption: 剩余C—H仍可被取代，不能只凭一条方程式认定产物只有CH₃Cl。
chapters.captionEn: Remaining C—H bonds can undergo further substitution, so the product is not exclusively CH₃Cl.

chapters.title: 太阳中的陌生谱线
chapters.caption: 相近的黄色并不等于同一种谱线；波长标尺先要对齐。
chapters.captionEn: Similar yellow colors are not identical spectral lines; compare calibrated wavelengths.

chapters.title: 把天空与矿物联系起来
chapters.titleEn: Connect sunlight with a mineral gas
chapters.caption: 矿物中释放的气体提供可比对的地面光谱证据。
chapters.captionEn: Gas released from a mineral supplied a terrestrial spectrum for comparison.

chapters.title: 一丁点密度差
chapters.caption: 同体积、同条件下，教材两组数据相差每升 6.4 mg。
chapters.captionEn: At equal volume and conditions, the textbook values differ by 6.4 mg per liter.

chapters.title: 剩余气体没有消失
chapters.caption: 移去已知组分后，残留气体及其独立光谱继续支持新元素判断。
chapters.captionEn: After known components are removed, the residual gas and its distinct spectrum support a new element.

chapters.title: 密封打开后出现新物质
chapters.titleEn: A new material appears after contact
chapters.caption: 相近的电离能启发假设；打开密封后的新产物提供实验检验。
chapters.captionEn: Similar ionization energies motivated a hypothesis; new material after contact tested it.

chapters.title: 修正的是绝对判断
chapters.caption: 已确认的氙化合物推翻“绝不反应”，但反应仍取决于具体条件。
chapters.captionEn: Confirmed xenon compounds refute absolute inertness; reactivity still depends on conditions.

chapters.title: 比较入射与透过
chapters.caption: 同一波数下比较 I 与 I₀，吸收越强，透过率越低。
chapters.captionEn: At one wavenumber, compare I with I₀: stronger absorption gives lower transmittance.

chapters.title: 频率吻合还不够
chapters.caption: 红外活性还要求振动改变偶极矩；N₂ 振动提供反例。
chapters.captionEn: Infrared activity also requires a changing dipole; N₂ vibration is a counterexample.

chapters.title: 把透过率连成谱
chapters.caption: 波数由高到低扫描，透过率谷对应样品的吸收带。
chapters.captionEn: Scan from high to low wavenumber; transmittance valleys mark absorption bands.

chapters.title: 把谱带联系到官能团
chapters.caption: O–H、C–H 与 C–O 的证据共同支持含羟基结构。
chapters.captionEn: O–H, C–H and C–O evidence together supports a hydroxyl-containing structure.

chapters.title: 同分异构体与干扰
chapters.caption: C₂H₆O 候选中的羟基有区分力，但未扣除水背景会造成误判。
chapters.captionEn: A hydroxyl band distinguishes the C₂H₆O candidates, but unremoved water can mislead.

chapters.title: 先看乙烯的燃烧
chapters.caption: 乙烯燃烧时火焰明亮并伴有黑烟；烟炱提示局部不完全燃烧。
chapters.captionEn: Ethene gives a bright flame with soot, indicating locally incomplete combustion.

chapters.title: 让氧化剂提供可见证据
chapters.titleEn: Use an oxidant as visible evidence
chapters.caption: 乙烯使酸性KMnO₄褪色，对应氧化还原变化。
chapters.captionEn: Ethene decolourises acidic KMnO₄ through a redox change.

chapters.title: 换成溴的四氯化碳溶液
chapters.titleEn: Change to bromine in carbon tetrachloride
chapters.caption: 溴的颜色变浅，但这次要用不饱和碳原子的加成来解释。
chapters.captionEn: Bromine fades, but here addition at the unsaturated carbons explains the change.

chapters.title: 跟住两个碳和两个溴
chapters.titleEn: Track both carbons and both bromines
chapters.caption: 两个碳保持相连，Br₂的两个Br分别连到两个碳，形成1,2-二溴乙烷。
chapters.captionEn: The carbon skeleton remains connected and one Br attaches to each carbon, forming 1,2-dibromoethane.

chapters.title: 从电石沿气路追踪乙炔
chapters.titleEn: Trace ethyne from the carbide generator
chapters.caption: CaC₂与水生成乙炔，气体从发生瓶进入洗气瓶液面以下。
chapters.captionEn: Calcium carbide reacts with water; the gas enters the scrubber below its liquid surface.

chapters.title: 洗气先排除干扰
chapters.caption: CuSO₄洗气液吸收H₂S等杂质；否则杂质也可能消耗性质检验试剂。
chapters.captionEn: The CuSO₄ scrubber removes H₂S impurity that could otherwise consume the test reagents.

chapters.title: 分别检验氧化与加成
chapters.caption: 净化乙炔分别使酸性KMnO₄与Br₂溶液褪色；三键可分步加成两份Br₂。
chapters.captionEn: Purified ethyne decolourises both reagents; its triple bond can add two Br₂ units in successive steps.

chapters.title: 最后观察乙炔燃烧
chapters.caption: 教材在净化并检验气体纯度后观察燃烧；火焰伴有明显黑烟。
chapters.captionEn: The textbook observes combustion after purification and gas-purity checking; soot accompanies the bright flame.

chapters.title: 没有外电流，锌仍可与酸反应
chapters.titleEn: Zinc can react with acid without external current
chapters.caption: 导线断开：锌表面仍有析氢，电流表为零。
chapters.captionEn: Open wire: local hydrogen evolution remains while external current is zero.

chapters.title: 让还原反应在铜表面发生
chapters.titleEn: Enable reduction at the copper surface
chapters.caption: 连接后，电子由锌经导线到铜，铜表面析氢。
chapters.captionEn: Connection routes electrons from zinc to copper, where hydrogen evolves.

chapters.title: 导线与溶液使用不同载流子
chapters.titleEn: Conductors and solution carry charge differently
chapters.caption: 电子沿导体传递，电解质中的离子迁移维持电路。
chapters.captionEn: Electrons move through conductors; ionic migration completes the electrolyte path.

chapters.title: 水果提供电解质，不单独供给电能
chapters.titleEn: Fruit supplies electrolyte, not energy by itself
chapters.caption: 锌、铜和水果中的离子通路共同组成电池。
chapters.captionEn: Zinc, copper and the ionic route inside the fruit form the cell.

chapters.title: 换成湿纸，重新检查反应条件
