chapters.titleEn: With wet paper, check the new reaction conditions
chapters.caption: 盐水湿纸提供离子通路；相同条件的两片铜不给出所示电势。
chapters.captionEn: Saline paper provides an ionic path; matching copper electrodes give no illustrated EMF.

chapters.title: 串联同时增加电势和内阻
chapters.titleEn: Series cells add both EMF and internal resistance
chapters.caption: 增加电池数量后，LED电流仍受总内阻限制。
chapters.captionEn: Adding cells can light the LED, but total internal resistance still limits current.

chapters.title: 两种导体接触不是完整原电池
chapters.titleEn: Touching conductors do not constitute a complete cell
chapters.caption: 没有电解质通路，所示金属接触回路不持续供电。
chapters.captionEn: Without an electrolyte route, the illustrated contact loop supplies no sustained current.

chapters.title: 用石墨表面对照电极材料
chapters.titleEn: Compare an inert graphite reaction surface
chapters.caption: Zn/C也可形成所示电池；Cu/C不具备这里的活泼金属反应。
chapters.captionEn: Zn/C supports the illustrated cell; Cu/C lacks its active-metal reaction.

chapters.title: 把两个半电池的电荷通路接通
chapters.caption: 盐桥浸入两侧液体后，锌铜半电池形成完整回路。
chapters.captionEn: The immersed salt bridge completes the two-half-cell circuit.

chapters.title: 金属变化与离子补偿同时发生
chapters.caption: 锌减少、铜增加；Cl⁻向锌侧、K⁺向铜侧迁移。
chapters.captionEn: Zinc decreases and copper increases; Cl⁻ enters the zinc side and K⁺ the copper side.

chapters.title: 移出盐桥，中断的是离子通路
chapters.titleEn: Removing the bridge interrupts the ionic route
chapters.caption: 盐桥口离开液面后，电流归零，已有沉积保留。
chapters.captionEn: Once bridge mouths leave the liquids, current stops and prior deposits remain.

chapters.title: 先由外电源制得两种气体
chapters.titleEn: First use external power to produce the gases
chapters.caption: K1闭合、K2断开；电解产生H₂与O₂，左侧局部变碱。
chapters.captionEn: K1 is closed and K2 open: electrolysis produces H₂/O₂ and local alkalinity at the left electrode.

chapters.title: 断开外电源再切换负载
chapters.titleEn: Disconnect external power before switching to a load
chapters.caption: 两支路均断开时，留存气体还在，外电流为零。
chapters.captionEn: With both branches open, retained gas remains but external current is zero.

chapters.title: 用有限留存气体释放电能
chapters.titleEn: Release energy from finite retained gas
chapters.caption: K2闭合后电流出现，随着留存反应物消耗而衰减。
chapters.captionEn: Closing K2 produces current that declines as the finite reactants are consumed.

chapters.title: 先得到离子
chapters.caption: 电子电离形成分子正离子，电荷与电子数量要一起核对。
chapters.captionEn: Electron ionization creates a molecular cation; account for charge and electrons together.

chapters.title: 同一装置分开不同质荷比
chapters.caption: 同电压与磁场下，离子曲率由 m/z 决定；收集狭缝只接收窄范围轨迹。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed voltage and field, m/z determines curvature and the collector accepts a narrow trajectory range.

chapters.title: 失去一部分，但仍带电
chapters.titleEn: Lose a fragment and retain charge
chapters.caption: 92 的分子离子失去中性氢后，可留下 91 的带电片段。
chapters.captionEn: A molecular ion at 92 can lose neutral hydrogen and leave a charged fragment at 91.

chapters.title: 最高的峰不是分子质量
chapters.titleEn: The tallest peak need not give molecular mass
chapters.caption: 甲苯示例中基峰为 91，分子离子峰为 92。
chapters.captionEn: In the toluene example, the base peak is 91 and the molecular-ion peak is 92.

chapters.title: 实验式还要配合分子质量
chapters.titleEn: Combine empirical formula with molecular mass
chapters.caption: C₂H₆O 的实验式质量约为 46；确认单电荷分子离子 46 后得到 n = 1。
chapters.captionEn: C₂H₆O has empirical mass near 46; a confirmed singly charged molecular ion at 46 gives n = 1.

chapters.title: 最右边也不总是答案
chapters.titleEn: The rightmost peak is not always the answer
chapters.caption: 同位素会在分子离子旁增加更高 m/z 的峰。
chapters.captionEn: Isotopes can add higher-m/z signals beside the principal molecular-ion peak.

chapters.title: 质量相同，连接可以不同
chapters.titleEn: Equal mass can hide different connectivity
chapters.caption: C₂H₆O 可以连接为乙醇或二甲醚，还需独立结构证据。
chapters.captionEn: C₂H₆O permits ethanol or dimethyl ether, requiring independent structural evidence.

chapters.title: 从乙醇中的气体开始
chapters.titleEn: Begin with gas formation in ethanol
chapters.caption: 无水乙醇中加入钠后产生气体，钠逐渐消耗。
chapters.captionEn: Sodium in anhydrous ethanol produces gas and is gradually consumed.

chapters.title: 燃烧后的产物留下水滴
chapters.caption: 教材检验气体纯度后观察燃烧，干燥收集杯内出现水滴。
chapters.captionEn: After the textbook gas-purity check, combustion leaves droplets in a dry collector.

chapters.title: 把石灰水结果一起考虑
chapters.caption: 收集杯倒转后加入澄清石灰水，教材观察中没有出现碳酸钙浑浊。
chapters.captionEn: After turning the collector upright, limewater shows no calcium-carbonate cloudiness.

chapters.title: 追踪羟基里的两个氢
chapters.caption: 两个羟基H形成一份H₂，两个Na成为Na⁺；乙基中的C—H保持不变。
chapters.captionEn: Two hydroxyl H atoms form one H₂, while two Na become Na⁺; the ethyl C—H groups remain.

chapters.title: 相同钠样进入水与乙醇
chapters.titleEn: Compare equal sodium samples in both liquids
chapters.caption: 相同条件下，钠与水的反应更剧烈；等量钠充分反应的H₂终量可以相同。
chapters.captionEn: Water reacts more vigorously under comparable conditions; equal sodium amounts can give the same final H₂ amount.

chapters.title: 从现象回到O—H环境
chapters.titleEn: Relate the observation to the O—H environment
chapters.caption: 水与乙醇都有O—H，但周围基团不同；反应快慢不能直接换算成酸度或键能。
chapters.captionEn: Both liquids contain O—H, but the surrounding groups differ; observed speed is not a direct acidity or bond-energy measurement.

chapters.title: 观察铜表面
chapters.caption: 铜丝在空气中受热，表面出现黑色CuO。
chapters.captionEn: Heating copper in air produces a black CuO surface.

chapters.title: 乙醇中恢复铜色
chapters.caption: 热CuO与乙醇反应，生成铜、乙醛和水。
chapters.captionEn: Hot CuO reacts with ethanol to form copper, ethanal and water.

chapters.title: 把两步连成循环
chapters.caption: 铜与CuO循环；净反应消耗乙醇和氧气。
chapters.captionEn: Copper and CuO cycle; the net reaction consumes ethanol and oxygen.

chapters.title: 追踪失去的氢
chapters.caption: 一个羟基H与相邻碳上的一个H离开，形成羰基。
chapters.captionEn: One O–H hydrogen and one adjacent C–H hydrogen leave as a carbonyl forms.

chapters.title: 观察酸性氧化剂
chapters.caption: 酸性重铬酸钾由橙色转向绿色，Cr(VI)被还原。
chapters.captionEn: Acid dichromate shifts from orange towards green as Cr(VI) is reduced.

chapters.title: 区分氧化终点
chapters.caption: 乙醇可经乙醛继续氧化为乙酸；终点取决于条件。
chapters.captionEn: Ethanol can pass through ethanal to ethanoic acid; conditions determine the endpoint.

chapters.title: 氢属于哪个分子
chapters.caption: 实线 O—H 属于水分子内部；虚线联系另一个水分子的氧。
chapters.captionEn: The solid O–H bond is inside one molecule; the dashed link reaches another oxygen.

chapters.title: 从一个水分子看四个邻居
chapters.caption: 冰中一个水分子可提供两条氢键，并接受另外两条。
chapters.captionEn: An ice water molecule donates two hydrogen bonds and accepts two more.

chapters.title: 规则排列留下空隙
chapters.caption: 普通六方冰的开放网络来自有方向性的分子间连接。
chapters.captionEn: Directional intermolecular links form the open network of ordinary hexagonal ice.

chapters.title: 改变网络，保留水分子
chapters.titleEn: Change the network, retain the molecules
chapters.caption: 融化使有序结构部分解体；液态水仍存在氢键。
chapters.captionEn: Melting partly disrupts order while hydrogen bonds remain in liquid water.

chapters.title: 从体积到浮起
chapters.caption: 等质量的冰体积更大；浮起时排开水的重力等于自身重力。
chapters.captionEn: Equal-mass ice occupies more volume; at flotation, displaced water balances its weight.

chapters.title: 只改变水浴温度
chapters.caption: 相同过氧化氢和催化剂，比较同一时间的产气。
chapters.captionEn: Same peroxide and catalyst; compare gas over the same time.

chapters.title: 浓度对照要固定接触面积
chapters.titleEn: Keep surface area fixed when comparing concentration
chapters.caption: 盐酸浓度不同，大理石质量与接触面积相同。
chapters.captionEn: Different acid concentrations; equal marble mass and surface area.

chapters.title: 先让总体积相同
chapters.caption: 两组均为 4 mL；硫代硫酸钠初始浓度不同。
chapters.captionEn: Both mixtures are 4 mL, with different initial thiosulfate concentrations.

chapters.title: 配方不变，再比较温度
chapters.titleEn: Keep the recipe fixed and change temperature
chapters.caption: 相同配方和光程，比较浑浊发展的快慢。
chapters.captionEn: Equal recipe and optical path; compare how cloudiness develops.

chapters.title: 保留没有催化剂的空白
chapters.caption: 空白与两种催化条件比较；不据此排名催化效率。
chapters.captionEn: Compare each catalyst with the blank; this does not rank their efficiencies.

chapters.title: 把定性设计写成可重复的条件
chapters.caption: 记录原液、补水、加酸和观察标准。
chapters.captionEn: Record stock, added water, acid and the observation criterion.

chapters.title: 收集到同样的十毫升
chapters.caption: 相同锌量和酸体积，分别计时至 10 mL。
chapters.captionEn: Equal zinc and acid volume; time each run to 10 mL.

chapters.title: 斜率、终点和漏气
chapters.caption: 同一体积除以所用时间，得到平均收集速率。
chapters.captionEn: Divide the common volume by elapsed time for an average collection rate.

chapters.title: 相撞不一定反应
chapters.caption: 保持有利取向，比较能量不足与足够的碰撞。
chapters.captionEn: Keep a favorable orientation; compare insufficient and sufficient energy.

chapters.title: 能量足够，还要合适取向
chapters.titleEn: Enough energy also needs a suitable orientation
chapters.caption: 能量条件相同，只有有利取向进入所示反应路径。
chapters.captionEn: With equal energy, only the favorable orientation follows the shown pathway.

chapters.title: 降低能垒不改变反应热
chapters.titleEn: A lower barrier does not change reaction enthalpy
chapters.caption: 两条路径起终点相同，催化路径能垒较低。
chapters.captionEn: Both paths share endpoints; the catalytic pathway has a lower barrier.

chapters.title: 验证燃烧产物
chapters.caption: 乙醇燃烧后的水滴与石灰水浑浊，共同支持水和CO₂的生成。
chapters.captionEn: Water droplets and cloudy limewater support water and CO₂ formation after ethanol combustion.

chapters.title: 重访催化氧化
chapters.caption: 同一根铜丝在Cu与CuO之间循环，乙醇氧化为乙醛。
chapters.captionEn: One coil cycles between Cu and CuO as ethanol is oxidised to ethanal.

chapters.title: 设计酸性证据
chapters.caption: 石蕊变红与碳酸盐放出CO₂，提供乙酸酸性的不同证据。
chapters.captionEn: Red litmus and CO₂ release from carbonate provide different evidence of acidity.

chapters.title: 看清制备装置
chapters.caption: 酸与醇受热酯化，产物通过连续导管进入接收管。
chapters.captionEn: Heated acid and alcohol esterify; vapour travels through one connected delivery tube.

chapters.title: 跟随混合蒸气
chapters.caption: 蒸气包含酯，也可能携带乙醇、乙酸与水。
chapters.captionEn: The vapour contains ester and can carry ethanol, ethanoic acid and water.

chapters.title: 区分上下两层
chapters.caption: 碳酸盐中和酸，乙醇进入水层，酯较多的液层浮在上方。
chapters.captionEn: Carbonate neutralises acid, ethanol enters the water layer, and an ester-rich layer floats above.

chapters.title: 控制介质变量
chapters.caption: 相同酯量与水浴条件下，比较中性、酸性和碱性体系。
chapters.captionEn: Compare neutral, acid and base systems with equal ester amounts in one water bath.

chapters.title: 理解酸性水解
chapters.caption: 酸催化水解与酯化互为逆过程，催化剂本身不改变平衡常数。
chapters.captionEn: Acid hydrolysis reverses esterification; the catalyst itself does not change the equilibrium constant.

chapters.title: 追踪碱的消耗
chapters.caption: 碱性水解生成乙酸根；OH⁻是被消耗的反应物。
chapters.captionEn: Basic hydrolysis produces acetate; OH⁻ is a consumed reactant.

chapters.title: 单独比较温度
chapters.caption: 保持介质与用量相同，再比较温度；层消失不等于百分之百反应。
chapters.captionEn: Keep medium and amounts fixed when changing temperature; layer disappearance is not complete conversion.

chapters.title: 同样的连接，镜中的排列
chapters.caption: 四个不同基团的四面体排列，反射后保留组成与连接。
chapters.captionEn: Reflection preserves composition and connectivity in a tetrahedral four-group model.

chapters.title: 只转动，不改基团身份
chapters.caption: 对齐 A、B 后，另外两个不同基团仍互换位置。
chapters.captionEn: Aligning A and B leaves the other two distinct groups exchanged.

chapters.title: 两个基团相同时
chapters.caption: 把 D 换成与 C 相同的基团，这个单中心模型可与镜像重合。
chapters.captionEn: Replacing D with an identical C group makes this single-centre model superposable.

chapters.title: 巴斯德按晶面分开样品
chapters.caption: 放大晶面差别，再追踪每一颗晶体进入对应的一组。
chapters.captionEn: Inspect the facet differences, then follow each crystal into its corresponding group.

chapters.title: 晶体消失，溶液仍有差别
chapters.caption: 两组晶体分别溶解后，在同样条件下使偏振面向相反方向转动。
chapters.captionEn: Separately dissolved crystal groups rotate polarization in opposite directions under matching conditions.

chapters.title: 零旋光也有两种可能
chapters.titleEn: Zero rotation has more than one explanation
chapters.caption: 等量对映体的旋光抵消，不表示两种物质消失。
chapters.captionEn: Equal enantiomer rotations cancel without removing either component.

chapters.title: 选择性利用改变剩余比例
chapters.caption: 若其中一种被优先利用，等量关系被打破，剩余溶液可以旋光。
chapters.captionEn: Preferential consumption breaks the equal mixture, allowing the remaining solution to rotate light.

chapters.title: 由反应物走近平衡
chapters.caption: 浓度趋于稳定时，正逆反应仍都存在。
chapters.captionEn: Concentrations settle while both reaction directions continue.

chapters.title: 也可以从生成物一侧接近
chapters.titleEn: Approach from the product side too
chapters.caption: 原子总量相同，从氨开始也接近同一平衡。
chapters.captionEn: With the same atom totals, ammonia approaches the same equilibrium.

chapters.title: 拉出活塞：先稀释
chapters.titleEn: Pull out the piston: dilution comes first
chapters.caption: 体积先增大、颜色变浅，随后颜色部分加深。
chapters.captionEn: Expansion first lightens the gas; chemical relaxation then partly darkens it.

chapters.title: 推入活塞：先浓缩
chapters.titleEn: Push in the piston: concentration comes first
chapters.caption: 压缩先加深颜色，随后部分变浅。
chapters.captionEn: Compression first darkens the gas; subsequent reaction partly lightens it.

chapters.title: 封闭后放入不同水浴
chapters.caption: 同样的初始气体，热浴较深、冰浴较浅。
chapters.captionEn: The same initial gas darkens in the hot bath and lightens in ice water.

chapters.title: 较快与较多是两个目标
chapters.titleEn: Faster and more are different goals
chapters.caption: 高温示意曲线更快，教材平衡含氨量更低。
chapters.captionEn: The hotter illustrative curve rises faster toward a lower textbook equilibrium fraction.

chapters.title: 提高压强还有实际代价
chapters.caption: 相同温度下，教材平衡含氨量随压强提高。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed temperature, the textbook equilibrium ammonia fraction rises with pressure.

chapters.title: 分离氨，再循环原料
chapters.caption: 分离液氨，未反应的氮氢继续循环。
chapters.captionEn: Separate liquid ammonia and recycle the remaining nitrogen and hydrogen.

chapters.title: 增加一种反应物，保留对照
chapters.titleEn: Add one reactant and retain a reference
chapters.caption: 铁盐或硫氰酸盐滴入后，与未加料试管比较。
chapters.captionEn: Compare each addition with the unchanged reference tube.

chapters.title: 铁粉消耗铁离子
chapters.caption: 铁粉进入溶液后，红色物种减少。
chapters.captionEn: After iron enters the solution, the red-species amount falls.

chapters.title: 先加碱再加酸
chapters.caption: 同一份铬溶液从橙向黄，再向橙变化。
chapters.captionEn: The same chromium sample shifts from orange toward yellow and back toward orange.

chapters.title: 铜盐的颜色来自混合物
chapters.titleEn: Copper color belongs to a mixture
chapters.caption: 加热与冷却可逆改变混合颜色，并与室温对照比较。
chapters.captionEn: Heating and cooling change the mixture color relative to a room-temperature reference.

chapters.title: 跟着瓶号交换水浴
chapters.titleEn: Follow flask identities through the exchange
chapters.caption: 两瓶保持封闭，交换水浴后颜色逐渐反转。
chapters.captionEn: Both flasks stay sealed; swapping baths gradually reverses their colors.

chapters.title: 先观察溶解状态
chapters.caption: 葡萄糖和蔗糖溶于水；淀粉冷水中分散，加热后形成糊状体系。
chapters.captionEn: Glucose and sucrose dissolve; starch disperses in cool water and forms a paste on warming.

chapters.title: 观察银镜
chapters.caption: 葡萄糖在碱性银氨体系中使银离子还原为金属银。
chapters.captionEn: Glucose reduces silver ions to metallic silver in an alkaline ammoniacal test.

chapters.title: 观察砖红色沉淀
chapters.caption: 新制铜试剂在碱性、加热条件下形成砖红色Cu₂O。
chapters.captionEn: Fresh copper reagent gives brick-red Cu₂O under alkaline, warmed conditions.

chapters.title: 检验食物中的淀粉
chapters.caption: 碘与淀粉体系显蓝色；这项检验不等同于还原糖检验。
chapters.captionEn: Iodine gives a blue starch response; this differs from a reducing-sugar test.

chapters.title: 先水解，再调节环境
chapters.caption: 淀粉酸水解后，冷却并使溶液呈碱性，再进行铜试剂检验。
chapters.captionEn: After acid hydrolysis, cool and make the sample alkaline before the copper test.

chapters.title: 比较水解前后
chapters.caption: 普通定性条件下，水解前不显明显阳性；水解后可检出还原性产物。
chapters.captionEn: The ordinary qualitative test is weak before hydrolysis and detects reducing products afterwards.

chapters.title: 保留未水解对照
chapters.caption: 未水解蔗糖在相同条件下不给出明显Cu₂O阳性证据。
chapters.captionEn: Unhydrolysed sucrose gives no clear Cu₂O-positive result under the same conditions.

chapters.title: 检验蔗糖水解产物
chapters.caption: 蔗糖水解产生葡萄糖和果糖，调至碱性后可显示还原性。
chapters.captionEn: Sucrose hydrolysis yields glucose and fructose, which give reducing evidence after alkalinisation.

chapters.title: 比较蔗糖与麦芽糖
chapters.caption: 同样的检验条件下，麦芽糖可呈阳性，蔗糖原样不呈明显阳性。
chapters.captionEn: Under matched conditions, maltose can test positive while untreated sucrose does not.

chapters.title: 解释连接部位
chapters.caption: 蔗糖连接了两个异头碳；麦芽糖保留一个可开环的半缩醛端。
chapters.captionEn: Sucrose links both anomeric carbons; maltose retains a hemiacetal end that can open.

chapters.title: 观察纤维素处理
chapters.caption: 脱脂棉中的纤维素经过教材的酸处理后，可以生成可检验的糖。
chapters.captionEn: Textbook acid treatment of cotton cellulose can produce sugars for testing.

chapters.title: 完成纤维素产物检验
chapters.caption: 处理液先呈碱性，再加入铜盐并加热，观察还原性证据。
chapters.captionEn: Establish alkaline conditions, then add copper reagent and warm to observe reducing evidence.

chapters.title: 熔化，却还没有澄清
chapters.caption: 历史样品在 T₁ 之后成为浑浊流体，不能只按固体与普通液体二分。
chapters.captionEn: Above T₁ the historical sample becomes a cloudy fluid, challenging a simple solid–liquid split.

chapters.title: 继续加热，还有第二次变化
chapters.caption: 到 T₂ 澄清点，浑浊流体转为透明清亮态。
chapters.captionEn: At the clearing point T₂, the cloudy fluid becomes transparent.

chapters.title: 位置改变，方向仍有秩序
chapters.caption: 向列相示意中，单元能够移动，而长轴仍倾向同一方向。
chapters.captionEn: In the nematic teaching model, units move while their long axes retain a preferred direction.

chapters.title: 再失去取向序
chapters.caption: 位置仍可移动，长轴的共同方向也逐渐消失。
chapters.captionEn: Positions remain mobile while the common long-axis direction disappears.

chapters.title: 电场改变取向，也改变透光
chapters.caption: 两侧仍受边界固定，内部取向随电场变化，透光率由同一分布计算。
chapters.captionEn: Boundary directions stay anchored while the interior responds to the field and determines transmission.

chapters.title: 观察盐析
chapters.caption: 较高硫酸铵浓度降低这组蛋白质的溶解度，使其析出。
chapters.captionEn: High ammonium-sulfate concentration lowers solubility and precipitates this protein population.

chapters.title: 加水检验可逆性
chapters.caption: 加水降低盐浓度，盐析出的蛋白质可以重新溶解。
chapters.captionEn: Adding water lowers salt concentration and can redissolve the salted-out protein.

chapters.title: 观察加热变性
chapters.caption: 加热改变蛋白质的空间状态，并可产生凝聚物。
chapters.captionEn: Heating changes protein conformation and can produce aggregates.

chapters.title: 比较两种化学处理
chapters.caption: 硝酸银与乙醇分别处理样品，也能产生变性和凝聚现象。
chapters.captionEn: Separate silver-nitrate and ethanol treatments can also denature and aggregate protein.

chapters.title: 再加水作对照
chapters.caption: 这三组教材处理后的凝聚物，加水后不能简单恢复原状。
chapters.captionEn: The aggregates from these textbook treatments do not simply return to the original state on adding water.

chapters.title: 保留铅盐实验位置
chapters.caption: 必修实验用醋酸铅处理鸡蛋清，观察蛋白质凝聚。
chapters.captionEn: The required-book experiment uses lead acetate with egg white to observe aggregation.

chapters.title: 区分析出与显色
chapters.caption: 浓硝酸先使样品出现白色沉淀，加热后可变黄。
chapters.captionEn: Concentrated nitric acid first precipitates the sample; warming can produce yellow colour.

chapters.title: 区分灼烧与变性
chapters.caption: 头发与蚕丝灼烧发生热分解；教材记录了特殊气味。
chapters.captionEn: Hair and silk undergo thermal decomposition on burning; the textbook records a characteristic odour.

chapters.title: 相同浓度，先测 pH
chapters.caption: 探头入液后，比较两种 0.1 M 酸。
chapters.captionEn: Immerse the probes and compare two 0.1 M acids.

chapters.title: 保持相同电极条件
chapters.caption: 相同交流电压与电极几何，电流响应不同。
chapters.captionEn: Equal AC voltage and electrode geometry give different current responses.

chapters.title: 等量镁的产气快慢
chapters.caption: 同量镁在两种酸中有不同的产气过程。
chapters.captionEn: Equal magnesium samples show different gas-production histories.

chapters.title: 电离比例与离子浓度
chapters.caption: 稀释醋酸时，电离比例上升而氢离子浓度下降。
chapters.captionEn: Diluting acetic acid raises its ionized fraction while lowering hydrogen-ion concentration.

chapters.title: 碳酸钠逐滴进入醋酸
chapters.caption: 碳酸钠进入足量醋酸后，产生二氧化碳。
chapters.captionEn: Carbonate entering excess acetic acid releases carbon dioxide.

chapters.title: 先看加液与测量路径
chapters.caption: 两瓶各含 0.05 g 镁，分别注入 2 mL 2 M 酸。
chapters.captionEn: Each flask contains 0.05 g Mg and receives 2 mL of 2 M acid.

chapters.title: 重建教材的压强趋势
chapters.caption: 盐酸先快后慢，醋酸先加速再减速。
chapters.captionEn: Hydrochloric acid slows from a fast start; acetic acid initially accelerates.

chapters.title: 用总量判断共同终点
chapters.titleEn: Use total amounts to explain the common endpoint
chapters.caption: 两组最多生成 2 mmol 氢气，并剩余约 1.39 mg 镁。
chapters.captionEn: Both can produce 2 mmol hydrogen, leaving about 1.39 mg magnesium.

chapters.title: 从同一份熔体长出来
chapters.caption: 硫先熔融，撤去热源后冷却结晶。
chapters.captionEn: Sulfur first melts, then crystallizes after heating stops.

chapters.title: 冷面接住蒸气
chapters.caption: 碘蒸气在冷的表面皿下方凝华，原料与产物位置不同。
chapters.captionEn: Iodine vapor deposits beneath the cold watch glass, away from the source.

chapters.title: 溶液中也能析出晶体
chapters.caption: 饱和氯化钠溶液加入浓盐酸，出现白色晶粒。
chapters.captionEn: Concentrated hydrochloric acid produces white crystals in saturated sodium chloride solution.

chapters.title: 用复溶检查解释
chapters.caption: 加入水后，原来的晶粒可以重新溶解。
chapters.captionEn: Adding water can redissolve the original crystals.

chapters.title: 先得到小晶种
chapters.caption: 温热饱和明矾溶液冷却静置，先得到小晶体。
chapters.captionEn: Cooling and standing a warm saturated alum solution first produces small crystals.

chapters.title: 选择并悬挂同一颗晶种
chapters.caption: 选形状完整的晶种，用细线悬在溶液中央。
chapters.captionEn: Choose a well-formed seed and suspend it centrally on a thread.

chapters.title: 增大的物质来自溶液
chapters.titleEn: The added material comes from solution
chapters.caption: 晶体增加，溶液中的相应物质量减少。
chapters.captionEn: As the crystal gains material, the corresponding dissolved amount decreases.

chapters.title: 留下透明、紫色、透明的层次
chapters.titleEn: Retain clear, purple and clear layers
chapters.caption: 换到不同生长液，原核外依次增加新的晶层。
chapters.captionEn: Changing growth solutions adds new layers around the retained core.

chapters.title: 沿着序列走
chapters.caption: 一级结构记录残基的种类与排列顺序。
chapters.captionEn: Primary structure records residue identities and their order.

chapters.title: 放大局部螺旋
chapters.caption: 局部螺旋由同一条链形成；虚线连接实际氧、氮坐标。
chapters.captionEn: A local helix belongs to one chain; dashed contacts use actual oxygen and nitrogen coordinates.

chapters.title: 对照反平行折叠
chapters.caption: 同一条链的两段靠近，也能形成反平行 β 折叠。
chapters.captionEn: Two segments of the same chain approach to form an antiparallel beta sheet.

chapters.title: 回到整条链
chapters.caption: 三级结构描述整条链的空间构象；局部结构仍嵌在其中。
chapters.captionEn: Tertiary structure describes the complete chain conformation, including its local structures.

chapters.title: 换到四链血红蛋白
chapters.caption: 血红蛋白由两条 α 链和两条 β 链组成；这属于四级结构。
chapters.captionEn: Hemoglobin contains two alpha and two beta chains: quaternary structure.

chapters.title: 泡豆吸水
chapters.caption: 泡豆使水进入豆粒，体积逐渐增大。
chapters.captionEn: Soaking lets water enter the beans and increases their volume.

chapters.title: 磨豆释放分散物
chapters.caption: 磨碎豆粒，使蛋白质等成分进入水中的分散体系。
chapters.captionEn: Grinding releases protein and other components into a water-based dispersion.

chapters.title: 滤去豆渣
chapters.caption: 粗大的豆渣被截留，豆浆及其中分散的蛋白质通过。
chapters.captionEn: Coarse okara is retained while soymilk and its dispersed protein pass through.

chapters.title: 煮浆改变结构
chapters.caption: 热处理改变蛋白质构象，为后续聚集提供条件。
chapters.captionEn: Thermal treatment changes protein conformations and prepares them for aggregation.

chapters.title: 点卤形成网络
chapters.caption: 钙、镁盐可促进蛋白质聚集，形成含水的凝胶网络。
chapters.captionEn: Calcium or magnesium salts can promote protein association into a hydrated gel network.

chapters.title: 压制排出液体
chapters.caption: 压制排出部分液体，使凝胶更加紧实。
chapters.captionEn: Pressing releases some liquid and compacts the gel.

chapters.title: 揭开成品内部
chapters.caption: 成形豆腐仍是含水网络，并非干燥的纯蛋白质。
chapters.captionEn: Finished tofu remains a hydrated network, not dry pure protein.

chapters.title: 先看碱滴入酸的曲线
chapters.titleEn: Start with base added to acid
chapters.caption: 加入体积改变剩余酸碱量，也改变总体积。
chapters.captionEn: Added volume changes both excess acid or base and total solution volume.

chapters.title: 放大当量点附近
chapters.caption: 同样的微小体积，在当量点附近引起更大的 pH 变化。
chapters.captionEn: The same tiny volume causes a larger pH change near equivalence.

chapters.title: 变色范围不等于一个点
chapters.titleEn: A transition range is not a single point
chapters.caption: 指示剂在范围内变色，终点不严格等于当量点。
chapters.captionEn: Indicators change across ranges; endpoint is not exactly equivalence.

chapters.title: 检漏后，用将盛装的液体润洗
chapters.titleEn: Check leaks and condition with the intended solution
chapters.caption: 润洗内壁后，从下口弃去润洗液。
chapters.captionEn: Wet the inner walls, then discard the rinse through the tip.

chapters.title: 排除气泡，再记初读数
chapters.titleEn: Clear bubbles before the starting reading
chapters.caption: 尖嘴充满液体后，调节并记录初读数。
chapters.captionEn: Fill the tip with liquid, then adjust and record the starting level.

chapters.title: 用碱式管量取待测液
chapters.titleEn: Measure the analyte with the base burette
chapters.caption: 量出 20.00 mL 待测碱，再加入两滴酚酞。
chapters.captionEn: Deliver 20.00 mL unknown base, then add two drops of phenolphthalein.

chapters.title: 酸滴入碱，逐步接近终点
chapters.titleEn: Add acid to base and approach the endpoint
chapters.caption: 盐酸从尖嘴进入锥形瓶，与待测碱混合。
chapters.captionEn: Hydrochloric acid enters the flask and mixes with the unknown base.

chapters.title: 让半滴真正进入溶液
chapters.titleEn: Deliver the partial drop into the solution
chapters.caption: 悬滴接触内壁并被冲下后，才计入主体中和。
chapters.captionEn: The partial drop affects bulk neutralization only after wall contact and rinsing.

chapters.title: 读弯月面，再取差值
chapters.titleEn: Read the meniscus and take the difference
chapters.caption: 体积等于终读数减初读数。
chapters.captionEn: Delivered volume equals final minus initial reading.

chapters.title: 重复实验与原始记录
chapters.caption: 教材例题的数据用来示范计算；自己的三次记录保持空白。
chapters.captionEn: Textbook example data illustrate calculation; your three-run record starts blank.

chapters.title: 水的位置决定误差方向
chapters.caption: 滴定管残水、锥形瓶残水和多余待测液有不同后果。
chapters.captionEn: Burette water, flask water and extra analyte have different consequences.

chapters.title: 按讨论题绘制反向曲线
chapters.titleEn: Plot the direction requested in the discussion
chapters.caption: 活动用酸滴定碱，讨论题再画碱滴定酸的曲线。
chapters.captionEn: The practical adds acid to base; the discussion requests base added to acid.

chapters.title: 先追踪已有分子
chapters.caption: 原油是混合物；加热后，蒸气与液体经管道进入分馏塔。
chapters.captionEn: Crude oil is a mixture; heated vapour and liquid enter the column.

chapters.title: 上冷下热，分路离开
chapters.caption: 较易挥发的组分能升得更高，较难挥发的组分较早凝结或留在底部。
chapters.captionEn: More volatile components rise farther; others condense lower down or remain at the bottom.

chapters.title: 放大同一条碳链
chapters.caption: 分馏前后，十六烷的碳原子数、氢原子数和连接方式没有变化。
chapters.captionEn: Hexadecane keeps the same atom counts and connections through fractionation.

chapters.title: 连接关系真正改变
chapters.caption: 一个十六烷可按教材净反应转化为一个辛烷和一个辛烯。
chapters.captionEn: The textbook net reaction converts hexadecane into octane and octene.

chapters.title: 较短的烃还能再变化
chapters.caption: 辛烷可继续转化为丁烷和丁烯；总计仍为八个碳、十八个氢。
chapters.captionEn: Octane can give butane and butene, conserving eight carbons and eighteen hydrogens.

chapters.title: 同一原料，选择一种产物组合
chapters.caption: 丁烷可生成甲烷和丙烯，这是一种可能的净反应。
chapters.captionEn: Butane can give methane and propene in one possible net reaction.

chapters.title: 换一条途径，再核对守恒
chapters.caption: 另一种丁烷净反应生成乙烷与乙烯；裂解产物并不唯一。
chapters.captionEn: An alternative butane net reaction gives ethane and ethene; products are not unique.

chapters.title: 把金属还原为单质
chapters.titleEn: Reduce the metal to its element
chapters.caption: 冶炼的共同目标，是把化合物中的金属还原为单质。
chapters.captionEn: The common goal is to reduce a metal in a compound to its elemental state.

chapters.title: 热分解氧化汞
chapters.caption: 氧化汞分解时，汞被还原，氧元素被氧化。
chapters.captionEn: When mercury oxide decomposes, mercury is reduced and oxygen is oxidized.

chapters.title: 一氧化碳夺取氧
chapters.caption: CO 转变为 CO₂，氧化铁中的铁得到电子。
chapters.captionEn: Carbon monoxide becomes carbon dioxide while iron in the oxide gains electrons.

chapters.title: 金属也能作还原剂
chapters.titleEn: A metal can be a reducing agent
chapters.caption: 铝被氧化为氧化铝，氧化铁被还原为铁。
chapters.captionEn: Aluminium is oxidized to aluminium oxide as iron oxide is reduced.

chapters.title: 熔盐中的电解路线
chapters.caption: 外电源驱动阴极还原与阳极氧化；两种产物分别收集。
chapters.captionEn: External power drives cathodic reduction and anodic oxidation, with products separated.

chapters.title: 镁需要两个电子
chapters.caption: 一个 Mg²⁺ 接受两个电子，与两个 Cl⁻ 的氧化配对。
chapters.captionEn: One magnesium ion accepts two electrons, paired with oxidation of two chloride ions.

chapters.title: 把碳阳极计入反应
chapters.caption: 工业铝电解使用碳阳极；碳消耗并形成含碳气体。
chapters.captionEn: Industrial aluminium electrolysis consumes carbon anodes and produces carbon-containing gases.

chapters.title: 一个原子被几个晶胞共享
chapters.titleEn: How many cells share one atom?
chapters.caption: 分数来自相邻晶胞共享，不是把原子切碎。
chapters.captionEn: Fractions count shared spatial ownership; atoms are not cut apart.

chapters.title: 十四个位置，四个原子的计数
chapters.titleEn: Fourteen drawn sites count as four atoms
chapters.caption: 铜的常规面心立方晶胞：8 × ⅛ + 6 × ½ = 4。
chapters.captionEn: Copper’s conventional face-centred cubic cell counts 8 × ⅛ + 6 × ½ = 4.

chapters.title: 有序不必等于周期重复
chapters.titleEn: Order need not mean periodic repetition
chapters.caption: 准周期构造有确定规则，却没有普通晶格的平移重复。
chapters.captionEn: A quasiperiodic construction follows rules without ordinary lattice translation repetition.

chapters.title: 非周期也可以产生尖锐亮斑
chapters.titleEn: Aperiodic order can produce sharp peaks
chapters.caption: 同一组有序坐标经相位叠加，得到有对称性的衍射亮斑。
chapters.captionEn: Phase summation from the same ordered coordinates produces symmetric diffraction peaks.

chapters.title: 同样的点数，不同的排列
chapters.caption: 周期排列集中形成亮斑，无序对照的强度更分散。
chapters.captionEn: Periodic positions concentrate intensity into peaks; the disordered comparison spreads it out.

chapters.title: 不同取向平均成环与峰
chapters.titleEn: Orientation averaging produces rings and peaks
chapters.caption: 粉末取向平均的强度由同一批三维点之间的距离计算。
chapters.captionEn: Powder-averaged intensity is calculated from pair distances in the same three-dimensional cluster.

chapters.title: 候选坐标必须解释强度
chapters.caption: 移动一个候选氧原子，重新计算衍射强度，误差下降。
chapters.captionEn: Moving one candidate oxygen recomputes the diffraction intensities and reduces the mismatch.

chapters.title: 从精修坐标量出键长与键角
chapters.titleEn: Measure bonds and angles from refined coordinates
chapters.caption: 青蒿素示例的键长、键角由公开精修坐标计算。
chapters.captionEn: Published refined coordinates determine the artemisinin example’s bond lengths and angles.

chapters.title: 水先蒸发，再冷凝
chapters.caption: 非挥发性盐留在原液，水蒸气冷凝后收集。
chapters.captionEn: Nonvolatile salts stay behind while water vapour is condensed and collected.

chapters.title: 水的自然渗透
chapters.caption: 在没有外加压力差时，水净流向较浓的盐水一侧。
chapters.captionEn: Without an imposed pressure difference, water flows toward the more concentrated saline side.

chapters.title: 用压力改变净方向
chapters.caption: 盐水侧的压力差超过渗透压差，净产水方向反转。
chapters.captionEn: When pressure on the saline side exceeds the osmotic difference, the net water flow reverses.

chapters.title: 两股物流都要保留
chapters.caption: 产水增加，原液变浓；压力不变时，产水驱动力逐渐减小。
chapters.captionEn: As permeate is removed, the feed concentrates and the driving force decreases at fixed pressure.

chapters.title: 剩下的盐还有去向
chapters.caption: 海水利用还包括制盐及镁、溴等资源的开发。
chapters.captionEn: Seawater use also includes salt production and recovery of resources such as magnesium and bromine.

chapters.title: 比较四类膜
chapters.caption: 微滤、超滤、纳滤和反渗透的选择性不同。
chapters.captionEn: Microfiltration, ultrafiltration, nanofiltration and reverse osmosis differ in selectivity.

chapters.title: 看一层致密选择层
chapters.caption: 反渗透膜的选择性不能仅用刚性筛孔解释。
chapters.captionEn: A reverse-osmosis selective layer is not adequately explained as a rigid sieve.

chapters.title: 浓缩液也可以是产品
chapters.titleEn: The retained stream can be the product
chapters.caption: 选择性移走水，可以在保留溶质的同时浓缩原液。
chapters.captionEn: Selective water removal can concentrate retained solutes.

chapters.title: 完整分子离开
chapters.caption: 碘分子之间分开，I—I 连接保留。
chapters.captionEn: Iodine molecules separate while their I—I bonds remain.

chapters.title: 冰中也保留水分子
chapters.caption: 实线连接一个水分子；虚线连接不同水分子。
chapters.captionEn: Solid bonds define each water molecule; dashed bonds connect different molecules.

chapters.title: 共价连接延伸出去
chapters.titleEn: Covalent bonds extend through the solid
chapters.caption: 每个内部碳原子连接四个近邻，网络向视野外延续。
chapters.captionEn: Each interior carbon has four neighbors, and covalent connectivity extends beyond the view.

chapters.title: 比例不等于分子
chapters.titleEn: A ratio is not a molecule
chapters.caption: 硅连四个氧，桥氧连两个硅：Si∶O = 1∶2。
chapters.captionEn: Silicon bonds to four oxygens; each bridging oxygen links two silicons.

chapters.title: 高硬度仍可断裂
chapters.caption: 共价网络分成两部分，跨越分离面的键必须断开。
chapters.captionEn: Separating the covalent network requires breaking bonds across the cut.

chapters.title: 先检验两种近中性的盐
chapters.caption: 玻璃棒点到干燥试纸后才出现酸碱性读数。
chapters.captionEn: A reading appears after a rod sample touches dry paper.

chapters.title: 弱酸的盐可以呈碱性
chapters.titleEn: Salts of weak acids can be basic
chapters.caption: 碳酸根、醋酸根参与酸碱平衡，溶液呈碱性。
chapters.captionEn: Carbonate and acetate participate in equilibria that make the solutions basic.

chapters.title: 铵盐给出相反的方向
chapters.titleEn: Ammonium salts give the opposite direction
chapters.caption: 两种铵盐呈酸性，但溶液整体仍电中性。
chapters.captionEn: Both ammonium salts are acidic while remaining electrically neutral overall.

chapters.title: 保留参照，只改变温度
chapters.titleEn: Retain a reference and change temperature
chapters.caption: 升温的方向用受限的一阶水解模型说明。
chapters.captionEn: A restricted first-step model illustrates the temperature direction.

chapters.title: 稀释增加比例，却降低浓度
chapters.titleEn: Dilution raises fraction but lowers concentration
chapters.caption: 总铁量不变，加水后的比例与浓度有不同变化。
chapters.captionEn: With total iron fixed, dilution changes fraction and concentration differently.

chapters.title: 晶体改变总铁量
chapters.caption: 晶体进入液体后，浓度与水解比例一起重算。
chapters.captionEn: After crystals enter, concentration and hydrolyzed fraction are recalculated.

chapters.title: 加酸改变平衡条件
chapters.caption: 右管加酸，一阶水解模型中的比例降低。
chapters.captionEn: Adding acid lowers the first-step hydrolyzed fraction.

chapters.title: 按活动用量观察酸化
chapters.titleEn: Observe acidification at the activity quantities
chapters.caption: 5 mL 水溶解晶体，再加入 2 mL 浓硫酸。
chapters.captionEn: Dissolve crystals in 5 mL water, then add 2 mL concentrated sulfuric acid.

chapters.title: 三份泥水，保留原空白
chapters.caption: 铁盐和铝盐组加料，空白保持原来的 5 mL。
chapters.captionEn: Iron and aluminum samples receive reagent; the blank stays at 5 mL.

chapters.title: 跟踪同一批颗粒沉降
chapters.titleEn: Follow the same particles through settling
chapters.caption: 在明确假设的加料后 pH 下，凝聚使沉降加快。
chapters.captionEn: Under an explicit post-dose pH assumption, aggregation accelerates settling.

chapters.title: 沸水中逐滴制备胶体
chapters.titleEn: Prepare colloid dropwise in boiling water
chapters.caption: 铁盐滴入沸水，形成细小分散相后停止加热。
chapters.captionEn: Iron salt enters boiling water; stop heating after the dispersed phase forms.

chapters.title: 只加热其中一管
chapters.caption: 同样纯碱与油量，比较冷热处理。
chapters.captionEn: Compare cold and heated treatments with equal carbonate and oil quantities.

chapters.title: 冲洗之后再比较内壁
chapters.caption: 液体沿管口流出，冲洗后保留可比较的油膜。
chapters.captionEn: Liquid exits through the mouth, leaving comparable wall films after rinsing.

chapters.title: 同为液体，挥发性不同
chapters.caption: 教材的三种氯代甲烷具有不同的常压沸点。
chapters.captionEn: The three chloromethanes have different normal boiling points.

chapters.title: 蒸气与液体组成不同
chapters.caption: 易挥发组分在蒸气中富集，其他组分仍可同时存在。
chapters.captionEn: The more volatile component is enriched in the vapour, while others are also present.

chapters.title: 沿连续通路冷凝
chapters.caption: 蒸气经蒸馏头进入冷凝管，再成为接收器中的液体。
chapters.captionEn: Vapour passes through the head and condenser before entering the receiver as liquid.

chapters.title: 温度计观察哪里
chapters.caption: 感温部位在蒸气出口附近，读数对应经过的蒸气。
chapters.captionEn: The sensing region is near the vapour outlet and reads the passing vapour.

chapters.title: 把不同时间段分开
chapters.caption: 分段收集得到不同组成的馏分；每份仍可能是混合物。
chapters.captionEn: Separate collection intervals give different compositions, each still potentially a mixture.

chapters.title: 瓶内剩余液体改变
chapters.caption: 易挥发组分不断移走，瓶内组成与后续蒸气随之改变。
chapters.captionEn: Removing the volatile component changes both the residue and subsequent vapour.

chapters.title: 没有冷凝的独立对照
chapters.caption: 在无冷凝的模型对照中，汽化量不算作已收集液体。
chapters.captionEn: In the no-condensation model, evaporated material is not counted as collected liquid.

chapters.title: 共有的价电子
chapters.caption: 离域价电子属于整块金属，正离子实保持有序排列。
chapters.captionEn: Delocalized valence electrons are shared across the ordered metal lattice.

chapters.title: 滑移时仍然结合
chapters.caption: 同一排原子连续越过相邻排，模型不让硬球互相穿透。
chapters.captionEn: A row slides past its neighbor without hard-sphere interpenetration.

chapters.title: 无规则运动叠加漂移
chapters.caption: 电子平均速度与电场相反，常规电流与电场同向。
chapters.captionEn: Mean electron drift opposes the field; conventional current follows it.

chapters.title: 更短的弛豫时间
chapters.caption: 电场相同，散射模型中的弛豫时间缩短，电流减小。
chapters.captionEn: At the same field, a shorter relaxation time reduces the current.

chapters.title: 同一层保留共价连接
chapters.titleEn: A sheet keeps its covalent bonds
chapters.caption: 石墨层内 C—C 为 142 pm，层间距离约 335 pm。
chapters.captionEn: Graphite has 142 pm in-plane C—C bonds and about 335 pm between layers.

chapters.title: 平行轨道侧向重叠
chapters.caption: p 轨道垂直于碳平面；两色表示相位，不是电荷。
chapters.captionEn: p orbitals stand normal to the carbon plane; colors denote phase, not charge.

chapters.title: 跨层较弱，仍然非零
chapters.caption: 转动电场，电导明显改变；跨层电导不等于零。
chapters.captionEn: Rotating the field changes conductivity; cross-plane conductivity remains nonzero.

chapters.title: 先有两个液相
chapters.caption: 液液萃取需要能分开的两个液相。
chapters.captionEn: Liquid–liquid extraction needs two separable liquid phases.

chapters.title: 比较两相浓度
chapters.caption: 达到分配平衡时，溶质通常仍同时存在于两相中。
chapters.captionEn: At distribution equilibrium, solute usually remains in both phases.

chapters.title: 密度决定上下位置
chapters.caption: 分配关系与上下层身份是两个不同的问题。
chapters.captionEn: Distribution and upper-versus-lower layer identity are different questions.

chapters.title: 把下层单独收集
chapters.caption: 分液改变两相的位置，不会把溶质全部变到某一侧。
chapters.captionEn: Separating layers relocates them without forcing all solute into one phase.

chapters.title: 空气也需要进入
chapters.caption: 上口封闭时，顶空气压下降，液体难以持续流出。
chapters.captionEn: With the upper opening sealed, falling headspace pressure restricts sustained outflow.

chapters.title: 分次用新鲜溶剂
chapters.caption: 相同总溶剂量分成多份，常可提高累计萃取份额。
chapters.captionEn: Dividing the same solvent total into fresh portions can improve cumulative extraction.

chapters.title: 从固体中溶出
chapters.titleEn: Extract a component from a solid
chapters.caption: 固液萃取让可溶组分进入溶剂，固体基质仍可留下。
chapters.captionEn: Solid–liquid extraction transfers soluble material into solvent while the matrix can remain.

chapters.title: 接通石墨电极
chapters.caption: 负极析铜，正极产生气体。
chapters.captionEn: Copper deposits at the negative electrode; gas forms at the positive one.

chapters.title: 区分两段载流路径
chapters.caption: 导线中的电子流与溶液中的离子迁移相接。
chapters.captionEn: Electron flow in conductors connects to ionic migration in solution.

chapters.title: 气体真正到达试纸
chapters.caption: 阳极气体上升并接触湿润的 KI–淀粉试纸。
chapters.captionEn: Anode gas rises and reaches moist KI–starch paper.

chapters.title: 用电量核对产物
chapters.caption: 理想情况下，每 2 mol 电子对应 1 mol 铜和 1 mol 氯气。
chapters.captionEn: Ideally, two moles of electrons correspond to one mole each of copper and chlorine.

chapters.title: 先准备铁件表面
chapters.caption: 打磨后除油，取出并用蒸馏水冲洗。
chapters.captionEn: Abrade, degrease, lift out and rinse with distilled water.

chapters.title: 除锈与第二次冲洗
chapters.caption: 20% 盐酸除锈之后，铁件再次水洗。
chapters.captionEn: After rust removal in 20% hydrochloric acid, rinse the iron again.

chapters.title: 正确连接两块电极
chapters.caption: 铁接负极、铜接正极，两极相距约 5 cm。
chapters.captionEn: Iron is negative, copper positive, with about 5 cm separation.

chapters.title: 铜从阳极补进溶液
chapters.titleEn: Copper replenishes the bath from the anode
chapters.caption: 铜阳极损失与阴极获得相等，浴液总铜保持不变。
chapters.captionEn: Anode loss equals cathode gain, preserving total bath copper.

chapters.title: 把接线反过来
chapters.caption: 铁成为阳极而溶解，铜在铜电极上析出。
chapters.captionEn: Iron dissolves as the anode while copper deposits on the copper electrode.

chapters.title: 断路不是所有反应停止
chapters.titleEn: An open circuit does not stop every reaction
chapters.caption: 外部电量为零，铁仍可局部置换铜离子。
chapters.captionEn: External charge is zero, yet iron can locally displace copper ions.

chapters.title: 相同电量，不同表面
chapters.caption: 被遮挡区域不沉积，理想铜量集中到有效面积。
chapters.captionEn: Masked regions do not deposit; ideal copper is concentrated on active area.

chapters.title: 共同的蓝色来自哪里
chapters.titleEn: What gives the shared blue color?
chapters.caption: 三种铜盐溶于足量水后呈蓝色，另三种盐作对照。
chapters.captionEn: Three copper salts become blue in ample water; three other salts serve as controls.

chapters.title: 少量氨水先沉淀
chapters.titleEn: A little ammonia first precipitates copper
chapters.caption: 先出现浅蓝色 Cu(OH)₂ 沉淀。
chapters.captionEn: A pale-blue Cu(OH)₂ precipitate appears first.

chapters.title: 再加氨水，沉淀溶解
chapters.caption: 继续加氨水并混匀，得到深蓝色澄清溶液。
chapters.captionEn: Further ammonia and mixing produce a deep-blue clear solution.

chapters.title: 回看配体替换
chapters.caption: 铜中心保持，水与氨的配位原子发生替换。
chapters.captionEn: The copper center remains while water donors are replaced by ammonia donors.

chapters.title: 深蓝晶体再出现
chapters.caption: 加入乙醇并摩擦管壁，析出配合物晶体。
chapters.captionEn: Ethanol and scratching the tube wall promote complex crystallization.

chapters.title: 先得到白色银盐
chapters.titleEn: First form a white silver salt
chapters.caption: 氯化钠溶液与硝酸银形成 AgCl 白色沉淀。
chapters.captionEn: Sodium chloride and silver nitrate form white AgCl precipitate.

chapters.title: 配位推动溶解
chapters.caption: 形成 [Ag(NH₃)₂]⁺，降低游离 Ag⁺，推动 AgCl 溶解。
chapters.captionEn: Forming [Ag(NH₃)₂]⁺ lowers free Ag⁺ and promotes AgCl dissolution.

chapters.title: 同含铁，反应仍不同
chapters.titleEn: Iron in different environments reacts differently
chapters.caption: FeCl₃ 与铁氰化钾接受同样的 SCN⁻ 检验，结果不同。
chapters.captionEn: FeCl₃ and ferricyanide give different results under the same SCN⁻ test.

chapters.title: 把三种物质分开记账
chapters.caption: 粗苯甲酸中的泥沙、氯化钠和苯甲酸需要不同去向。
chapters.captionEn: Sand, sodium chloride and benzoic acid need different destinations.

chapters.title: 加热增加溶解量
chapters.caption: 升温时更多苯甲酸进入溶液，泥沙仍留下。
chapters.captionEn: Heating dissolves more benzoic acid while sand remains.

chapters.title: 热过滤保留泥沙
chapters.caption: 泥沙留在滤纸上，溶解的苯甲酸和盐进入滤液。
chapters.captionEn: Sand stays on the filter while dissolved acid and salt enter the filtrate.

chapters.title: 冷却后仍有溶解损失
chapters.caption: 冷却降低溶解容量，部分苯甲酸析晶，部分仍在母液。
chapters.captionEn: Cooling reduces solubility, forming crystals while some acid remains in the mother liquor.

chapters.title: 这次保留的是晶体
chapters.caption: 再次过滤时，晶体保留，母液携带盐和部分苯甲酸离开。
chapters.captionEn: The second filtration retains crystals while mother liquor carries salt and some acid away.

chapters.title: 洗涤存在取舍
chapters.caption: 少量冷水带走附着母液，但也会溶走部分苯甲酸。
chapters.captionEn: A small cold wash removes adhering liquor but also dissolves some benzoic acid.

chapters.title: 分清收率与纯度
chapters.caption: 干燥固体质量除以粗品质量是教材的收率，不等于纯度。
chapters.captionEn: The textbook recovery is dry solid divided by crude sample mass; it is not purity.

chapters.title: 用化学证据检查盐
chapters.caption: 氯离子可用氯化银反应检验；检测结果仍有灵敏度边界。
chapters.captionEn: Chloride can be tested through silver chloride formation, subject to detection limits.

chapters.title: 耗氧改变水柱
chapters.titleEn: Oxygen uptake changes the water column
chapters.caption: 密闭、恒温条件下，耗氧压降推动外部水上升。
chapters.captionEn: In a sealed isothermal setup, oxygen uptake lowers pressure and raises external water.

chapters.title: 先保留相同起点
chapters.caption: 相同锌粒、等体积等浓度稀盐酸，先观察基线。
chapters.captionEn: Equal zinc samples and equal dilute acid establish the baseline.

chapters.title: 铜析出之后才加速
chapters.caption: 一组滴入硫酸铜，铜接触锌后，析氢变快。
chapters.captionEn: Copper sulfate enters one sample; copper–zinc contact accelerates hydrogen release.

chapters.title: 让锌供电子
chapters.caption: 锌氧化，电子沿金属通路到达铁。
chapters.captionEn: Zinc oxidizes and supplies electrons to iron through the metallic path.

chapters.title: 取样之后再加检验剂
chapters.titleEn: Sample first, then add the test reagent
chapters.caption: 比较独立试验：Fe—Zn 与仅 Fe 的铁附近取样。
chapters.captionEn: Compare separate iron-region aliquots from Fe—Zn and iron-alone trials.

chapters.title: 先制备观察介质
chapters.caption: 琼脂在盐水与水的混合液中加热溶解，再稍冷。
chapters.captionEn: Dissolve agar by heating the salt–water mixture, then cool slightly.

chapters.title: 观察裹锌的铁钉
chapters.caption: 铁附近的阴极反应产生局部碱性，酚酞显粉红。
chapters.captionEn: Cathodic reaction near protected iron creates local alkalinity and pink phenolphthalein.

chapters.title: 铜接触改变腐蚀区域
chapters.titleEn: Copper contact changes the corrosion regions
chapters.caption: 铁附近的蓝色提示 Fe²⁺，铜附近可出现阴极粉红。
chapters.captionEn: Blue near iron indicates Fe²⁺; cathodic pink may appear near copper.

chapters.title: 仅仅相邻还不够
chapters.caption: 分离与接触是两次独立比较，电子通路改变保护关系。
chapters.captionEn: Separate trials compare isolation and contact; the electronic path changes protection.

chapters.title: 先确定组成与变量
chapters.caption: 虚拟配方用于控制变量，实际研究另记数据。
chapters.captionEn: The virtual formula supports controlled comparisons; actual research requires its own data.

chapters.title: 打开外包装，氧进入内袋
chapters.titleEn: Opening the outer package admits oxygen
chapters.caption: 铁氧化放热，内袋的透气性限制供氧。
chapters.captionEn: Iron oxidation releases heat; inner-pouch permeability limits oxygen supply.

chapters.title: 温度不是累计放热量
chapters.caption: 放热一部分储存在材料中，另一部分散向环境。
chapters.captionEn: Some released heat is stored; the rest flows to the environment.

chapters.title: 用对照组织实际研究
chapters.caption: 供氧受限与缺水组检验条件，实测记录保持独立。
chapters.captionEn: Oxygen-limited and dry controls test conditions; measured records remain separate.

chapters.title: 先看两个碳笼
chapters.caption: C₆₀ 与 C₇₀ 的原子连接不同，不能只画成两个大小不同的球。
chapters.captionEn: C₆₀ and C₇₀ have different atomic networks, not just different sphere sizes.

chapters.title: 进入杯酚骨架
chapters.caption: 主体与客体保持各自骨架；C₇₀ 也可以形成配合物。
chapters.captionEn: Host and guest retain their own skeletons; C₇₀ can also form a complex.

chapters.title: 分离固相与液相
chapters.titleEn: Separate the solid and liquid phases
chapters.caption: 保留相富集 C₆₀，但仍含 C₇₀；比例来自示例平衡计算。
chapters.captionEn: The retained phase is enriched in C₆₀ but still contains C₇₀; percentages are illustrative equilibrium results.

chapters.title: 改变环境，释放客体
chapters.titleEn: Change the environment to release the guest
chapters.caption: 同一客体离开主体，主体可以回收；分离效果仍取决于条件。
chapters.captionEn: The same guest leaves and the host can be recovered; separation remains condition-dependent.

chapters.title: 用氧原子围住阳离子
chapters.caption: 18-冠-6 有 18 个环原子，其中 6 个是氧。
chapters.captionEn: 18-crown-6 has 18 ring atoms, including 6 oxygens.

chapters.title: 空腔大小只是一个因素
chapters.caption: 不同环的尺寸范围不同；柔性、溶剂和配位共同影响识别。
chapters.captionEn: Rings have different cavity ranges; flexibility, solvent and coordination also affect recognition.

chapters.title: 把混合物送入吸附柱
chapters.caption: 植物色素随液体进入碳酸钙粉末，棉花支撑柱床。
chapters.captionEn: Plant pigments enter a calcium carbonate bed supported by cotton.

chapters.title: 移动与停留交替
chapters.caption: 只有处于流动相的时间用于迁移；吸附停留降低平均速度。
chapters.captionEn: Time spent adsorbed reduces average migration with the moving liquid.

chapters.title: 把时间差变成位置差
chapters.caption: 迁移速度不同，最初重叠的组分逐渐形成不同色带。
chapters.captionEn: Different migration speeds turn an overlapping mixture into distinct bands.

chapters.title: 对照相同的保留
chapters.caption: 将三者的保留设为相同，颜色重叠；扩大差异才能分开。
chapters.captionEn: Equal retention produces overlapping bands; contrasting retention separates them.

chapters.title: 展宽会损害分离
chapters.caption: 色带具有宽度，相邻分布重叠时，单一色层也可能含多种组分。
chapters.captionEn: Bands have width: overlapping distributions can leave a colored zone as a mixture.

chapters.title: 取出固体色层
chapters.caption: 回到分开的色带，把吸附色素的碳酸钙分层取出。
chapters.captionEn: Return to separated bands and remove the pigment-bearing calcium carbonate zones.

chapters.title: 再从色层提取色素
chapters.titleEn: Extract pigments from the removed zones
chapters.caption: 乙醇接触取出的色层，色素从吸附剂转入液相。
chapters.captionEn: Ethanol contacts the removed zones and transfers pigment into the liquid.
